edition: Hebrew–English column (Literal-Smooth, Rabbinic Priority) of the Saints.Bible Parallel Reader
source_hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex (pointed text via Sefaria), supplied for reference; the site does not display the Hebrew

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they came out of the land of Egypt, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה בְּמִדְבַּר סִינַי בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי בַּשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית לְצֵאתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Take a census of the whole congregation of the sons of Israel, by their clans and their ancestral houses, counting the names of every male, head by head.
verses.hebrew: שְׂאוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ כָּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמוֹת כָּל־זָכָר לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָם׃

verses.english: From twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out for military service in Israel: you and Aaron shall register them by their armies.
verses.hebrew: מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה כָּל־יֹצֵא צָבָא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל תִּפְקְדוּ אֹתָם לְצִבְאֹתָם אַתָּה וְאַהֲרֹן׃

verses.english: A man from each tribe shall be with you, each the head of his ancestral house.
verses.hebrew: וְאִתְּכֶם יִהְיוּ אִישׁ אִישׁ לַמַּטֶּה אִישׁ רֹאשׁ לְבֵית־אֲבֹתָיו הוּא׃

verses.english: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you. For Reuben: Elizur son of Shedeur.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יַעַמְדוּ אִתְּכֶם לִרְאוּבֵן אֱלִיצוּר בֶּן־שְׁדֵיאוּר׃

verses.english: For Simeon: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
verses.hebrew: לְשִׁמְעוֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵל בֶּן־צוּרִישַׁדָּי׃

verses.english: For Judah: Nahshon son of Amminadab.
verses.hebrew: לִיהוּדָה נַחְשׁוֹן בֶּן־עַמִּינָדָב׃

verses.english: For Issachar: Nethanel son of Zuar.
verses.hebrew: לְיִשָּׂשכָר נְתַנְאֵל בֶּן־צוּעָר׃

verses.english: For Zebulun: Eliab son of Helon.
verses.hebrew: לִזְבוּלֻן אֱלִיאָב בֶּן־חֵלֹן׃

verses.english: For the sons of Joseph: for Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud; for Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי יוֹסֵף לְאֶפְרַיִם אֱלִישָׁמָע בֶּן־עַמִּיהוּד לִמְנַשֶּׁה גַּמְלִיאֵל בֶּן־פְּדָהצוּר׃

verses.english: For Benjamin: Abidan son of Gideoni.
verses.hebrew: לְבִנְיָמִן אֲבִידָן בֶּן־גִּדְעֹנִי׃

verses.english: For Dan: Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
verses.hebrew: לְדָן אֲחִיעֶזֶר בֶּן־עַמִּישַׁדָּי׃

verses.english: For Asher: Pagiel son of Ocran.
verses.hebrew: לְאָשֵׁר פַּגְעִיאֵל בֶּן־עָכְרָן׃

verses.english: For Gad: Eliasaph son of Deuel.
verses.hebrew: לְגָד אֶלְיָסָף בֶּן־דְּעוּאֵל׃

verses.english: For Naphtali: Ahira son of Enan.
verses.hebrew: לְנַפְתָּלִי אֲחִירַע בֶּן־עֵינָן׃

verses.english: These were the men summoned from the congregation, the leaders of their ancestral tribes, the heads of Israel’s thousands.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה קריאי [קְרוּאֵי] הָעֵדָה נְשִׂיאֵי מַטּוֹת אֲבוֹתָם רָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵם׃

verses.english: Moses and Aaron took these men who had been designated by name.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֵת הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר נִקְּבוּ בְּשֵׁמוֹת׃

verses.english: They assembled the whole congregation on the first day of the second month. The men declared their descent by their clans and ancestral houses, with their names counted, from twenty years old and upward, head by head.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כָּל־הָעֵדָה הִקְהִילוּ בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי וַיִּתְיַלְדוּ עַל־מִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמוֹת מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָם׃

verses.english: As YHWH commanded Moses, he registered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה וַיִּפְקְדֵם בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי׃

verses.english: The sons of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn: their descendants by their clans and ancestral houses, by the number of names, head by head, every male, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out for military service.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־רְאוּבֵן בְּכֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל תּוֹלְדֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמוֹת לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָם כָּל־זָכָר מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה כֹּל יֹצֵא צָבָא׃

verses.english: Those registered for the tribe of Reuben were forty-six thousand five hundred.
verses.hebrew: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה רְאוּבֵן שִׁשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: The sons of Simeon: their descendants by their clans and ancestral houses, those registered by the number of names, head by head, every male, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out for military service.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן תּוֹלְדֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם פְּקֻדָיו בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמוֹת לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָם כָּל־זָכָר מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה כֹּל יֹצֵא צָבָא׃

verses.english: Those registered for the tribe of Simeon were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
verses.hebrew: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה שִׁמְעוֹן תִּשְׁעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: The sons of Judah: their descendants by their clans and ancestral houses, by the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out for military service.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי יְהוּדָה תּוֹלְדֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמֹת מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה כֹּל יֹצֵא צָבָא׃

verses.english: Those registered for the tribe of Judah were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
verses.hebrew: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה אַרְבָּעָה וְשִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: The sons of Issachar: their descendants by their clans and ancestral houses, by the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out for military service.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר תּוֹלְדֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמֹת מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה כֹּל יֹצֵא צָבָא׃

verses.english: Those registered for the tribe of Issachar were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.hebrew: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה יִשָּׂשכָר אַרְבָּעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: The sons of Zebulun: their descendants by their clans and ancestral houses, by the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out for military service.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי זְבוּלֻן תּוֹלְדֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמֹת מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה כֹּל יֹצֵא צָבָא׃

verses.english: Those registered for the tribe of Zebulun were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
verses.hebrew: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה זְבוּלֻן שִׁבְעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: The sons of Joseph, the sons of Ephraim: their descendants by their clans and ancestral houses, by the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out for military service.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי יוֹסֵף לִבְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם תּוֹלְדֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמֹת מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה כֹּל יֹצֵא צָבָא׃

verses.english: Those registered for the tribe of Ephraim were forty thousand five hundred.
verses.hebrew: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה אֶפְרָיִם אַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: The sons of Manasseh: their descendants by their clans and ancestral houses, by the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out for military service.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה תּוֹלְדֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמוֹת מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה כֹּל יֹצֵא צָבָא׃

verses.english: Those registered for the tribe of Manasseh were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.hebrew: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וּמָאתָיִם׃

verses.english: The sons of Benjamin: their descendants by their clans and ancestral houses, by the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out for military service.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי בִנְיָמִן תּוֹלְדֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמֹת מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה כֹּל יֹצֵא צָבָא׃

verses.english: Those registered for the tribe of Benjamin were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.hebrew: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה בִנְיָמִן חֲמִשָּׁה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: The sons of Gad: their descendants by their clans and ancestral houses, by the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out for military service.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי גָד תּוֹלְדֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמוֹת מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה כֹּל יֹצֵא צָבָא׃

verses.english: Those registered for the tribe of Gad were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
verses.hebrew: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה גָד חֲמִשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים׃

verses.english: The sons of Dan: their descendants by their clans and ancestral houses, by the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out for military service.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי דָן תּוֹלְדֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמֹת מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה כֹּל יֹצֵא צָבָא׃

verses.english: Those registered for the tribe of Dan were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.hebrew: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה דָן שְׁנַיִם וְשִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: The sons of Asher: their descendants by their clans and ancestral houses, by the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out for military service.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי אָשֵׁר תּוֹלְדֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמֹת מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה כֹּל יֹצֵא צָבָא׃

verses.english: Those registered for the tribe of Asher were forty-one thousand five hundred.
verses.hebrew: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה אָשֵׁר אֶחָד וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: The sons of Naphtali: their descendants by their clans and ancestral houses, by the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out for military service.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי נַפְתָּלִי תּוֹלְדֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמֹת מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה כֹּל יֹצֵא צָבָא׃

verses.english: Those registered for the tribe of Naphtali were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.hebrew: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמַטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי שְׁלֹשָׁה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: These are those registered by Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel, twelve men, one man for each ancestral house.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הַפְּקֻדִים אֲשֶׁר פָּקַד מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּנְשִׂיאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אִישׁ אִישׁ־אֶחָד לְבֵית־אֲבֹתָיו הָיוּ׃

verses.english: All those registered among the sons of Israel by their ancestral houses, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out for military service in Israel—
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ כָּל־פְּקוּדֵי בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה כָּל־יֹצֵא צָבָא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: All those registered were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ כָּל־הַפְּקֻדִים שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים׃

verses.english: The Levites, according to their ancestral tribe, were not registered among them.
verses.hebrew: וְהַלְוִיִּם לְמַטֵּה אֲבֹתָם לֹא הָתְפָּקְדוּ בְּתוֹכָם׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Only, you shall not register the tribe of Levi or take their census among the sons of Israel.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ אֶת־מַטֵּה לֵוִי לֹא תִפְקֹד וְאֶת־רֹאשָׁם לֹא תִשָּׂא בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Appoint the Levites over the Dwelling of Testimony, over all its furnishings, and over everything belonging to it. They shall carry the Dwelling and all its furnishings, serve it, and camp around it.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה הַפְקֵד אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם עַל־מִשְׁכַּן הָעֵדֻת וְעַל כָּל־כֵּלָיו וְעַל כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ הֵמָּה יִשְׂאוּ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָיו וְהֵם יְשָׁרְתֻהוּ וְסָבִיב לַמִּשְׁכָּן יַחֲנוּ׃

verses.english: When the Dwelling sets out, the Levites shall take it down; when it camps, the Levites shall erect it. Any unauthorized person who approaches shall be put to death.
verses.hebrew: וּבִנְסֹעַ הַמִּשְׁכָּן יוֹרִידוּ אֹתוֹ הַלְוִיִּם וּבַחֲנֹת הַמִּשְׁכָּן יָקִימוּ אֹתוֹ הַלְוִיִּם וְהַזָּר הַקָּרֵב יוּמָת׃

verses.english: The sons of Israel shall camp, each with his camp and each by his standard, according to their armies.
verses.hebrew: וְחָנוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ עַל־מַחֲנֵהוּ וְאִישׁ עַל־דִּגְלוֹ לְצִבְאֹתָם׃

verses.english: The Levites shall camp around the Dwelling of Testimony, so that wrath does not fall on the congregation of the sons of Israel. The Levites shall keep charge of the Dwelling of Testimony.
verses.hebrew: וְהַלְוִיִּם יַחֲנוּ סָבִיב לְמִשְׁכַּן הָעֵדֻת וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה קֶצֶף עַל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשָׁמְרוּ הַלְוִיִּם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת מִשְׁכַּן הָעֵדוּת׃

verses.english: The sons of Israel did everything that YHWH commanded Moses; so they did.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל־אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: The sons of Israel shall camp, each by his standard, with the signs of their ancestral houses. They shall camp at a distance, around the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ עַל־דִּגְלוֹ בְאֹתֹת לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם יַחֲנוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִנֶּגֶד סָבִיב לְאֹהֶל־מוֹעֵד יַחֲנוּ׃

verses.english: Those camping on the east, toward sunrise, shall be under the standard of Judah’s camp, by their armies. The leader of the sons of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab.
verses.hebrew: וְהַחֹנִים קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה יְהוּדָה לְצִבְאֹתָם וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי יְהוּדָה נַחְשׁוֹן בֶּן־עַמִּינָדָב׃

verses.english: His army, those registered, numbered seventy-four thousand six hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְשִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: Those camping beside him shall be the tribe of Issachar; the leader of the sons of Issachar is Nethanel son of Zuar.
verses.hebrew: וְהַחֹנִים עָלָיו מַטֵּה יִשָּׂשכָר וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר נְתַנְאֵל בֶּן־צוּעָר׃

verses.english: His army, those registered, numbered fifty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדָיו אַרְבָּעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: And the tribe of Zebulun; the leader of the sons of Zebulun is Eliab son of Helon.
verses.hebrew: מַטֵּה זְבוּלֻן וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי זְבוּלֻן אֱלִיאָב בֶּן־חֵלֹן׃

verses.english: His army, those registered, numbered fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדָיו שִׁבְעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: All those registered in the camp of Judah, by their armies, numbered one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred. They shall set out first.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַפְּקֻדִים לְמַחֲנֵה יְהוּדָה מְאַת אֶלֶף וּשְׁמֹנִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשֶׁת־אֲלָפִים וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת לְצִבְאֹתָם רִאשֹׁנָה יִסָּעוּ׃

verses.english: The standard of the camp of Reuben, by their armies, shall be on the south. The leader of the sons of Reuben is Elizur son of Shedeur.
verses.hebrew: דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה רְאוּבֵן תֵּימָנָה לְצִבְאֹתָם וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן אֱלִיצוּר בֶּן־שְׁדֵיאוּר׃

verses.english: His army, those registered, numbered forty-six thousand five hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדָיו שִׁשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: Those camping beside him shall be the tribe of Simeon; the leader of the sons of Simeon is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
verses.hebrew: וְהַחוֹנִם עָלָיו מַטֵּה שִׁמְעוֹן וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵל בֶּן־צוּרִי־שַׁדָּי׃

verses.english: His army, those registered, numbered fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם תִּשְׁעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: And the tribe of Gad; the leader of the sons of Gad is Eliasaph son of Reuel.
verses.hebrew: וְמַטֵּה גָּד וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי גָד אֶלְיָסָף בֶּן־רְעוּאֵל׃

verses.english: His army, those registered, numbered forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים׃

verses.english: All those registered in the camp of Reuben, by their armies, numbered one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty. They shall set out second.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַפְּקֻדִים לְמַחֲנֵה רְאוּבֵן מְאַת אֶלֶף וְאֶחָד וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים לְצִבְאֹתָם וּשְׁנִיִּם יִסָּעוּ׃

verses.english: Then the Tent of Meeting, the camp of the Levites, shall set out in the middle of the camps. As they camp, so they shall set out, each in his place, by their standards.
verses.hebrew: וְנָסַע אֹהֶל־מוֹעֵד מַחֲנֵה הַלְוִיִּם בְּתוֹךְ הַמַּחֲנֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר יַחֲנוּ כֵּן יִסָּעוּ אִישׁ עַל־יָדוֹ לְדִגְלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: The standard of the camp of Ephraim, by their armies, shall be on the west. The leader of the sons of Ephraim is Elishama son of Ammihud.
verses.hebrew: דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה אֶפְרַיִם לְצִבְאֹתָם יָמָּה וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם אֱלִישָׁמָע בֶּן־עַמִּיהוּד׃

verses.english: His army, those registered, numbered forty thousand five hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: Beside him shall be the tribe of Manasseh; the leader of the sons of Manasseh is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.
verses.hebrew: וְעָלָיו מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה גַּמְלִיאֵל בֶּן־פְּדָהצוּר׃

verses.english: His army, those registered, numbered thirty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וּמָאתָיִם׃

verses.english: And the tribe of Benjamin; the leader of the sons of Benjamin is Abidan son of Gideoni.
verses.hebrew: וּמַטֵּה בִּנְיָמִן וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי בִנְיָמִן אֲבִידָן בֶּן־גִּדְעֹנִי׃

verses.english: His army, those registered, numbered thirty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: All those registered in the camp of Ephraim, by their armies, numbered one hundred eight thousand one hundred. They shall set out third.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַפְּקֻדִים לְמַחֲנֵה אֶפְרַיִם מְאַת אֶלֶף וּשְׁמֹנַת־אֲלָפִים וּמֵאָה לְצִבְאֹתָם וּשְׁלִשִׁים יִסָּעוּ׃

verses.english: The standard of the camp of Dan, by their armies, shall be on the north. The leader of the sons of Dan is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
verses.hebrew: דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה דָן צָפֹנָה לְצִבְאֹתָם וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי דָן אֲחִיעֶזֶר בֶּן־עַמִּישַׁדָּי׃

verses.english: His army, those registered, numbered sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וְשִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: Those camping beside him shall be the tribe of Asher; the leader of the sons of Asher is Pagiel son of Ocran.
verses.hebrew: וְהַחֹנִים עָלָיו מַטֵּה אָשֵׁר וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי אָשֵׁר פַּגְעִיאֵל בֶּן־עָכְרָן׃

verses.english: His army, those registered, numbered forty-one thousand five hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם אֶחָד וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: And the tribe of Naphtali; the leader of the sons of Naphtali is Ahira son of Enan.
verses.hebrew: וּמַטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי וְנָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי אֲחִירַע בֶּן־עֵינָן׃

verses.english: His army, those registered, numbered fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּצְבָאוֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: All those registered in the camp of Dan numbered one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last, by their standards.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַפְּקֻדִים לְמַחֲנֵה דָן מְאַת אֶלֶף וְשִׁבְעָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת לָאַחֲרֹנָה יִסְעוּ לְדִגְלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: These are those registered among the sons of Israel by their ancestral houses. All those registered in the camps, by their armies, were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה פְּקוּדֵי בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם כָּל־פְּקוּדֵי הַמַּחֲנֹת לְצִבְאֹתָם שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים׃

verses.english: The Levites were not registered among the sons of Israel, as YHWH commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וְהַלְוִיִּם לֹא הָתְפָּקְדוּ בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: The sons of Israel did everything that YHWH commanded Moses. So they camped by their standards, and so they set out, each by his clan and ancestral house.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה כֵּן־חָנוּ לְדִגְלֵיהֶם וְכֵן נָסָעוּ אִישׁ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָיו עַל־בֵּית אֲבֹתָיו׃

verses.english: These are the generations of Aaron and Moses on the day when YHWH spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדֹת אַהֲרֹן וּמֹשֶׁה בְּיוֹם דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה בְּהַר סִינָי׃

verses.english: These are the names of Aaron’s sons: Nadab the firstborn, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי־אַהֲרֹן הַבְּכוֹר נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא אֶלְעָזָר וְאִיתָמָר׃

verses.english: These are the names of Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests whose hands were filled for priestly service.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֲנִים הַמְּשֻׁחִים אֲשֶׁר־מִלֵּא יָדָם לְכַהֵן׃

verses.english: Nadab and Abihu died before YHWH when they offered unauthorized fire before YHWH in the wilderness of Sinai. They had no sons. Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during the lifetime of Aaron their father.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא לִפְנֵי יְהוָה בְּהַקְרִבָם אֵשׁ זָרָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה בְּמִדְבַּר סִינַי וּבָנִים לֹא־הָיוּ לָהֶם וַיְכַהֵן אֶלְעָזָר וְאִיתָמָר עַל־פְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֲבִיהֶם׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Bring the tribe of Levi near and stand them before Aaron the priest, so that they may serve him.
verses.hebrew: הַקְרֵב אֶת־מַטֵּה לֵוִי וְהַעֲמַדְתָּ אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וְשֵׁרְתוּ אֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: They shall keep his charge and the charge of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, performing the service of the Dwelling.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת־מִשְׁמַרְתּוֹ וְאֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת כָּל־הָעֵדָה לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לַעֲבֹד אֶת־עֲבֹדַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

verses.english: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting and the charge of the sons of Israel, performing the service of the Dwelling.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת־כָּל־כְּלֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְאֶת־מִשְׁמֶרֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲבֹד אֶת־עֲבֹדַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

verses.english: Give the Levites to Aaron and his sons. They are wholly given to him from the sons of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו נְתוּנִם נְתוּנִם הֵמָּה לוֹ מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall guard their priesthood. Any unauthorized person who approaches shall be put to death.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת־בָּנָיו תִּפְקֹד וְשָׁמְרוּ אֶת־כְּהֻנָּתָם וְהַזָּר הַקָּרֵב יוּמָת׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Look, I have taken the Levites from among the sons of Israel in place of every firstborn who opens the womb among the sons of Israel. The Levites shall be Mine.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי הִנֵּה לָקַחְתִּי אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תַּחַת כָּל־בְּכוֹר פֶּטֶר רֶחֶם מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיוּ לִי הַלְוִיִּם׃

verses.english: For every firstborn is Mine. On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated to Myself every firstborn in Israel, human and livestock alike. They shall be Mine. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לִי כָּל־בְּכוֹר בְּיוֹם הַכֹּתִי כָל־בְּכוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי לִי כָל־בְּכוֹר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאָדָם עַד־בְּהֵמָה לִי יִהְיוּ אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה בְּמִדְבַּר סִינַי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Register the sons of Levi by their ancestral houses and clans. Register every male from one month old and upward.
verses.hebrew: פְּקֹד אֶת־בְּנֵי לֵוִי לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם כָּל־זָכָר מִבֶּן־חֹדֶשׁ וָמַעְלָה תִּפְקְדֵם׃

verses.english: Moses registered them at the mouth of YHWH, as he was commanded.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְקֹד אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה עַל־פִּי יְהוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צֻוָּה׃

verses.english: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ־אֵלֶּה בְנֵי־לֵוִי בִּשְׁמֹתָם גֵּרְשׁוֹן וּקְהָת וּמְרָרִי׃

verses.english: These are the names of Gershon’s sons by their clans: Libni and Shimei.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי־גֵרְשׁוֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִבְנִי וְשִׁמְעִי׃

verses.english: The sons of Kohath by their clans: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי קְהָת לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם עַמְרָם וְיִצְהָר חֶבְרוֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵל׃

verses.english: The sons of Merari by their clans: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of Levi by their ancestral houses.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם מַחְלִי וּמוּשִׁי אֵלֶּה הֵם מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַלֵּוִי לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם׃

verses.english: To Gershon belonged the Libnite clan and the Shimeite clan. These are the Gershonite clans.
verses.hebrew: לְגֵרְשׁוֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַלִּבְנִי וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הַשִּׁמְעִי אֵלֶּה הֵם מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי׃

verses.english: Those registered, counting every male from one month old and upward, numbered seven thousand five hundred.
verses.hebrew: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם בְּמִסְפַּר כָּל־זָכָר מִבֶּן־חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה פְּקֻדֵיהֶם שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: The Gershonite clans shall camp behind the Dwelling, toward the west.
verses.hebrew: מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי אַחֲרֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן יַחֲנוּ יָמָּה׃

verses.english: The leader of the ancestral house of the Gershonites is Eliasaph son of Lael.
verses.hebrew: וּנְשִׂיא בֵית־אָב לַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי אֶלְיָסָף בֶּן־לָאֵל׃

verses.english: The charge of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting is the Dwelling, the tent, its covering, and the screen at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
verses.hebrew: וּמִשְׁמֶרֶת בְּנֵי־גֵרְשׁוֹן בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְהָאֹהֶל מִכְסֵהוּ וּמָסַךְ פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: The hangings of the courtyard, the screen at the courtyard entrance surrounding the Dwelling and the altar, and its cords for all its service.
verses.hebrew: וְקַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר וְאֶת־מָסַךְ פֶּתַח הֶחָצֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְעַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב וְאֵת מֵיתָרָיו לְכֹל עֲבֹדָתוֹ׃

verses.english: To Kohath belonged the Amramite, Izharite, Hebronite, and Uzzielite clans. These are the Kohathite clans.
verses.hebrew: וְלִקְהָת מִשְׁפַּחַת הַעַמְרָמִי וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הַיִּצְהָרִי וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶבְרֹנִי וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הָעָזִּיאֵלִי אֵלֶּה הֵם מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקְּהָתִי׃

verses.english: Counting every male from one month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred, keeping charge of the sanctuary.
verses.hebrew: בְּמִסְפַּר כָּל־זָכָר מִבֶּן־חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה שְׁמֹנַת אֲלָפִים וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: The clans of the sons of Kohath shall camp on the south side of the Dwelling.
verses.hebrew: מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי־קְהָת יַחֲנוּ עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּן תֵּימָנָה׃

verses.english: The leader of the ancestral house of the Kohathite clans is Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
verses.hebrew: וּנְשִׂיא בֵית־אָב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקְּהָתִי אֶלִיצָפָן בֶּן־עֻזִּיאֵל׃

verses.english: Their charge is the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the sanctuary utensils with which service is performed, the screen, and all its service.
verses.hebrew: וּמִשְׁמַרְתָּם הָאָרֹן וְהַשֻּׁלְחָן וְהַמְּנֹרָה וְהַמִּזְבְּחֹת וּכְלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְתוּ בָּהֶם וְהַמָּסָךְ וְכֹל עֲבֹדָתוֹ׃

verses.english: The chief of the Levite leaders is Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, with oversight of those keeping charge of the sanctuary.
verses.hebrew: וּנְשִׂיא נְשִׂיאֵי הַלֵּוִי אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן פְּקֻדַּת שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: To Merari belonged the Mahlite clan and the Mushite clan. These are the clans of Merari.
verses.hebrew: לִמְרָרִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּחְלִי וּמִשְׁפַּחַת הַמּוּשִׁי אֵלֶּה הֵם מִשְׁפְּחֹת מְרָרִי׃

verses.english: Those registered, counting every male from one month old and upward, numbered six thousand two hundred.
verses.hebrew: וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם בְּמִסְפַּר כָּל־זָכָר מִבֶּן־חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה שֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וּמָאתָיִם׃

verses.english: The leader of the ancestral house of the Merarite clans is Zuriel son of Abihail. They shall camp on the north side of the Dwelling.
verses.hebrew: וּנְשִׂיא בֵית־אָב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹת מְרָרִי צוּרִיאֵל בֶּן־אֲבִיחָיִל עַל יֶרֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּן יַחֲנוּ צָפֹנָה׃

verses.english: The appointed charge of the sons of Merari is the frames of the Dwelling, its bars, pillars, and bases, all its furnishings, and all its service,
verses.hebrew: וּפְקֻדַּת מִשְׁמֶרֶת בְּנֵי מְרָרִי קַרְשֵׁי הַמִּשְׁכָּן וּבְרִיחָיו וְעַמֻּדָיו וַאֲדָנָיו וְכָל־כֵּלָיו וְכֹל עֲבֹדָתוֹ׃

verses.english: The pillars around the courtyard, their bases, pegs, and cords.
verses.hebrew: וְעַמֻּדֵי הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב וְאַדְנֵיהֶם וִיתֵדֹתָם וּמֵיתְרֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Those camping before the Dwelling, eastward, before the Tent of Meeting toward sunrise, are Moses, Aaron, and his sons, keeping charge of the sanctuary on behalf of the sons of Israel. Any unauthorized person who approaches shall be put to death.
verses.hebrew: וְהַחֹנִים לִפְנֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן קֵדְמָה לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל־מוֹעֵד מִזְרָחָה מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו שֹׁמְרִים מִשְׁמֶרֶת הַמִּקְדָּשׁ לְמִשְׁמֶרֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַזָּר הַקָּרֵב יוּמָת׃

verses.english: All those registered among the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron registered at the mouth of YHWH by their clans, every male from one month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־פְּקוּדֵי הַלְוִיִּם אֲשֶׁר פָּקַד מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן עַל־פִּי יְהוָה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם כָּל־זָכָר מִבֶּן־חֹדֶשׁ וָמַעְלָה שְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף׃

verses.english: YHWH said to Moses: Register every firstborn male among the sons of Israel from one month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה פְּקֹד כָּל־בְּכֹר זָכָר לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִבֶּן־חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה וְשָׂא אֵת מִסְפַּר שְׁמֹתָם׃

verses.english: Take the Levites for Me—I am YHWH—in place of every firstborn among the sons of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of every firstborn among the livestock of the sons of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם לִי אֲנִי יְהוָה תַּחַת כָּל־בְּכֹר בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֵת בֶּהֱמַת הַלְוִיִּם תַּחַת כָּל־בְּכוֹר בְּבֶהֱמַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Moses registered every firstborn among the sons of Israel, as YHWH commanded him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְקֹד מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֹתוֹ אֶת־כָּל־בְּכֹר בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: All the firstborn males, counted by name from one month old and upward, numbered twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כָל־בְּכוֹר זָכָר בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמוֹת מִבֶּן־חֹדֶשׁ וָמַעְלָה לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף שְׁלֹשָׁה וְשִׁבְעִים וּמָאתָיִם׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Take the Levites in place of every firstborn among the sons of Israel, and the Levites’ livestock in place of their livestock. The Levites shall be Mine. I am YHWH.
verses.hebrew: קַח אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם תַּחַת כָּל־בְּכוֹר בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־בֶּהֱמַת הַלְוִיִּם תַּחַת בְּהֶמְתָּם וְהָיוּ־לִי הַלְוִיִּם אֲנִי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three firstborn sons of Israel who exceed the number of Levites,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת פְּדוּיֵי הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה וְהַשִּׁבְעִים וְהַמָּאתָיִם הָעֹדְפִים עַל־הַלְוִיִּם מִבְּכוֹר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Take five shekels per head, using the sanctuary shekel; the shekel is twenty gerahs.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַחְתָּ חֲמֵשֶׁת חֲמֵשֶׁת שְׁקָלִים לַגֻּלְגֹּלֶת בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ תִּקָּח עֶשְׂרִים גֵּרָה הַשָּׁקֶל׃

verses.english: Give the silver to Aaron and his sons as the redemption payment for those who exceed their number.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה הַכֶּסֶף לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו פְּדוּיֵי הָעֹדְפִים בָּהֶם׃

verses.english: Moses took the redemption silver from those who exceeded the number redeemed by the Levites.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֵת כֶּסֶף הַפִּדְיוֹם מֵאֵת הָעֹדְפִים עַל פְּדוּיֵי הַלְוִיִּם׃

verses.english: From the firstborn of the sons of Israel he took the silver: one thousand three hundred sixty-five sanctuary shekels.
verses.hebrew: מֵאֵת בְּכוֹר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָקַח אֶת־הַכָּסֶף חֲמִשָּׁה וְשִׁשִּׁים וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וָאֶלֶף בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: Moses gave the redemption silver to Aaron and his sons at the mouth of YHWH, as YHWH commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה אֶת־כֶּסֶף הַפְּדֻיִם לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו עַל־פִּי יְהוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל־אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their clans and ancestral houses,
verses.hebrew: נָשֹׂא אֶת־רֹאשׁ בְּנֵי קְהָת מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי לֵוִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם׃

verses.english: From thirty years old and upward, up to fifty years old, everyone entering the service to do work in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: מִבֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה וְעַד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה כָּל־בָּא לַצָּבָא לַעֲשׂוֹת מְלָאכָה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting: the most holy things.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת עֲבֹדַת בְּנֵי־קְהָת בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים׃

verses.english: When the camp sets out, Aaron and his sons shall enter, take down the screening curtain, and cover the Ark of Testimony with it.
verses.hebrew: וּבָא אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו בִּנְסֹעַ הַמַּחֲנֶה וְהוֹרִדוּ אֵת פָּרֹכֶת הַמָּסָךְ וְכִסּוּ־בָהּ אֵת אֲרֹן הָעֵדֻת׃

verses.english: They shall put over it a covering of tahash skin, spread a cloth entirely of blue above it, and set its poles in place.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנוּ עָלָיו כְּסוּי עוֹר תַּחַשׁ וּפָרְשׂוּ בֶגֶד־כְּלִיל תְּכֵלֶת מִלְמָעְלָה וְשָׂמוּ בַּדָּיו׃

verses.english: Over the Table of the Presence they shall spread a blue cloth and put on it the dishes, ladles, pitchers, and bowls for pouring. The continual bread shall remain on it.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל שֻׁלְחַן הַפָּנִים יִפְרְשׂוּ בֶּגֶד תְּכֵלֶת וְנָתְנוּ עָלָיו אֶת־הַקְּעָרֹת וְאֶת־הַכַּפֹּת וְאֶת־הַמְּנַקִּיֹּת וְאֵת קְשׂוֹת הַנָּסֶךְ וְלֶחֶם הַתָּמִיד עָלָיו יִהְיֶה׃

verses.english: They shall spread a scarlet cloth over them, cover it with a covering of tahash skin, and set its poles in place.
verses.hebrew: וּפָרְשׂוּ עֲלֵיהֶם בֶּגֶד תּוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי וְכִסּוּ אֹתוֹ בְּמִכְסֵה עוֹר תָּחַשׁ וְשָׂמוּ אֶת־בַּדָּיו׃

verses.english: They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand for light, its lamps, tongs, firepans, and all the oil vessels used in serving it.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקְחוּ בֶּגֶד תְּכֵלֶת וְכִסּוּ אֶת־מְנֹרַת הַמָּאוֹר וְאֶת־נֵרֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־מַלְקָחֶיהָ וְאֶת־מַחְתֹּתֶיהָ וְאֵת כָּל־כְּלֵי שַׁמְנָהּ אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְתוּ־לָהּ בָּהֶם׃

verses.english: They shall put it and all its furnishings into a covering of tahash skin and place it on the carrying frame.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנוּ אֹתָהּ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלֶיהָ אֶל־מִכְסֵה עוֹר תָּחַשׁ וְנָתְנוּ עַל־הַמּוֹט׃

verses.english: Over the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, cover it with a covering of tahash skin, and set its poles in place.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב יִפְרְשׂוּ בֶּגֶד תְּכֵלֶת וְכִסּוּ אֹתוֹ בְּמִכְסֵה עוֹר תָּחַשׁ וְשָׂמוּ אֶת־בַּדָּיו׃

verses.english: They shall take all the service utensils used in the sanctuary, put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of tahash skin, and place them on the carrying frame.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקְחוּ אֶת־כָּל־כְּלֵי הַשָּׁרֵת אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְתוּ־בָם בַּקֹּדֶשׁ וְנָתְנוּ אֶל־בֶּגֶד תְּכֵלֶת וְכִסּוּ אוֹתָם בְּמִכְסֵה עוֹר תָּחַשׁ וְנָתְנוּ עַל־הַמּוֹט׃

verses.english: They shall remove the ashes from the altar and spread a purple cloth over it.
verses.hebrew: וְדִשְּׁנוּ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּפָרְשׂוּ עָלָיו בֶּגֶד אַרְגָּמָן׃

verses.english: They shall put on it all the utensils used in its service: the firepans, forks, shovels, and basins—all the altar utensils. They shall spread a covering of tahash skin over it and set its poles in place.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתְנוּ עָלָיו אֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָיו אֲשֶׁר יְשָׁרְתוּ עָלָיו בָּהֶם אֶת־הַמַּחְתֹּת אֶת־הַמִּזְלָגֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקֹת כֹּל כְּלֵי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּפָרְשׂוּ עָלָיו כְּסוּי עוֹר תַּחַשׁ וְשָׂמוּ בַדָּיו׃

verses.english: When the camp sets out, Aaron and his sons shall finish covering the holy things and all the holy utensils. Afterward the sons of Kohath shall come to carry them, but they must not touch the holy things, lest they die. These are the burdens of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְכִלָּה אַהֲרֹן־וּבָנָיו לְכַסֹּת אֶת־הַקֹּדֶשׁ וְאֶת־כָּל־כְּלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ בִּנְסֹעַ הַמַּחֲנֶה וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן יָבֹאוּ בְנֵי־קְהָת לָשֵׂאת וְלֹא־יִגְּעוּ אֶל־הַקֹּדֶשׁ וָמֵתוּ אֵלֶּה מַשָּׂא בְנֵי־קְהָת בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest has charge of the oil for light, the fragrant incense, the continual grain offering, and the anointing oil. He has oversight of the whole Dwelling and everything in it, the holy things and their utensils.
verses.hebrew: וּפְקֻדַּת אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן שֶׁמֶן הַמָּאוֹר וּקְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים וּמִנְחַת הַתָּמִיד וְשֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה פְּקֻדַּת כָּל־הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ בְּקֹדֶשׁ וּבְכֵלָיו׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל־אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Do not let the tribe of the Kohathite clans be cut off from among the Levites.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּכְרִיתוּ אֶת־שֵׁבֶט מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקְּהָתִי מִתּוֹךְ הַלְוִיִּם׃

verses.english: Do this for them so that they may live and not die when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall enter and assign each man to his service and his burden.
verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת עֲשׂוּ לָהֶם וְחָיוּ וְלֹא יָמֻתוּ בְּגִשְׁתָּם אֶת־קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו יָבֹאוּ וְשָׂמוּ אוֹתָם אִישׁ אִישׁ עַל־עֲבֹדָתוֹ וְאֶל־מַשָּׂאוֹ׃

verses.english: They must not enter to see while the holy things are being covered, lest they die.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יָבֹאוּ לִרְאוֹת כְּבַלַּע אֶת־הַקֹּדֶשׁ וָמֵתוּ׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their ancestral houses and clans.
verses.hebrew: נָשֹׂא אֶת־רֹאשׁ בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן גַּם־הֵם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

verses.english: Register them from thirty years old and upward, up to fifty years old, everyone entering the service to perform service in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: מִבֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה עַד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה תִּפְקֹד אוֹתָם כָּל־הַבָּא לִצְבֹא צָבָא לַעֲבֹד עֲבֹדָה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: This is the service of the Gershonite clans, in serving and carrying:
verses.hebrew: זֹאת עֲבֹדַת מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לַעֲבֹד וּלְמַשָּׂא׃

verses.english: They shall carry the curtains of the Dwelling, the Tent of Meeting, its covering, the tahash covering above it, and the screen at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
verses.hebrew: וְנָשְׂאוּ אֶת־יְרִיעֹת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד מִכְסֵהוּ וּמִכְסֵה הַתַּחַשׁ אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו מִלְמָעְלָה וְאֶת־מָסַךְ פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: The courtyard hangings, the screen at the entrance to the courtyard gate surrounding the Dwelling and altar, their cords, all their service utensils, and everything to be done with them. They shall perform the service.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת קַלְעֵי הֶחָצֵר וְאֶת־מָסַךְ פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְעַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב וְאֵת מֵיתְרֵיהֶם וְאֶת־כָּל־כְּלֵי עֲבֹדָתָם וְאֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה לָהֶם וְעָבָדוּ׃

verses.english: All the service of the sons of Gershon, all their carrying and all their work, shall be at the mouth of Aaron and his sons. You shall assign all their burdens to their charge.
verses.hebrew: עַל־פִּי אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו תִּהְיֶה כָּל־עֲבֹדַת בְּנֵי הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לְכָל־מַשָּׂאָם וּלְכֹל עֲבֹדָתָם וּפְקַדְתֶּם עֲלֵהֶם בְּמִשְׁמֶרֶת אֵת כָּל־מַשָּׂאָם׃

verses.english: This is the service of the clans of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting. Their charge is under the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת עֲבֹדַת מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּמִשְׁמַרְתָּם בְּיַד אִיתָמָר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: Register the sons of Merari by their clans and ancestral houses.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית־אֲבֹתָם תִּפְקֹד אֹתָם׃

verses.english: Register them from thirty years old and upward, up to fifty years old, everyone entering the service to perform the service of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: מִבֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה וְעַד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה תִּפְקְדֵם כָּל־הַבָּא לַצָּבָא לַעֲבֹד אֶת־עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: This is the charge of what they carry for all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the frames of the Dwelling, its bars, pillars, and bases,
verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת מִשְׁמֶרֶת מַשָּׂאָם לְכָל־עֲבֹדָתָם בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד קַרְשֵׁי הַמִּשְׁכָּן וּבְרִיחָיו וְעַמּוּדָיו וַאֲדָנָיו׃

verses.english: The pillars around the courtyard, their bases, pegs, and cords, with all their utensils and all their service. Assign by name the utensils entrusted to their carrying.
verses.hebrew: וְעַמּוּדֵי הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב וְאַדְנֵיהֶם וִיתֵדֹתָם וּמֵיתְרֵיהֶם לְכָל־כְּלֵיהֶם וּלְכֹל עֲבֹדָתָם וּבְשֵׁמֹת תִּפְקְדוּ אֶת־כְּלֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת מַשָּׂאָם׃

verses.english: This is the service of the clans of the sons of Merari, all their service in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת עֲבֹדַת מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי מְרָרִי לְכָל־עֲבֹדָתָם בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד בְּיַד אִיתָמָר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of the congregation registered the sons of Kohath by their clans and ancestral houses,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְקֹד מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּנְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה אֶת־בְּנֵי הַקְּהָתִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וּלְבֵית אֲבֹתָם׃

verses.english: From thirty years old and upward, up to fifty years old, everyone entering the service for work in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: מִבֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה וְעַד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה כָּל־הַבָּא לַצָּבָא לַעֲבֹדָה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: Those registered by their clans numbered two thousand seven hundred fifty.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ פְקֻדֵיהֶם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם אַלְפַּיִם שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים׃

verses.english: These are those registered from the Kohathite clans, everyone serving in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron registered at the mouth of YHWH through Moses.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה פְקוּדֵי מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַקְּהָתִי כָּל־הָעֹבֵד בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר פָּקַד מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן עַל־פִּי יְהוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: Those registered among the sons of Gershon, by their clans and ancestral houses,
verses.hebrew: וּפְקוּדֵי בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם וּלְבֵית אֲבֹתָם׃

verses.english: From thirty years old and upward, up to fifty years old, everyone entering the service for work in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: מִבֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה וְעַד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה כָּל־הַבָּא לַצָּבָא לַעֲבֹדָה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: Those registered by their clans and ancestral houses numbered two thousand six hundred thirty.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ פְּקֻדֵיהֶם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם אַלְפַּיִם וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִׁים׃

verses.english: These are those registered from the clans of the sons of Gershon, everyone serving in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron registered at the mouth of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה פְקוּדֵי מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן כָּל־הָעֹבֵד בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר פָּקַד מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן עַל־פִּי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Those registered from the clans of the sons of Merari, by their clans and ancestral houses,
verses.hebrew: וּפְקוּדֵי מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם׃

verses.english: From thirty years old and upward, up to fifty years old, everyone entering the service for work in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: מִבֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה וְעַד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה כָּל־הַבָּא לַצָּבָא לַעֲבֹדָה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: Those registered by their clans numbered three thousand two hundred.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ פְקֻדֵיהֶם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וּמָאתָיִם׃

verses.english: These are those registered from the clans of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron registered at the mouth of YHWH through Moses.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה פְקוּדֵי מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי מְרָרִי אֲשֶׁר פָּקַד מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן עַל־פִּי יְהוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: All those registered among the Levites by Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel, by their clans and ancestral houses,
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַפְּקֻדִים אֲשֶׁר פָּקַד מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּנְשִׂיאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וּלְבֵית אֲבֹתָם׃

verses.english: From thirty years old and upward, up to fifty years old, everyone entering to perform the work of service and the work of carrying in the Tent of Meeting,
verses.hebrew: מִבֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה וְעַד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה כָּל־הַבָּא לַעֲבֹד עֲבֹדַת עֲבֹדָה וַעֲבֹדַת מַשָּׂא בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: Those registered numbered eight thousand five hundred eighty.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ פְּקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁמֹנַת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וּשְׁמֹנִים׃

verses.english: At the mouth of YHWH, through Moses, each man was appointed to his service and his burden. So they were registered as YHWH commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: עַל־פִּי יְהוָה פָּקַד אוֹתָם בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה אִישׁ אִישׁ עַל־עֲבֹדָתוֹ וְעַל־מַשָּׂאוֹ וּפְקֻדָיו אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Command the sons of Israel to send out of the camp everyone with leprosy, everyone with a discharge, and everyone unclean through a dead person.
verses.hebrew: צַו אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וִישַׁלְּחוּ מִן־הַמַּחֲנֶה כָּל־צָרוּעַ וְכָל־זָב וְכֹל טָמֵא לָנָפֶשׁ׃

verses.english: Send out male and female alike. Send them outside the camp, so that they do not defile their camps, where I dwell among them.
verses.hebrew: מִזָּכָר עַד־נְקֵבָה תְּשַׁלֵּחוּ אֶל־מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה תְּשַׁלְּחוּם וְלֹא יְטַמְּאוּ אֶת־מַחֲנֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי שֹׁכֵן בְּתוֹכָם׃

verses.english: The sons of Israel did so and sent them outside the camp. As YHWH spoke to Moses, so the sons of Israel did.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־כֵן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ אוֹתָם אֶל־מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to the sons of Israel: When a man or woman commits any human sin, acting unfaithfully against YHWH, and that person becomes guilty,
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ אוֹ־אִשָּׁה כִּי יַעֲשׂוּ מִכָּל־חַטֹּאת הָאָדָם לִמְעֹל מַעַל בַּיהוָה וְאָשְׁמָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא׃

verses.english: They shall confess the sin they committed. The person shall repay the full amount of the wrong, add one-fifth to it, and give it to the person wronged.
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְוַדּוּ אֶת־חַטָּאתָם אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ וְהֵשִׁיב אֶת־אֲשָׁמוֹ בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וַחֲמִישִׁתוֹ יֹסֵף עָלָיו וְנָתַן לַאֲשֶׁר אָשַׁם לוֹ׃

verses.english: If the man has no kinsman to receive repayment, the repayment made to YHWH shall belong to the priest, besides the ram of atonement with which atonement is made for him.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־אֵין לָאִישׁ גֹּאֵל לְהָשִׁיב הָאָשָׁם אֵלָיו הָאָשָׁם הַמּוּשָׁב לַיהוָה לַכֹּהֵן מִלְּבַד אֵיל הַכִּפֻּרִים אֲשֶׁר יְכַפֶּר־בּוֹ עָלָיו׃

verses.english: Every contribution from all the holy gifts of the sons of Israel that they bring to the priest shall belong to him.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־תְּרוּמָה לְכָל־קָדְשֵׁי בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־יַקְרִיבוּ לַכֹּהֵן לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

verses.english: Each man’s holy gifts shall be his; whatever a man gives to the priest shall belong to him.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֶת־קֳדָשָׁיו לוֹ יִהְיוּ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִתֵּן לַכֹּהֵן לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them: If any man’s wife strays and acts unfaithfully against him,
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אִישׁ כִּי־תִשְׂטֶה אִשְׁתּוֹ וּמָעֲלָה בוֹ מָעַל׃

verses.english: And a man lies with her in an emission of seed, hidden from her husband’s eyes, and she conceals herself, having become defiled, with no witness against her and without being caught,
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁכַב אִישׁ אֹתָהּ שִׁכְבַת־זֶרַע וְנֶעְלַם מֵעֵינֵי אִישָׁהּ וְנִסְתְּרָה וְהִיא נִטְמָאָה וְעֵד אֵין בָּהּ וְהִוא לֹא נִתְפָּשָׂה׃

verses.english: And a spirit of jealousy comes over him and he is jealous of his wife, when she is defiled—or a spirit of jealousy comes over him and he is jealous of his wife, when she is not defiled—
verses.hebrew: וְעָבַר עָלָיו רוּחַ־קִנְאָה וְקִנֵּא אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ וְהִוא נִטְמָאָה אוֹ־עָבַר עָלָיו רוּחַ־קִנְאָה וְקִנֵּא אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ וְהִיא לֹא נִטְמָאָה׃

verses.english: The man shall bring his wife to the priest and bring her offering on her behalf: one-tenth of an ephah of barley flour. He shall not pour oil on it or put frankincense on it, because it is a grain offering of jealousy, a memorial grain offering bringing guilt to remembrance.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵבִיא הָאִישׁ אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן וְהֵבִיא אֶת־קָרְבָּנָהּ עָלֶיהָ עֲשִׂירִת הָאֵיפָה קֶמַח שְׂעֹרִים לֹא־יִצֹק עָלָיו שֶׁמֶן וְלֹא־יִתֵּן עָלָיו לְבֹנָה כִּי־מִנְחַת קְנָאֹת הוּא מִנְחַת זִכָּרוֹן מַזְכֶּרֶת עָוֺן׃

verses.english: The priest shall bring her near and stand her before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב אֹתָהּ הַכֹּהֵן וְהֶעֱמִדָהּ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: The priest shall take holy water in an earthenware vessel. He shall take some dust from the floor of the Dwelling and put it into the water.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מַיִם קְדֹשִׁים בִּכְלִי־חָרֶשׂ וּמִן־הֶעָפָר אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה בְּקַרְקַע הַמִּשְׁכָּן יִקַּח הַכֹּהֵן וְנָתַן אֶל־הַמָּיִם׃

verses.english: The priest shall stand the woman before YHWH, loosen the hair of her head, and put the memorial grain offering—the grain offering of jealousy—on her palms. In the priest’s hand shall be the bitter water that brings a curse.
verses.hebrew: וְהֶעֱמִיד הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הָאִשָּׁה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וּפָרַע אֶת־רֹאשׁ הָאִשָּׁה וְנָתַן עַל־כַּפֶּיהָ אֵת מִנְחַת הַזִּכָּרוֹן מִנְחַת קְנָאֹת הִוא וּבְיַד הַכֹּהֵן יִהְיוּ מֵי הַמָּרִים הַמְאָרֲרִים׃

verses.english: The priest shall put her under oath and say to the woman: If no man has lain with you, and you have not strayed into defilement while under your husband, be free from this bitter water that brings a curse.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁבִּיעַ אֹתָהּ הַכֹּהֵן וְאָמַר אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה אִם־לֹא שָׁכַב אִישׁ אֹתָךְ וְאִם־לֹא שָׂטִית טֻמְאָה תַּחַת אִישֵׁךְ הִנָּקִי מִמֵּי הַמָּרִים הַמְאָרֲרִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

verses.english: But if you have strayed while under your husband, if you have become defiled, and a man other than your husband has put his emission in you—
verses.hebrew: וְאַתְּ כִּי שָׂטִית תַּחַת אִישֵׁךְ וְכִי נִטְמֵאת וַיִּתֵּן אִישׁ בָּךְ אֶת־שְׁכָבְתּוֹ מִבַּלְעֲדֵי אִישֵׁךְ׃

verses.english: The priest shall put the woman under the oath of the curse and say to her: May YHWH make you a curse and an oath among your people, when YHWH makes your thigh fall and your belly swell.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁבִּיעַ הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הָאִשָּׁה בִּשְׁבֻעַת הָאָלָה וְאָמַר הַכֹּהֵן לָאִשָּׁה יִתֵּן יְהוָה אוֹתָךְ לְאָלָה וְלִשְׁבֻעָה בְּתוֹךְ עַמֵּךְ בְּתֵת יְהוָה אֶת־יְרֵכֵךְ נֹפֶלֶת וְאֶת־בִּטְנֵךְ צָבָה׃

verses.english: May this curse-bringing water enter your inward parts, making the belly swell and the thigh fall. The woman shall say: Amen, amen.
verses.hebrew: וּבָאוּ הַמַּיִם הַמְאָרְרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּמֵעַיִךְ לַצְבּוֹת בֶּטֶן וְלַנְפִּל יָרֵךְ וְאָמְרָה הָאִשָּׁה אָמֵן אָמֵן׃

verses.english: The priest shall write these curses in a scroll and wipe them off into the bitter water.
verses.hebrew: וְכָתַב אֶת־הָאָלֹת הָאֵלֶּה הַכֹּהֵן בַּסֵּפֶר וּמָחָה אֶל־מֵי הַמָּרִים׃

verses.english: He shall make the woman drink the bitter water that brings a curse, and the curse-bringing water shall enter her for bitterness.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁקָה אֶת־הָאִשָּׁה אֶת־מֵי הַמָּרִים הַמְאָרֲרִים וּבָאוּ בָהּ הַמַּיִם הַמְאָרֲרִים לְמָרִים׃

verses.english: The priest shall take the grain offering of jealousy from the woman’s hand, wave the grain offering before YHWH, and bring it near the altar.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִיַּד הָאִשָּׁה אֵת מִנְחַת הַקְּנָאֹת וְהֵנִיף אֶת־הַמִּנְחָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְהִקְרִיב אֹתָהּ אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

verses.english: The priest shall take a handful from the grain offering as its memorial portion and burn it on the altar. Afterward he shall make the woman drink the water.
verses.hebrew: וְקָמַץ הַכֹּהֵן מִן־הַמִּנְחָה אֶת־אַזְכָּרָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְאַחַר יַשְׁקֶה אֶת־הָאִשָּׁה אֶת־הַמָּיִם׃

verses.english: He shall make her drink the water. If she is defiled and has acted unfaithfully against her husband, the curse-bringing water shall enter her for bitterness; her belly shall swell and her thigh fall, and the woman shall become a curse among her people.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁקָהּ אֶת־הַמַּיִם וְהָיְתָה אִם־נִטְמְאָה וַתִּמְעֹל מַעַל בְּאִישָׁהּ וּבָאוּ בָהּ הַמַּיִם הַמְאָרֲרִים לְמָרִים וְצָבְתָה בִטְנָהּ וְנָפְלָה יְרֵכָהּ וְהָיְתָה הָאִשָּׁה לְאָלָה בְּקֶרֶב עַמָּהּ׃

verses.english: If the woman has not been defiled and is clean, she shall be free and shall be sown with seed.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא נִטְמְאָה הָאִשָּׁה וּטְהֹרָה הִוא וְנִקְּתָה וְנִזְרְעָה זָרַע׃

verses.english: This is the instruction for jealousy, when a wife strays while under her husband and becomes defiled,
verses.hebrew: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַקְּנָאֹת אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׂטֶה אִשָּׁה תַּחַת אִישָׁהּ וְנִטְמָאָה׃

verses.english: Or when a spirit of jealousy comes over a man and he is jealous of his wife. He shall stand the woman before YHWH, and the priest shall perform all this instruction for her.
verses.hebrew: אוֹ אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲבֹר עָלָיו רוּחַ קִנְאָה וְקִנֵּא אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ וְהֶעֱמִיד אֶת־הָאִשָּׁה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְעָשָׂה לָהּ הַכֹּהֵן אֵת כָּל־הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת׃

verses.english: The man shall be free from guilt, and that woman shall bear her guilt.
verses.hebrew: וְנִקָּה הָאִישׁ מֵעָוֺן וְהָאִשָּׁה הַהִוא תִּשָּׂא אֶת־עֲוֺנָהּ׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them: When a man or woman makes a special vow, a Nazirite vow of separation to YHWH,
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אִישׁ אוֹ־אִשָּׁה כִּי יַפְלִא לִנְדֹּר נֶדֶר נָזִיר לְהַזִּיר לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: They shall abstain from wine and strong drink. They shall not drink wine vinegar, strong-drink vinegar, or any grape infusion, and shall not eat fresh or dried grapes.
verses.hebrew: מִיַּיִן וְשֵׁכָר יַזִּיר חֹמֶץ יַיִן וְחֹמֶץ שֵׁכָר לֹא יִשְׁתֶּה וְכָל־מִשְׁרַת עֲנָבִים לֹא יִשְׁתֶּה וַעֲנָבִים לַחִים וִיבֵשִׁים לֹא יֹאכֵל׃

verses.english: Throughout the days of their separation, they shall eat nothing produced by the grapevine, from seed to skin.
verses.hebrew: כֹּל יְמֵי נִזְרוֹ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה מִגֶּפֶן הַיַּיִן מֵחַרְצַנִּים וְעַד־זָג לֹא יֹאכֵל׃

verses.english: Throughout the days of the vow of separation, no razor shall pass over their head. Until the days of separation to YHWH are fulfilled, they shall be holy, letting the locks of hair on their head grow.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־יְמֵי נֶדֶר נִזְרוֹ תַּעַר לֹא־יַעֲבֹר עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ עַד־מְלֹאת הַיָּמִם אֲשֶׁר־יַזִּיר לַיהוָה קָדֹשׁ יִהְיֶה גַּדֵּל פֶּרַע שְׂעַר רֹאשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: Throughout the days of separation to YHWH, they shall not approach a dead person.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־יְמֵי הַזִּירוֹ לַיהוָה עַל־נֶפֶשׁ מֵת לֹא יָבֹא׃

verses.english: They shall not make themselves unclean for their father, mother, brother, or sister when they die, because the consecration of their God is upon their head.
verses.hebrew: לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ לְאָחִיו וּלְאַחֹתוֹ לֹא־יִטַּמָּא לָהֶם בְּמֹתָם כִּי נֵזֶר אֱלֹהָיו עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: Throughout the days of their separation, they are holy to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: כֹּל יְמֵי נִזְרוֹ קָדֹשׁ הוּא לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: If someone dies very suddenly beside them and defiles their consecrated head, they shall shave their head on the day of cleansing; they shall shave it on the seventh day.
verses.hebrew: וְכִי־יָמוּת מֵת עָלָיו בְּפֶתַע פִּתְאֹם וְטִמֵּא רֹאשׁ נִזְרוֹ וְגִלַּח רֹאשׁוֹ בְּיוֹם טָהֳרָתוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי יְגַלְּחֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: On the eighth day they shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי יָבִא שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְּנֵי יוֹנָה אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן אֶל־פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: The priest shall offer one as a sin offering and one as a burnt offering, and make atonement for them concerning their sin in connection with the dead person. They shall consecrate their head that day.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה הַכֹּהֵן אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וְאֶחָד לְעֹלָה וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו מֵאֲשֶׁר חָטָא עַל־הַנָּפֶשׁ וְקִדַּשׁ אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

verses.english: They shall dedicate to YHWH the days of their separation and bring a year-old male lamb as a guilt offering. The former days shall fall away, because their separation was defiled.
verses.hebrew: וְהִזִּיר לַיהוָה אֶת־יְמֵי נִזְרוֹ וְהֵבִיא כֶּבֶשׂ בֶּן־שְׁנָתוֹ לְאָשָׁם וְהַיָּמִים הָרִאשֹׁנִים יִפְּלוּ כִּי טָמֵא נִזְרוֹ׃

verses.english: This is the instruction for the Nazirite: on the day the days of separation are fulfilled, the person shall be brought to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הַנָּזִיר בְּיוֹם מְלֹאת יְמֵי נִזְרוֹ יָבִיא אֹתוֹ אֶל־פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: They shall present their offering to YHWH: one unblemished year-old male lamb as a burnt offering, one unblemished year-old ewe lamb as a sin offering, and one unblemished ram for well-being offerings,
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב אֶת־קָרְבָּנוֹ לַיהוָה כֶּבֶשׂ בֶּן־שְׁנָתוֹ תָמִים אֶחָד לְעֹלָה וְכַבְשָׂה אַחַת בַּת־שְׁנָתָהּ תְּמִימָה לְחַטָּאת וְאַיִל־אֶחָד תָּמִים לִשְׁלָמִים׃

verses.english: A basket of unleavened bread of fine flour—cakes mixed with oil and unleavened wafers spread with oil—with their grain offering and drink offerings.
verses.hebrew: וְסַל מַצּוֹת סֹלֶת חַלֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּׁמֶן וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם׃

verses.english: The priest shall present them before YHWH and offer the person’s sin offering and burnt offering.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיב הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְעָשָׂה אֶת־חַטָּאתוֹ וְאֶת־עֹלָתוֹ׃

verses.english: He shall offer the ram as a well-being sacrifice to YHWH, with the basket of unleavened bread. The priest shall offer its grain offering and drink offering.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הָאַיִל יַעֲשֶׂה זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים לַיהוָה עַל סַל הַמַּצּוֹת וְעָשָׂה הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־מִנְחָתוֹ וְאֶת־נִסְכּוֹ׃

verses.english: The Nazirite shall shave the consecrated head at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, take the hair of the consecrated head, and put it on the fire under the well-being sacrifice.
verses.hebrew: וְגִלַּח הַנָּזִיר פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֶת־רֹאשׁ נִזְרוֹ וְלָקַח אֶת־שְׂעַר רֹאשׁ נִזְרוֹ וְנָתַן עַל־הָאֵשׁ אֲשֶׁר־תַּחַת זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים׃

verses.english: The priest shall take the boiled shoulder from the ram, one unleavened cake from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and put them on the Nazirite’s palms after the consecrated hair is shaved.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַזְּרֹעַ בְּשֵׁלָה מִן־הָאַיִל וְחַלַּת מַצָּה אַחַת מִן־הַסַּל וּרְקִיק מַצָּה אֶחָד וְנָתַן עַל־כַּפֵּי הַנָּזִיר אַחַר הִתְגַּלְּחוֹ אֶת־נִזְרוֹ׃

verses.english: The priest shall wave them as a wave offering before YHWH. They are holy for the priest, together with the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution. Afterward the Nazirite may drink wine.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵנִיף אוֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה קֹדֶשׁ הוּא לַכֹּהֵן עַל חֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וְעַל שׁוֹק הַתְּרוּמָה וְאַחַר יִשְׁתֶּה הַנָּזִיר יָיִן׃

verses.english: This is the instruction for the Nazirite who vows an offering to YHWH for the separation, besides whatever their hand can afford. According to the vow made, so they shall act, in addition to the instruction for their separation.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַנָּזִיר אֲשֶׁר יִדֹּר קָרְבָּנוֹ לַיהוָה עַל־נִזְרוֹ מִלְּבַד אֲשֶׁר־תַּשִּׂיג יָדוֹ כְּפִי נִדְרוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִדֹּר כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה עַל תּוֹרַת נִזְרוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to Aaron and his sons, saying: Thus you shall bless the sons of Israel; say to them:
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל־בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר כֹּה תְבָרֲכוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָמוֹר לָהֶם׃

verses.english: They shall put My name upon the sons of Israel, and I will bless them.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׂמוּ אֶת־שְׁמִי עַל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַאֲנִי אֲבָרֲכֵם׃

verses.english: May YHWH bless you and keep you.
verses.hebrew: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהוָה וְיִשְׁמְרֶךָ׃

verses.english: May YHWH make His face shine upon you and be gracious to you.
verses.hebrew: יָאֵר יְהוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וִיחֻנֶּךָּ׃

verses.english: May YHWH lift His face toward you and set peace for you.
verses.hebrew: יִשָּׂא יְהוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם׃

verses.english: On the day Moses finished setting up the Dwelling, he anointed and consecrated it and all its furnishings, the altar and all its utensils. He anointed and consecrated them.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּיוֹם כַּלּוֹת מֹשֶׁה לְהָקִים אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּן וַיִּמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָיו וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָיו וַיִּמְשָׁחֵם וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתָם׃

verses.english: The leaders of Israel, heads of their ancestral houses, presented offerings. They were the tribal leaders, the men standing over those registered.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרִיבוּ נְשִׂיאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאשֵׁי בֵּית אֲבֹתָם הֵם נְשִׂיאֵי הַמַּטֹּת הֵם הָעֹמְדִים עַל־הַפְּקֻדִים׃

verses.english: They brought their offering before YHWH: six covered wagons and twelve oxen, a wagon for every two leaders and an ox for each. They presented them before the Dwelling.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת־קָרְבָּנָם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה שֵׁשׁ־עֶגְלֹת צָב וּשְׁנֵי עָשָׂר בָּקָר עֲגָלָה עַל־שְׁנֵי הַנְּשִׂאִים וְשׁוֹר לְאֶחָד וַיַּקְרִיבוּ אוֹתָם לִפְנֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃

verses.english: YHWH said to Moses:
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Take these from them for the service of the Tent of Meeting. Give them to the Levites, each according to his service.
verses.hebrew: קַח מֵאִתָּם וְהָיוּ לַעֲבֹד אֶת־עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְנָתַתָּה אוֹתָם אֶל־הַלְוִיִּם אִישׁ כְּפִי עֲבֹדָתוֹ׃

verses.english: Moses took the wagons and oxen and gave them to the Levites.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת־הָעֲגָלֹת וְאֶת־הַבָּקָר וַיִּתֵּן אוֹתָם אֶל־הַלְוִיִּם׃

verses.english: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service.
verses.hebrew: אֵת שְׁתֵּי הָעֲגָלֹת וְאֵת אַרְבַּעַת הַבָּקָר נָתַן לִבְנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן כְּפִי עֲבֹדָתָם׃

verses.english: He gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת אַרְבַּע הָעֲגָלֹת וְאֵת שְׁמֹנַת הַבָּקָר נָתַן לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי כְּפִי עֲבֹדָתָם בְּיַד אִיתָמָר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: He gave none to the sons of Kohath, because the service of the holy things was upon them; they shall carry them on the shoulder.
verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי קְהָת לֹא נָתָן כִּי־עֲבֹדַת הַקֹּדֶשׁ עֲלֵהֶם בַּכָּתֵף יִשָּׂאוּ׃

verses.english: The leaders presented the dedication offering for the altar on the day it was anointed. The leaders presented their offering before the altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרִיבוּ הַנְּשִׂאִים אֵת חֲנֻכַּת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בְּיוֹם הִמָּשַׁח אֹתוֹ וַיַּקְרִיבוּ הַנְּשִׂיאִם אֶת־קָרְבָּנָם לִפְנֵי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

verses.english: YHWH said to Moses: One leader each day, one leader each day, shall present his offering for the dedication of the altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה נָשִׂיא אֶחָד לַיּוֹם נָשִׂיא אֶחָד לַיּוֹם יַקְרִיבוּ אֶת־קָרְבָּנָם לַחֲנֻכַּת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

verses.english: The one presenting his offering on the first day was Nahshon son of Amminadab, for the tribe of Judah.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַמַּקְרִיב בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן אֶת־קָרְבָּנוֹ נַחְשׁוֹן בֶּן־עַמִּינָדָב לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה׃

verses.english: His offering was one silver dish weighing one hundred thirty shekels and one silver basin of seventy sanctuary shekels, both full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering.

verses.hebrew: קָרְבָּנוֹ קַעֲרַת־כֶּסֶף אַחַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמֵאָה מִשְׁקָלָהּ מִזְרָק אֶחָד כֶּסֶף שִׁבְעִים שֶׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ שְׁנֵיהֶם מְלֵאִים סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לְמִנְחָה׃

verses.english: One gold ladle weighing ten shekels, full of incense;
verses.hebrew: כַּף אַחַת עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מְלֵאָה קְטֹרֶת׃

verses.english: One young bull, one ram, and one year-old male lamb for a burnt offering;
verses.hebrew: פַּר אֶחָד בֶּן־בָּקָר אַיִל אֶחָד כֶּבֶשׂ־אֶחָד בֶּן־שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָה׃

verses.english: One male goat for a sin offering;
verses.hebrew: שְׂעִיר־עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת׃

verses.english: For a well-being sacrifice: two cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five year-old lambs. This was the offering of Abidan son of Gideoni.
verses.hebrew: וּלְזֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים בָּקָר שְׁנַיִם אֵילִם חֲמִשָּׁה עַתֻּדִים חֲמִשָּׁה כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה חֲמִשָּׁה זֶה קָרְבַּן אֲבִידָן בֶּן־גִּדְעֹנִי׃

verses.english: On the tenth day: Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai, leader of the sons of Dan.
verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הָעֲשִׂירִי נָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי דָן אֲחִיעֶזֶר בֶּן־עַמִּישַׁדָּי׃

verses.hebrew: קָרְבָּנוֹ קַעֲרַת־כֶּסֶף אַחַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמֵאָה מִשְׁקָלָהּ מִזְרָק אֶחָד כֶּסֶף שִׁבְעִים שֶׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ שְׁנֵיהֶם מְלֵאִים סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לְמִנְחָה׃

verses.english: On the eleventh day: Pagiel son of Ocran, leader of the sons of Asher.
verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹם עַשְׁתֵּי עָשָׂר יוֹם נָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי אָשֵׁר פַּגְעִיאֵל בֶּן־עָכְרָן׃

verses.english: His offering was one silver dish weighing one hundred thirty shekels and one silver basin of seventy sanctuary shekels, both full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering.
verses.hebrew: קָרְבָּנוֹ קַעֲרַת־כֶּסֶף אַחַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמֵאָה מִשְׁקָלָהּ מִזְרָק אֶחָד כֶּסֶף שִׁבְעִים שֶׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ שְׁנֵיהֶם מְלֵאִים סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לְמִנְחָה׃

verses.hebrew: שְׂעִיר־עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת׃

verses.english: On the twelfth day: Ahira son of Enan, leader of the sons of Naphtali.
verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר יוֹם נָשִׂיא לִבְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי אֲחִירַע בֶּן־עֵינָן׃

verses.english: His offering was one silver dish weighing one hundred thirty shekels and one silver basin of seventy sanctuary shekels, both full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering.
verses.hebrew: קָרְבָּנוֹ קַעֲרַת־כֶּסֶף אַחַת שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמֵאָה מִשְׁקָלָהּ מִזְרָק אֶחָד כֶּסֶף שִׁבְעִים שֶׁקֶל בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ שְׁנֵיהֶם מְלֵאִים סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לְמִנְחָה׃

verses.hebrew: כַּף אַחַת עֲשָׂרָה זָהָב מְלֵאָה קְטֹרֶת׃

verses.hebrew: פַּר אֶחָד בֶּן־בָּקָר אַיִל אֶחָד כֶּבֶשׂ־אֶחָד בֶּן־שְׁנָתוֹ לְעֹלָה׃

verses.english: One male goat for a sin offering;
verses.hebrew: שְׂעִיר־עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת׃

verses.english: For a well-being sacrifice: two cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five year-old lambs. This was the offering of Ahira son of Enan.
verses.hebrew: וּלְזֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים בָּקָר שְׁנַיִם אֵילִם חֲמִשָּׁה עַתֻּדִים חֲמִשָּׁה כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה חֲמִשָּׁה זֶה קָרְבַּן אֲחִירַע בֶּן־עֵינָן׃

verses.english: This was the dedication offering for the altar from the leaders of Israel on the day it was anointed: twelve silver dishes, twelve silver basins, and twelve gold ladles,
verses.hebrew: זֹאת חֲנֻכַּת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ בְּיוֹם הִמָּשַׁח אֹתוֹ מֵאֵת נְשִׂיאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל קַעֲרֹת כֶּסֶף שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה מִזְרְקֵי־כֶסֶף שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר כַּפּוֹת זָהָב שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה׃

verses.english: Each silver dish weighed one hundred thirty shekels and each basin seventy. All the silver of the vessels was two thousand four hundred sanctuary shekels.
verses.hebrew: שְׁלֹשִׁים וּמֵאָה הַקְּעָרָה הָאַחַת כֶּסֶף וְשִׁבְעִים הַמִּזְרָק הָאֶחָד כֹּל כֶּסֶף הַכֵּלִים אַלְפַּיִם וְאַרְבַּע־מֵאוֹת בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: The twelve gold ladles were full of incense, each weighing ten sanctuary shekels. All the gold of the ladles was one hundred twenty shekels.
verses.hebrew: כַּפּוֹת זָהָב שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה מְלֵאֹת קְטֹרֶת עֲשָׂרָה עֲשָׂרָה הַכַּף בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ כָּל־זְהַב הַכַּפּוֹת עֶשְׂרִים וּמֵאָה׃

verses.english: All the cattle for the burnt offering were twelve bulls, with twelve rams and twelve year-old male lambs, and their grain offering; also twelve male goats for a sin offering.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַבָּקָר לָעֹלָה שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר פָּרִים אֵילִם שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר וּמִנְחָתָם וּשְׂעִירֵי עִזִּים שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר לְחַטָּאת׃

verses.english: All the cattle for the well-being sacrifice were twenty-four bulls, with sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty year-old lambs. This was the dedication offering for the altar after it was anointed.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל בְּקַר זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה פָּרִים אֵילִם שִׁשִּׁים עַתֻּדִים שִׁשִּׁים כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה שִׁשִּׁים זֹאת חֲנֻכַּת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ אַחֲרֵי הִמָּשַׁח אֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: When Moses entered the Tent of Meeting to speak with Him, he heard the voice speaking to him from above the atonement cover on the Ark of Testimony, from between the two cherubim. He spoke to him.
verses.hebrew: וּבְבֹא מֹשֶׁה אֶל־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ וַיִּשְׁמַע אֶת־הַקּוֹל מִדַּבֵּר אֵלָיו מֵעַל הַכַּפֹּרֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל־אֲרֹן הָעֵדֻת מִבֵּין שְׁנֵי הַכְּרֻבִים וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to Aaron and say to him: When you raise the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light toward the front of the lampstand.
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־אַהֲרֹן וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו בְּהַעֲלֹתְךָ אֶת־הַנֵּרֹת אֶל־מוּל פְּנֵי הַמְּנוֹרָה יָאִירוּ שִׁבְעַת הַנֵּרוֹת׃

verses.english: Aaron did so. He raised its lamps toward the front of the lampstand, as YHWH commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן אַהֲרֹן אֶל־מוּל פְּנֵי הַמְּנוֹרָה הֶעֱלָה נֵרֹתֶיהָ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: This was the workmanship of the lampstand: hammered gold, from its base to its flower-work, all hammered. According to the pattern YHWH showed Moses, so he made the lampstand.
verses.hebrew: וְזֶה מַעֲשֵׂה הַמְּנֹרָה מִקְשָׁה זָהָב עַד־יְרֵכָהּ עַד־פִּרְחָהּ מִקְשָׁה הִוא כַּמַּרְאֶה אֲשֶׁר הֶרְאָה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשָׂה אֶת־הַמְּנֹרָה׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Take the Levites from among the sons of Israel and cleanse them.
verses.hebrew: קַח אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְטִהַרְתָּ אֹתָם׃

verses.english: Do this to cleanse them: sprinkle purification water upon them, let them pass a razor over all their flesh, wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹה־תַעֲשֶׂה לָהֶם לְטַהֲרָם הַזֵּה עֲלֵיהֶם מֵי חַטָּאת וְהֶעֱבִירוּ תַעַר עַל־כָּל־בְּשָׂרָם וְכִבְּסוּ בִגְדֵיהֶם וְהִטֶּהָרוּ׃

verses.english: They shall take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you shall take a second young bull for a sin offering.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקְחוּ פַּר בֶּן־בָּקָר וּמִנְחָתוֹ סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן וּפַר־שֵׁנִי בֶן־בָּקָר תִּקַּח לְחַטָּאת׃

verses.english: Bring the Levites before the Tent of Meeting and assemble the whole congregation of the sons of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם לִפְנֵי אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהִקְהַלְתָּ אֶת־כָּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Bring the Levites before YHWH, and the sons of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְסָמְכוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־יְדֵיהֶם עַל־הַלְוִיִּם׃

verses.english: Aaron shall wave the Levites as a wave offering before YHWH from the sons of Israel, so that they may perform the service of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵנִיף אַהֲרֹן אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיוּ לַעֲבֹד אֶת־עֲבֹדַת יְהוָה׃

verses.english: The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls. Offer one as a sin offering and one as a burnt offering to YHWH, to make atonement for the Levites.
verses.hebrew: וְהַלְוִיִּם יִסְמְכוּ אֶת־יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הַפָּרִים וַעֲשֵׂה אֶת־הָאֶחָד חַטָּאת וְאֶת־הָאֶחָד עֹלָה לַיהוָה לְכַפֵּר עַל־הַלְוִיִּם׃

verses.english: Stand the Levites before Aaron and his sons, and wave them as a wave offering to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְהַעֲמַדְתָּ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם לִפְנֵי אַהֲרֹן וְלִפְנֵי בָנָיו וְהֵנַפְתָּ אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: Separate the Levites from among the sons of Israel, and the Levites shall be Mine.
verses.hebrew: וְהִבְדַּלְתָּ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיוּ לִי הַלְוִיִּם׃

verses.english: Afterward the Levites shall enter to serve the Tent of Meeting. You shall cleanse them and wave them as a wave offering.
verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן יָבֹאוּ הַלְוִיִּם לַעֲבֹד אֶת־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְטִהַרְתָּ אֹתָם וְהֵנַפְתָּ אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה׃

verses.english: For they are wholly given to Me from among the sons of Israel. In place of those opening every womb, every firstborn among the sons of Israel, I have taken them for Myself.
verses.hebrew: כִּי נְתֻנִים נְתֻנִים הֵמָּה לִי מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תַּחַת פִּטְרַת כָּל־רֶחֶם בְּכוֹר כֹּל מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָקַחְתִּי אֹתָם לִי׃

verses.english: For every firstborn among the sons of Israel is Mine, human and livestock alike. On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated them to Myself.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לִי כָל־בְּכוֹר בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה בְּיוֹם הַכֹּתִי כָל־בְּכוֹר בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם הִקְדַּשְׁתִּי אֹתָם לִי׃

verses.english: I took the Levites in place of every firstborn among the sons of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶקַּח אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם תַּחַת כָּל־בְּכוֹר בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: I gave the Levites as gifts to Aaron and his sons from among the sons of Israel, to perform the service of the sons of Israel in the Tent of Meeting and make atonement for the sons of Israel, so that no plague should fall among the sons of Israel when they approach the sanctuary.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶתְּנָה אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם נְתֻנִים לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו מִתּוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲבֹד אֶת־עֲבֹדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּלְכַפֵּר עַל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא יִהְיֶה בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶגֶף בְּגֶשֶׁת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of the sons of Israel did for the Levites everything that YHWH commanded Moses concerning the Levites. So the sons of Israel did for them.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וְכָל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַלְוִיִּם כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה לַלְוִיִּם כֵּן־עָשׂוּ לָהֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes. Aaron waved them as a wave offering before YHWH, and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְחַטְּאוּ הַלְוִיִּם וַיְכַבְּסוּ בִּגְדֵיהֶם וַיָּנֶף אַהֲרֹן אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וַיְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיהֶם אַהֲרֹן לְטַהֲרָם׃

verses.english: Afterward the Levites entered to perform their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron and his sons. As YHWH commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did for them.
verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן בָּאוּ הַלְוִיִּם לַעֲבֹד אֶת־עֲבֹדָתָם בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי אַהֲרֹן וְלִפְנֵי בָנָיו כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה עַל־הַלְוִיִּם כֵּן עָשׂוּ לָהֶם׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: This applies to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward, they shall enter the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת אֲשֶׁר לַלְוִיִּם מִבֶּן חָמֵשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה יָבוֹא לִצְבֹא צָבָא בַּעֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: From fifty years old, they shall withdraw from the service of the work and shall work no longer.
verses.hebrew: וּמִבֶּן חֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה יָשׁוּב מִצְּבָא הָעֲבֹדָה וְלֹא יַעֲבֹד עוֹד׃

verses.english: They may assist their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, keeping charge, but shall perform no work. Thus you shall deal with the Levites in their charges.
verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁרֵת אֶת־אֶחָיו בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִשְׁמֹר מִשְׁמֶרֶת וַעֲבֹדָה לֹא יַעֲבֹד כָּכָה תַּעֲשֶׂה לַלְוִיִּם בְּמִשְׁמְרֹתָם׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the second year after they came out of the land of Egypt, in the first month, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה בְמִדְבַּר־סִינַי בַּשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית לְצֵאתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: The sons of Israel shall observe the Passover at its appointed time.
verses.hebrew: וְיַעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַפָּסַח בְּמוֹעֲדוֹ׃

verses.english: On the fourteenth day of this month, between the evenings, you shall observe it at its appointed time. You shall observe it according to all its statutes and ordinances.
verses.hebrew: בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר־יוֹם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה בֵּין הָעֲרְבַּיִם תַּעֲשׂוּ אֹתוֹ בְּמוֹעֲדוֹ כְּכָל־חֻקֹּתָיו וּכְכָל־מִשְׁפָּטָיו תַּעֲשׂוּ אֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: Moses told the sons of Israel to observe the Passover.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשֹׂת הַפָּסַח׃

verses.english: They observed the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, between the evenings, in the wilderness of Sinai. As YHWH commanded Moses, so the sons of Israel did.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת־הַפֶּסַח בָּרִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: There were men unclean through a dead person who could not observe the Passover that day. They came before Moses and Aaron that day.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ טְמֵאִים לְנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם וְלֹא־יָכְלוּ לַעֲשֹׂת־הַפֶּסַח בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּקְרְבוּ לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וְלִפְנֵי אַהֲרֹן בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא׃

verses.english: Those men said to him: We are unclean through a dead person. Why should we be kept back from presenting YHWH’s offering at its appointed time among the sons of Israel?
