verses.english: All the contributions of the holy things that the sons of Israel contribute to YHWH I have given to you, your sons, and your daughters with you as a perpetual statute. It is a perpetual covenant of salt before YHWH for you and your offspring with you.
verses.hebrew: כֹּל תְּרוּמֹת הַקֳּדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר יָרִימוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַיהוָה נָתַתִּי לְךָ וּלְבָנֶיךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶיךָ אִתְּךָ לְחָק־עוֹלָם בְּרִית מֶלַח עוֹלָם הִוא לִפְנֵי יְהוָה לְךָ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אִתָּךְ׃

verses.english: YHWH said to Aaron: You shall have no inheritance in their land, and no share among them. I am your share and your inheritance among the sons of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־אַהֲרֹן בְּאַרְצָם לֹא תִנְחָל וְחֵלֶק לֹא־יִהְיֶה לְךָ בְּתוֹכָם אֲנִי חֶלְקְךָ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: To the sons of Levi, look, I have given every tithe in Israel as an inheritance in return for the service they perform, the service of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְלִבְנֵי לֵוִי הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי כָּל־מַעֲשֵׂר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל לְנַחֲלָה חֵלֶף עֲבֹדָתָם אֲשֶׁר־הֵם עֹבְדִים אֶת־עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: The sons of Israel shall no longer approach the Tent of Meeting, incurring sin and dying.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יִקְרְבוּ עוֹד בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לָשֵׂאת חֵטְא לָמוּת׃

verses.english: The Levite himself shall perform the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their guilt. It is a perpetual statute throughout your generations. Among the sons of Israel they shall receive no inheritance.
verses.hebrew: וְעָבַד הַלֵּוִי הוּא אֶת־עֲבֹדַת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְהֵם יִשְׂאוּ עֲוֺנָם חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם וּבְתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יִנְחֲלוּ נַחֲלָה׃

verses.english: For the tithes of the sons of Israel that they contribute to YHWH as a contribution I have given to the Levites as an inheritance. Therefore I have said of them: Among the sons of Israel they shall receive no inheritance.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶת־מַעְשַׂר בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יָרִימוּ לַיהוָה תְּרוּמָה נָתַתִּי לַלְוִיִּם לְנַחֲלָה עַל־כֵּן אָמַרְתִּי לָהֶם בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא יִנְחֲלוּ נַחֲלָה׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Speak to the Levites and say to them: When you receive from the sons of Israel the tithe that I have given you from them as your inheritance, you shall contribute from it a contribution to YHWH, a tithe of the tithe.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־הַלְוִיִּם תְּדַבֵּר וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי־תִקְחוּ מֵאֵת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַמַּעֲשֵׂר אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לָכֶם מֵאִתָּם בְּנַחֲלַתְכֶם וַהֲרֵמֹתֶם מִמֶּנּוּ תְּרוּמַת יְהוָה מַעֲשֵׂר מִן־הַמַּעֲשֵׂר׃

verses.english: Your contribution shall be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing floor and as the full yield from the winepress.
verses.hebrew: וְנֶחְשַׁב לָכֶם תְּרוּמַתְכֶם כַּדָּגָן מִן־הַגֹּרֶן וְכַמְלֵאָה מִן־הַיָּקֶב׃

verses.english: Thus you also shall contribute a contribution to YHWH from all your tithes that you receive from the sons of Israel; from them you shall give YHWH's contribution to Aaron the priest.
verses.hebrew: כֵּן תָּרִימוּ גַם־אַתֶּם תְּרוּמַת יְהוָה מִכֹּל מַעְשְׂרֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר תִּקְחוּ מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּנְתַתֶּם מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת־תְּרוּמַת יְהוָה לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: From all your gifts you shall contribute every contribution due to YHWH, from all its best, the holy portion from it.
verses.hebrew: מִכֹּל מַתְּנֹתֵיכֶם תָּרִימוּ אֵת כָּל־תְּרוּמַת יְהוָה מִכָּל־חֶלְבּוֹ אֶת־מִקְדְּשׁוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ׃

verses.english: Say to them: When you contribute the best from it, the remainder shall be reckoned to the Levites as the produce of the threshing floor and the produce of the winepress.
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם בַּהֲרִימְכֶם אֶת־חֶלְבּוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ וְנֶחְשַׁב לַלְוִיִּם כִּתְבוּאַת גֹּרֶן וְכִתְבוּאַת יָקֶב׃

verses.english: You and your households may eat it in any place, for it is your wages in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם אֹתוֹ בְּכָל־מָקוֹם אַתֶּם וּבֵיתְכֶם כִּי־שָׂכָר הוּא לָכֶם חֵלֶף עֲבֹדַתְכֶם בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: You shall incur no sin through it when you contribute the best from it. You shall not profane the holy things of the sons of Israel, and you shall not die.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־תִשְׂאוּ עָלָיו חֵטְא בַּהֲרִימְכֶם אֶת־חֶלְבּוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ וְאֶת־קָדְשֵׁי בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא תְחַלְּלוּ וְלֹא תָמוּתוּ׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל־אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: This is the statute of the instruction that YHWH has commanded: Speak to the sons of Israel, and let them bring you a red cow, sound and without defect, on which no yoke has been laid.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת חֻקַּת הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוָה לֵאמֹר דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִקְחוּ אֵלֶיךָ פָרָה אֲדֻמָּה תְּמִימָה אֲשֶׁר אֵין־בָּהּ מוּם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָלָה עָלֶיהָ עֹל׃

verses.english: You shall give it to Eleazar the priest. It shall be taken outside the camp and slaughtered before him.
verses.hebrew: וּנְתַתֶּם אֹתָהּ אֶל־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְהוֹצִיא אֹתָהּ אֶל־מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְשָׁחַט אֹתָהּ לְפָנָיו׃

verses.english: Eleazar the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger and sprinkle some of its blood seven times toward the front of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן מִדָּמָהּ בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ וְהִזָּה אֶל־נֹכַח פְּנֵי אֹהֶל־מוֹעֵד מִדָּמָהּ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים׃

verses.english: The cow shall be burned before his eyes: its skin, flesh, and blood, together with its dung, shall be burned.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׂרַף אֶת־הַפָּרָה לְעֵינָיו אֶת־עֹרָהּ וְאֶת־בְּשָׂרָהּ וְאֶת־דָּמָהּ עַל־פִּרְשָׁהּ יִשְׂרֹף׃

verses.english: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet material and throw them into the burning cow.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן עֵץ אֶרֶז וְאֵזוֹב וּשְׁנִי תוֹלָעַת וְהִשְׁלִיךְ אֶל־תּוֹךְ שְׂרֵפַת הַפָּרָה׃

verses.english: The priest shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water. Afterward he may enter the camp, but the priest shall be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו הַכֹּהֵן וְרָחַץ בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמַּיִם וְאַחַר יָבוֹא אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וְטָמֵא הַכֹּהֵן עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: The one who burns it shall wash his clothes in water and bathe his body in water, and he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְהַשֹּׂרֵף אֹתָהּ יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו בַּמַּיִם וְרָחַץ בְּשָׂרוֹ בַּמָּיִם וְטָמֵא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: A clean man shall gather the cow's ashes and deposit them outside the camp in a clean place. They shall be kept for the congregation of the sons of Israel, for water for impurity; it is a purification offering.
verses.hebrew: וְאָסַף אִישׁ טָהוֹר אֵת אֵפֶר הַפָּרָה וְהִנִּיחַ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה בְּמָקוֹם טָהוֹר וְהָיְתָה לַעֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמִשְׁמֶרֶת לְמֵי נִדָּה חַטָּאת הִוא׃

verses.english: The one who gathers the cow's ashes shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening. This shall be a perpetual statute for the sons of Israel and the resident alien living among them.
verses.hebrew: וְכִבֶּס הָאֹסֵף אֶת־אֵפֶר הַפָּרָה אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וְטָמֵא עַד־הָעָרֶב וְהָיְתָה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: Whoever touches a dead person, any human corpse, shall be unclean for seven days.
verses.hebrew: הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּמֵת לְכָל־נֶפֶשׁ אָדָם וְטָמֵא שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

verses.english: That person shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean. If he does not purify himself on the third day, he shall not be clean on the seventh day.
verses.hebrew: הוּא יִתְחַטָּא־בוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי יִטְהָר וְאִם־לֹא יִתְחַטָּא בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי לֹא יִטְהָר׃

verses.english: Whoever touches a corpse, the body of a person who has died, and does not purify himself defiles YHWH's Dwelling. That person shall be cut off from Israel. Because water for impurity was not dashed over him, he remains unclean; his uncleanness is still in him.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַנֹּגֵעַ בְּמֵת בְּנֶפֶשׁ הָאָדָם אֲשֶׁר־יָמוּת וְלֹא יִתְחַטָּא אֶת־מִשְׁכַּן יְהוָה טִמֵּא וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל כִּי מֵי נִדָּה לֹא־זֹרַק עָלָיו טָמֵא יִהְיֶה עוֹד טֻמְאָתוֹ בוֹ׃

verses.english: This is the instruction: When a person dies in a tent, everyone who enters the tent and everything in the tent shall be unclean for seven days.
verses.hebrew: זֹאת הַתּוֹרָה אָדָם כִּי־יָמוּת בְּאֹהֶל כָּל־הַבָּא אֶל־הָאֹהֶל וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר בָּאֹהֶל יִטְמָא שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

verses.english: Every open vessel without a tied covering upon it is unclean.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל כְּלִי פָתוּחַ אֲשֶׁר אֵין־צָמִיד פָּתִיל עָלָיו טָמֵא הוּא׃

verses.english: Anyone who touches, in the open field, someone killed by a sword, a corpse, a human bone, or a grave shall be unclean for seven days.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּע עַל־פְּנֵי הַשָּׂדֶה בַּחֲלַל־חֶרֶב אוֹ בְמֵת אוֹ־בְעֶצֶם אָדָם אוֹ בְקָבֶר יִטְמָא שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

verses.english: For the unclean person they shall take some ashes from the burned purification offering, and fresh water shall be put over them in a vessel.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקְחוּ לַטָּמֵא מֵעֲפַר שְׂרֵפַת הַחַטָּאת וְנָתַן עָלָיו מַיִם חַיִּים אֶל־כֶּלִי׃

verses.english: A clean man shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, all the vessels, and the people who were there, and on whoever touched the bone, the slain person, the corpse, or the grave.
verses.hebrew: וְלָקַח אֵזוֹב וְטָבַל בַּמַּיִם אִישׁ טָהוֹר וְהִזָּה עַל־הָאֹהֶל וְעַל־כָּל־הַכֵּלִים וְעַל־הַנְּפָשׁוֹת אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ־שָׁם וְעַל־הַנֹּגֵעַ בַּעֶצֶם אוֹ בֶחָלָל אוֹ בַמֵּת אוֹ בַקָּבֶר׃

verses.english: The clean person shall sprinkle the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day, and purify him on the seventh day. He shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and he shall be clean at evening.
verses.hebrew: וְהִזָּה הַטָּהֹר עַל־הַטָּמֵא בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְחִטְּאוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וְכִבֶּס בְּגָדָיו וְרָחַץ בַּמַּיִם וְטָהֵר בָּעָרֶב׃

verses.english: A person who becomes unclean and does not purify himself shall be cut off from the assembly, because he has defiled YHWH's sanctuary. Water for impurity has not been dashed over him; he is unclean.
verses.hebrew: וְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִטְמָא וְלֹא יִתְחַטָּא וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִתּוֹךְ הַקָּהָל כִּי אֶת־מִקְדַּשׁ יְהוָה טִמֵּא מֵי נִדָּה לֹא־זֹרַק עָלָיו טָמֵא הוּא׃

verses.english: This shall be a perpetual statute for them. The one who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and whoever touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה לָּהֶם לְחֻקַּת עוֹלָם וּמַזֵּה מֵי־הַנִּדָּה יְכַבֵּס בְּגָדָיו וְהַנֹּגֵעַ בְּמֵי הַנִּדָּה יִטְמָא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean, and the person who touches it shall be unclean until evening.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּע־בּוֹ הַטָּמֵא יִטְמָא וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ הַנֹּגַעַת תִּטְמָא עַד־הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: The sons of Israel, the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the people stayed at Kadesh. Miriam died there and was buried there.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּל־הָעֵדָה מִדְבַּר־צִן בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן וַיֵּשֶׁב הָעָם בְּקָדֵשׁ וַתָּמָת שָׁם מִרְיָם וַתִּקָּבֵר שָׁם׃

verses.english: There was no water for the congregation, and they assembled against Moses and Aaron.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־הָיָה מַיִם לָעֵדָה וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ עַל־מֹשֶׁה וְעַל־אַהֲרֹן׃

verses.english: The people quarreled with Moses and said: If only we had perished when our brothers perished before YHWH!
verses.hebrew: וַיָּרֶב הָעָם עִם־מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֵאמֹר וְלוּ גָוַעְנוּ בִּגְוַע אַחֵינוּ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Why have you brought YHWH's assembly into this wilderness for us and our livestock to die here?
verses.hebrew: וְלָמָה הֲבֵאתֶם אֶת־קְהַל יְהוָה אֶל־הַמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה לָמוּת שָׁם אֲנַחְנוּ וּבְעִירֵנוּ׃

verses.english: Why have you brought us up from Egypt to bring us to this wretched place? It is no place for seed, figs, vines, or pomegranates, and there is no water to drink.
verses.hebrew: וְלָמָה הֶעֱלִיתֻנוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם לְהָבִיא אֹתָנוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם הָרָע הַזֶּה לֹא מְקוֹם זֶרַע וּתְאֵנָה וְגֶפֶן וְרִמּוֹן וּמַיִם אַיִן לִשְׁתּוֹת׃

verses.english: Moses and Aaron went away from the assembly to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting and fell on their faces. YHWH's glory appeared to them.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן מִפְּנֵי הַקָּהָל אֶל־פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם וַיֵּרָא כְבוֹד־יְהוָה אֲלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Take the staff and assemble the congregation, you and your brother Aaron. Speak to the rock before their eyes, and it shall give its water. You shall bring water out of the rock for them and give the congregation and their livestock water to drink.
verses.hebrew: קַח אֶת־הַמַּטֶּה וְהַקְהֵל אֶת־הָעֵדָה אַתָּה וְאַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ וְדִבַּרְתֶּם אֶל־הַסֶּלַע לְעֵינֵיהֶם וְנָתַן מֵימָיו וְהוֹצֵאתָ לָהֶם מַיִם מִן־הַסֶּלַע וְהִשְׁקִיתָ אֶת־הָעֵדָה וְאֶת־בְּעִירָם׃

verses.english: Moses took the staff from before YHWH, as He had commanded him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת־הַמַּטֶּה מִלִּפְנֵי יְהוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּהוּ׃

verses.english: Moses and Aaron assembled the congregation before the rock. He said to them: Listen now, you rebels! Shall we bring water out of this rock for you?
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְהִלוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן אֶת־הַקָּהָל אֶל־פְּנֵי הַסָּלַע וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְעוּ־נָא הַמֹּרִים הֲמִן־הַסֶּלַע הַזֶּה נוֹצִיא לָכֶם מָיִם׃

verses.english: Moses raised his hand and struck the rock twice with his staff. Abundant water came out, and the congregation and their livestock drank.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּרֶם מֹשֶׁה אֶת־יָדוֹ וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַסֶּלַע בְּמַטֵּהוּ פַּעֲמָיִם וַיֵּצְאוּ מַיִם רַבִּים וַתֵּשְׁתְּ הָעֵדָה וּבְעִירָם׃

verses.english: YHWH said to Moses and Aaron: Because you did not trust Me to show Me holy before the eyes of the sons of Israel, you shall not bring this assembly into the land that I have given them.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל־אַהֲרֹן יַעַן לֹא־הֶאֱמַנְתֶּם בִּי לְהַקְדִּישֵׁנִי לְעֵינֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לָכֵן לֹא תָבִיאוּ אֶת־הַקָּהָל הַזֶּה אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַתִּי לָהֶם׃

verses.english: These are the waters of Meribah, where the sons of Israel quarreled with YHWH, and He showed Himself holy among them.
verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה מֵי מְרִיבָה אֲשֶׁר־רָבוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־יְהוָה וַיִּקָּדֵשׁ בָּם׃

verses.english: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom: Thus says your brother Israel: You know all the hardship that has overtaken us.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֹשֶׁה מַלְאָכִים מִקָּדֵשׁ אֶל־מֶלֶךְ אֱדוֹם כֹּה אָמַר אָחִיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ אֵת כָּל־הַתְּלָאָה אֲשֶׁר מְצָאָתְנוּ׃

verses.english: Our fathers went down to Egypt, and we lived in Egypt many days. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרְדוּ אֲבֹתֵינוּ מִצְרַיְמָה וַנֵּשֶׁב בְּמִצְרַיִם יָמִים רַבִּים וַיָּרֵעוּ לָנוּ מִצְרַיִם וְלַאֲבֹתֵינוּ׃

verses.english: We cried out to YHWH, and He heard our voice, sent a messenger, and brought us out of Egypt. Look, we are at Kadesh, a town on the edge of your territory.
verses.hebrew: וַנִּצְעַק אֶל־יְהוָה וַיִּשְׁמַע קֹלֵנוּ וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָךְ וַיֹּצִאֵנוּ מִמִּצְרָיִם וְהִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ בְקָדֵשׁ עִיר קְצֵה גְבוּלֶךָ׃

verses.english: Please let us pass through your land. We will not cross fields or vineyards or drink well water. We will travel the King's Highway and turn neither right nor left until we have passed through your territory.
verses.hebrew: נַעְבְּרָה־נָּא בְאַרְצֶךָ לֹא נַעֲבֹר בְּשָׂדֶה וּבְכֶרֶם וְלֹא נִשְׁתֶּה מֵי בְאֵר דֶּרֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ נֵלֵךְ לֹא נִטֶּה יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול עַד אֲשֶׁר־נַעֲבֹר גְּבוּלֶךָ׃

verses.english: Edom said to him: You shall not pass through me, or I will come out against you with the sword.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֱדוֹם לֹא תַעֲבֹר בִּי פֶּן־בַּחֶרֶב אֵצֵא לִקְרָאתֶךָ׃

verses.english: The sons of Israel said to him: We will go up by the highway. If I and my livestock drink your water, I will pay its price. It is only a small matter; let me pass through on foot.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמְסִלָּה נַעֲלֶה וְאִם־מֵימֶיךָ נִשְׁתֶּה אֲנִי וּמִקְנַי וְנָתַתִּי מִכְרָם רַק אֵין־דָּבָר בְּרַגְלַי אֶעֱבֹרָה׃

verses.english: He said: You shall not pass through. Edom came out against him with a large force and a strong hand.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא תַעֲבֹר וַיֵּצֵא אֱדוֹם לִקְרָאתוֹ בְּעַם כָּבֵד וּבְיָד חֲזָקָה׃

verses.english: Edom refused to allow Israel to pass through his territory, so Israel turned away from him.
verses.hebrew: וַיְמָאֵן אֱדוֹם נְתֹן אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבֹר בִּגְבֻלוֹ וַיֵּט יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעָלָיו׃

verses.english: They set out from Kadesh, and the sons of Israel, the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִקָּדֵשׁ וַיָּבֹאוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּל־הָעֵדָה הֹר הָהָר׃

verses.english: YHWH said to Moses and Aaron at Mount Hor, on the border of the land of Edom:
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל־אַהֲרֹן בְּהֹר הָהָר עַל־גְּבוּל אֶרֶץ־אֱדוֹם לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Aaron shall be gathered to his people, for he shall not enter the land that I have given to the sons of Israel, because you rebelled against My command at the waters of Meribah.
verses.hebrew: יֵאָסֵף אַהֲרֹן אֶל־עַמָּיו כִּי לֹא יָבֹא אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל אֲשֶׁר־מְרִיתֶם אֶת־פִּי לְמֵי מְרִיבָה׃

verses.english: Take Aaron and his son Eleazar and bring them up Mount Hor.
verses.hebrew: קַח אֶת־אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת־אֶלְעָזָר בְּנוֹ וְהַעַל אֹתָם הֹר הָהָר׃

verses.english: Strip Aaron of his garments and put them on his son Eleazar. Aaron shall be gathered to his people and die there.
verses.hebrew: וְהַפְשֵׁט אֶת־אַהֲרֹן אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּם אֶת־אֶלְעָזָר בְּנוֹ וְאַהֲרֹן יֵאָסֵף וּמֵת שָׁם׃

verses.english: Moses did as YHWH commanded, and they went up Mount Hor before the eyes of the whole congregation.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶל־הֹר הָהָר לְעֵינֵי כָּל־הָעֵדָה׃

verses.english: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments and put them on his son Eleazar. Aaron died there on the summit of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּפְשֵׁט מֹשֶׁה אֶת־אַהֲרֹן אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתָם אֶת־אֶלְעָזָר בְּנוֹ וַיָּמָת אַהֲרֹן שָׁם בְּרֹאשׁ הָהָר וַיֵּרֶד מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר מִן־הָהָר׃

verses.english: The whole congregation saw that Aaron had died, and all the house of Israel wept for Aaron thirty days.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ כָּל־הָעֵדָה כִּי גָוַע אַהֲרֹן וַיִּבְכּוּ אֶת־אַהֲרֹן שְׁלֹשִׁים יוֹם כֹּל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negeb, heard that Israel was coming by the road of Atharim. He fought Israel and took some of them captive.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע הַכְּנַעֲנִי מֶלֶךְ־עֲרָד יֹשֵׁב הַנֶּגֶב כִּי בָּא יִשְׂרָאֵל דֶּרֶךְ הָאֲתָרִים וַיִּלָּחֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׁבְּ מִמֶּנּוּ שֶׁבִי׃

verses.english: Israel vowed a vow to YHWH: If You indeed give this people into my hand, I will devote their towns to destruction.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּדַּר יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶדֶר לַיהוָה וַיֹּאמַר אִם־נָתֹן תִּתֵּן אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה בְּיָדִי וְהַחֲרַמְתִּי אֶת־עָרֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: YHWH heard Israel's voice and gave up the Canaanites. Israel devoted them and their towns to destruction and called the place Hormah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע יְהוָה בְּקוֹל יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתֵּן אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי וַיַּחֲרֵם אֶתְהֶם וְאֶת־עָרֵיהֶם וַיִּקְרָא שֵׁם־הַמָּקוֹם חָרְמָה׃

verses.english: They set out from Mount Hor by the road to the Sea of Reeds to go around the land of Edom. The people grew impatient on the journey.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהֹר הָהָר דֶּרֶךְ יַם־סוּף לִסְבֹב אֶת־אֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם וַתִּקְצַר נֶפֶשׁ־הָעָם בַּדָּרֶךְ׃

verses.english: The people spoke against God and Moses: Why have you brought us up from Egypt to die in the wilderness? There is no bread and no water, and we loathe this miserable bread.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר הָעָם בֵּאלֹהִים וּבְמֹשֶׁה לָמָה הֶעֱלִיתֻנוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם לָמוּת בַּמִּדְבָּר כִּי אֵין לֶחֶם וְאֵין מַיִם וְנַפְשֵׁנוּ קָצָה בַּלֶּחֶם הַקְּלֹקֵל׃

verses.english: YHWH sent fiery serpents among the people. They bit the people, and many people of Israel died.
verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהוָה בָּעָם אֵת הַנְּחָשִׁים הַשְּׂרָפִים וַיְנַשְּׁכוּ אֶת־הָעָם וַיָּמָת עַם־רָב מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: The people came to Moses and said: We have sinned by speaking against YHWH and against you. Pray to YHWH that He remove the serpents from us. Moses prayed for the people.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא הָעָם אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמְרוּ חָטָאנוּ כִּי־דִבַּרְנוּ בַיהוָה וָבָךְ הִתְפַּלֵּל אֶל־יְהוָה וְיָסֵר מֵעָלֵינוּ אֶת־הַנָּחָשׁ וַיִּתְפַּלֵּל מֹשֶׁה בְּעַד הָעָם׃

verses.english: YHWH said to Moses: Make yourself a fiery serpent and put it on a standard. Everyone who is bitten shall look at it and live.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה עֲשֵׂה לְךָ שָׂרָף וְשִׂים אֹתוֹ עַל־נֵס וְהָיָה כָּל־הַנָּשׁוּךְ וְרָאָה אֹתוֹ וָחָי׃

verses.english: Moses made a bronze serpent and put it on the standard. Whenever a serpent bit someone, that person looked at the bronze serpent and lived.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה נְחַשׁ נְחֹשֶׁת וַיְשִׂמֵהוּ עַל־הַנֵּס וְהָיָה אִם־נָשַׁךְ הַנָּחָשׁ אֶת־אִישׁ וְהִבִּיט אֶל־נְחַשׁ הַנְּחֹשֶׁת וָחָי׃

verses.english: The sons of Israel set out and camped at Oboth.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּאֹבֹת׃

verses.english: They set out from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim, in the wilderness opposite Moab toward the sunrise.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֹבֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעִיֵּי הָעֲבָרִים בַּמִּדְבָּר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי מוֹאָב מִמִּזְרַח הַשָּׁמֶשׁ׃

verses.english: From there they set out and camped in the wadi of Zered.
verses.hebrew: מִשָּׁם נָסָעוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּנַחַל זָרֶד׃

verses.english: From there they set out and camped beyond the Arnon, in the wilderness extending from the Amorite border. The Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
verses.hebrew: מִשָּׁם נָסָעוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ מֵעֵבֶר אַרְנוֹן אֲשֶׁר בַּמִּדְבָּר הַיֹּצֵא מִגְּבוּל הָאֱמֹרִי כִּי אַרְנוֹן גְּבוּל מוֹאָב בֵּין מוֹאָב וּבֵין הָאֱמֹרִי׃

verses.english: Therefore it is said in the Book of the Wars of YHWH: Waheb in Suphah, and the wadis of the Arnon,
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן יֵאָמַר בְּסֵפֶר מִלְחֲמֹת יְהוָה אֶת־וָהֵב בְּסוּפָה וְאֶת־הַנְּחָלִים אַרְנוֹן׃

verses.english: and the slope of the wadis that stretches toward the settlement of Ar and rests against the border of Moab.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶשֶׁד הַנְּחָלִים אֲשֶׁר נָטָה לְשֶׁבֶת עָר וְנִשְׁעַן לִגְבוּל מוֹאָב׃

verses.english: From there they went to Beer. This is the well of which YHWH said to Moses: Gather the people, and I will give them water.
verses.hebrew: וּמִשָּׁם בְּאֵרָה הִוא הַבְּאֵר אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהוָה לְמֹשֶׁה אֱסֹף אֶת־הָעָם וְאֶתְּנָה לָהֶם מָיִם׃

verses.english: Then Israel sang this song: Spring up, O well! Sing to it!
verses.hebrew: אָז יָשִׁיר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת עֲלִי בְאֵר עֱנוּ־לָהּ׃

verses.english: The well that rulers dug, that the nobles of the people excavated with the ruler's staff, with their staffs. From the wilderness they went to Mattanah.
verses.hebrew: בְּאֵר חֲפָרוּהָ שָׂרִים כָּרוּהָ נְדִיבֵי הָעָם בִּמְחֹקֵק בְּמִשְׁעֲנֹתָם וּמִמִּדְבָּר מַתָּנָה׃

verses.english: From Mattanah they went to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to Bamoth.
verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּתָּנָה נַחֲלִיאֵל וּמִנַּחֲלִיאֵל בָּמוֹת׃

verses.english: From Bamoth they went to the valley in the territory of Moab, at the summit of Pisgah overlooking the wasteland.
verses.hebrew: וּמִבָּמוֹת הַגַּיְא אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂדֵה מוֹאָב רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה וְנִשְׁקָפָה עַל־פְּנֵי הַיְשִׁימֹן׃

verses.english: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלְאָכִים אֶל־סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ־הָאֱמֹרִי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Let me pass through your land. We will not turn aside into fields or vineyards or drink well water. We will travel the King's Highway until we have passed through your territory.
verses.hebrew: אֶעְבְּרָה בְאַרְצֶךָ לֹא נִטֶּה בְּשָׂדֶה וּבְכֶרֶם לֹא נִשְׁתֶּה מֵי בְאֵר בְּדֶרֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ נֵלֵךְ עַד אֲשֶׁר־נַעֲבֹר גְּבֻלֶךָ׃

verses.english: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his territory. He gathered all his people and went out against Israel in the wilderness. He came to Jahaz and fought Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־נָתַן סִיחֹן אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבֹר בִּגְבֻלוֹ וַיֶּאֱסֹף סִיחֹן אֶת־כָּל־עַמּוֹ וַיֵּצֵא לִקְרַאת יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּדְבָּרָה וַיָּבֹא יָהְצָה וַיִּלָּחֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, as far as the sons of Ammon, because the border of the sons of Ammon was strong.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּהוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְפִי־חָרֶב וַיִּירַשׁ אֶת־אַרְצוֹ מֵאַרְנֹן עַד־יַבֹּק עַד־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן כִּי עַז גְּבוּל בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

verses.english: Israel took all these towns and settled in all the Amorite towns, in Heshbon and all its dependent villages.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כָּל־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל־עָרֵי הָאֱמֹרִי בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן וּבְכָל־בְּנֹתֶיהָ׃

verses.english: Heshbon was the city of Sihon king of the Amorites, who had fought the former king of Moab and taken all his land from his hand as far as the Arnon.
verses.hebrew: כִּי חֶשְׁבּוֹן עִיר סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי הִוא וְהוּא נִלְחַם בְּמֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב הָרִאשׁוֹן וַיִּקַּח אֶת־כָּל־אַרְצוֹ מִיָּדוֹ עַד־אַרְנֹן׃

verses.english: Therefore the makers of proverbs say: Come to Heshbon! Let Sihon's city be built and established.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן יֹאמְרוּ הַמֹּשְׁלִים בֹּאוּ חֶשְׁבּוֹן תִּבָּנֶה וְתִכּוֹנֵן עִיר סִיחוֹן׃

verses.english: For fire went out from Heshbon, a flame from Sihon's city. It consumed Ar of Moab, the lords of the heights of the Arnon.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֵשׁ יָצְאָה מֵחֶשְׁבּוֹן לֶהָבָה מִקִּרְיַת סִיחֹן אָכְלָה עָר מוֹאָב בַּעֲלֵי בָּמוֹת אַרְנֹן׃

verses.english: Woe to you, Moab! You are ruined, people of Chemosh. He gave his sons as fugitives and his daughters into captivity to Sihon king of the Amorites.
verses.hebrew: אוֹי־לְךָ מוֹאָב אָבַדְתָּ עַם־כְּמוֹשׁ נָתַן בָּנָיו פְּלֵיטִם וּבְנֹתָיו בַּשְּׁבִית לְמֶלֶךְ אֱמֹרִי סִיחוֹן׃

verses.english: We shot them down; Heshbon is ruined as far as Dibon. We laid waste as far as Nophah, which reaches to Medeba.
verses.hebrew: וַנִּירָם אָבַד חֶשְׁבּוֹן עַד־דִּיבוֹן וַנַּשִּׁים עַד־נֹפַח אֲשֶׁר עַד־מֵידְבָא׃

verses.english: Israel settled in the land of the Amorites.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ הָאֱמֹרִי׃

verses.english: Moses sent men to spy out Jazer. They captured its dependent villages and dispossessed the Amorites who were there.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מֹשֶׁה לְרַגֵּל אֶת־יַעְזֵר וַיִּלְכְּדוּ בְּנֹתֶיהָ ויירש [וַיּוֹרֶשׁ] אֶת־הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם׃

verses.english: They turned and went up by the road to Bashan. Og king of Bashan came out against them, he and all his people, to fight at Edrei.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְנוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ דֶּרֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וַיֵּצֵא עוֹג מֶלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁן לִקְרָאתָם הוּא וְכָל־עַמּוֹ לַמִּלְחָמָה אֶדְרֶעִי׃

verses.english: YHWH said to Moses: Do not fear him, for I have given him, all his people, and his land into your hand. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה אַל־תִּירָא אֹתוֹ כִּי בְיָדְךָ נָתַתִּי אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־כָּל־עַמּוֹ וְאֶת־אַרְצוֹ וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ לְסִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן׃

verses.english: They struck him, his sons, and all his people until no survivor was left to him, and they possessed his land.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכּוּ אֹתוֹ וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וְאֶת־כָּל־עַמּוֹ עַד־בִּלְתִּי הִשְׁאִיר־לוֹ שָׂרִיד וַיִּירְשׁוּ אֶת־אַרְצוֹ׃

verses.english: The sons of Israel set out and camped in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan opposite Jericho.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַרְבוֹת מוֹאָב מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

verses.english: Balak son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא בָּלָק בֶּן־צִפּוֹר אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה יִשְׂרָאֵל לָאֱמֹרִי׃

verses.english: Moab was very afraid of the people because they were numerous; Moab dreaded the sons of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּגָר מוֹאָב מִפְּנֵי הָעָם מְאֹד כִּי רַב־הוּא וַיָּקָץ מוֹאָב מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Moab said to the elders of Midian: Now this assembly will lick up everything around us as an ox licks up the green plants of the field. Balak son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מוֹאָב אֶל־זִקְנֵי מִדְיָן עַתָּה יְלַחֲכוּ הַקָּהָל אֶת־כָּל־סְבִיבֹתֵינוּ כִּלְחֹךְ הַשּׁוֹר אֵת יֶרֶק הַשָּׂדֶה וּבָלָק בֶּן־צִפּוֹר מֶלֶךְ לְמוֹאָב בָּעֵת הַהִוא׃

verses.english: He sent messengers to Balaam son of Beor at Pethor, beside the River in the land of his people, to summon him: Look, a people has come out of Egypt. They cover the face of the land and are staying opposite me.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־בִּלְעָם בֶּן־בְּעוֹר פְּתוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַנָּהָר אֶרֶץ בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹ לִקְרֹא־לוֹ לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה עַם יָצָא מִמִּצְרַיִם הִנֵּה כִסָּה אֶת־עֵין הָאָרֶץ וְהוּא יֹשֵׁב מִמֻּלִי׃

verses.english: Now please come and curse this people for me, for they are stronger than I am. Perhaps I will succeed, and we can strike them and drive them from the land. I know that whoever you bless is blessed, and whoever you curse is cursed.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לְכָה־נָּא אָרָה־לִּי אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה כִּי־עָצוּם הוּא מִמֶּנִּי אוּלַי אוּכַל נַכֶּה־בּוֹ וַאֲגָרְשֶׁנּוּ מִן־הָאָרֶץ כִּי יָדַעְתִּי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־תְּבָרֵךְ מְבֹרָךְ וַאֲשֶׁר תָּאֹר יוּאָר׃

verses.english: The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian went with divination fees in their hands. They came to Balaam and told him Balak's words.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ זִקְנֵי מוֹאָב וְזִקְנֵי מִדְיָן וּקְסָמִים בְּיָדָם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־בִּלְעָם וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֵלָיו דִּבְרֵי בָלָק׃

verses.english: He said to them: Spend the night here, and I will bring you back the answer that YHWH speaks to me. The officials of Moab stayed with Balaam.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם לִינוּ פֹה הַלַּיְלָה וַהֲשִׁבֹתִי אֶתְכֶם דָּבָר כַּאֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֵלָי וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׂרֵי־מוֹאָב עִם־בִּלְעָם׃

verses.english: God came to Balaam and said: Who are these men with you?
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֱלֹהִים אֶל־בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר מִי הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה עִמָּךְ׃

verses.english: Balaam said to God: Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent to me:
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים בָּלָק בֶּן־צִפֹּר מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב שָׁלַח אֵלָי׃

verses.english: Look, the people who came out of Egypt cover the face of the land. Now come and curse them for me. Perhaps I can fight them and drive them out.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה הָעָם הַיֹּצֵא מִמִּצְרַיִם וַיְכַס אֶת־עֵין הָאָרֶץ עַתָּה לְכָה קָבָה־לִּי אֹתוֹ אוּלַי אוּכַל לְהִלָּחֶם בּוֹ וְגֵרַשְׁתִּיו׃

verses.english: God said to Balaam: You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל־בִּלְעָם לֹא תֵלֵךְ עִמָּהֶם לֹא תָאֹר אֶת־הָעָם כִּי בָרוּךְ הוּא׃

verses.english: Balaam rose in the morning and said to Balak's officials: Go to your land, for YHWH has refused to let me go with you.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם בִּלְעָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־שָׂרֵי בָלָק לְכוּ אֶל־אַרְצְכֶם כִּי מֵאֵן יְהוָה לְתִתִּי לַהֲלֹךְ עִמָּכֶם׃

verses.english: The officials of Moab rose, came to Balak, and said: Balaam has refused to come with us.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקוּמוּ שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־בָּלָק וַיֹּאמְרוּ מֵאֵן בִּלְעָם הֲלֹךְ עִמָּנוּ׃

verses.english: Balak again sent officials, more numerous and more distinguished than these.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד בָּלָק שְׁלֹחַ שָׂרִים רַבִּים וְנִכְבָּדִים מֵאֵלֶּה׃

verses.english: They came to Balaam and said to him: Thus says Balak son of Zippor: Please do not let anything prevent you from coming to me.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ כֹּה אָמַר בָּלָק בֶּן־צִפּוֹר אַל־נָא תִמָּנַע מֵהֲלֹךְ אֵלָי׃

verses.english: I will certainly honor you greatly, and I will do whatever you tell me. Please come and curse this people for me.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־כַבֵּד אֲכַבֶּדְךָ מְאֹד וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאמַר אֵלַי אֶעֱשֶׂה וּלְכָה־נָּא קָבָה־לִּי אֵת הָעָם הַזֶּה׃

verses.english: Balaam answered Balak's servants: Even if Balak gave me his house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond the command of YHWH my God to do anything small or great.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־עַבְדֵי בָלָק אִם־יִתֶּן־לִי בָלָק מְלֹא בֵיתוֹ כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲבֹר אֶת־פִּי יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי לַעֲשׂוֹת קְטַנָּה אוֹ גְדוֹלָה׃

verses.english: Now please stay here tonight also, so that I may learn what more YHWH will say to me.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שְׁבוּ נָא בָזֶה גַּם־אַתֶּם הַלָּיְלָה וְאֵדְעָה מַה־יֹּסֵף יְהוָה דַּבֵּר עִמִּי׃

verses.english: God came to Balaam at night and said to him: If the men have come to summon you, rise and go with them. But you shall do only what I tell you.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֱלֹהִים אֶל־בִּלְעָם לַיְלָה וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִם־לִקְרֹא לְךָ בָּאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים קוּם לֵךְ אִתָּם וְאַךְ אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־אֲדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ אֹתוֹ תַעֲשֶׂה׃

verses.english: Balaam rose in the morning, saddled his donkey, and went with the officials of Moab.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם בִּלְעָם בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ אֶת־אֲתֹנוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ עִם־שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב׃

verses.english: God's anger burned because he was going. YHWH's angel stationed himself in the road as an adversary to him. Balaam was riding his donkey, with his two servants beside him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף אֱלֹהִים כִּי־הוֹלֵךְ הוּא וַיִּתְיַצֵּב מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה בַּדֶּרֶךְ לְשָׂטָן לוֹ וְהוּא רֹכֵב עַל־אֲתֹנוֹ וּשְׁנֵי נְעָרָיו עִמּוֹ׃

verses.english: The donkey saw YHWH's angel standing in the road with his sword drawn in his hand. She turned off the road into the field, and Balaam struck her to turn her back onto the road.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא הָאָתוֹן אֶת־מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה נִצָּב בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְחַרְבּוֹ שְׁלוּפָה בְּיָדוֹ וַתֵּט הָאָתוֹן מִן־הַדֶּרֶךְ וַתֵּלֶךְ בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיַּךְ בִּלְעָם אֶת־הָאָתוֹן לְהַטֹּתָהּ הַדָּרֶךְ׃

verses.english: YHWH's angel stood in a narrow path between vineyards, with a wall on either side.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה בְּמִשְׁעוֹל הַכְּרָמִים גָּדֵר מִזֶּה וְגָדֵר מִזֶּה׃

verses.english: The donkey saw YHWH's angel and pressed against the wall, crushing Balaam's foot against it. He struck her again.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא הָאָתוֹן אֶת־מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה וַתִּלָּחֵץ אֶל־הַקִּיר וַתִּלְחַץ אֶת־רֶגֶל בִּלְעָם אֶל־הַקִּיר וַיֹּסֶף לְהַכֹּתָהּ׃

verses.english: YHWH's angel went farther and stood in a narrow place where there was no way to turn right or left.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹסֶף מַלְאַךְ־יְהוָה עֲבוֹר וַיַּעֲמֹד בְּמָקוֹם צָר אֲשֶׁר אֵין־דֶּרֶךְ לִנְטוֹת יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול׃

verses.english: The donkey saw YHWH's angel and lay down beneath Balaam. Balaam's anger burned, and he struck the donkey with his staff.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא הָאָתוֹן אֶת־מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה וַתִּרְבַּץ תַּחַת בִּלְעָם וַיִּחַר־אַף בִּלְעָם וַיַּךְ אֶת־הָאָתוֹן בַּמַּקֵּל׃

verses.english: YHWH opened the donkey's mouth, and she said to Balaam: What have I done to you that you have struck me these three times?
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְתַּח יְהוָה אֶת־פִּי הָאָתוֹן וַתֹּאמֶר לְבִלְעָם מֶה־עָשִׂיתִי לְךָ כִּי הִכִּיתַנִי זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ רְגָלִים׃

verses.english: Balaam said to the donkey: Because you have made a fool of me! If I had a sword in my hand, I would kill you now.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם לָאָתוֹן כִּי הִתְעַלַּלְתְּ בִּי לוּ יֶשׁ־חֶרֶב בְּיָדִי כִּי עַתָּה הֲרַגְתִּיךְ׃

verses.english: The donkey said to Balaam: Am I not your donkey, which you have ridden all your life to this day? Have I ever been accustomed to doing this to you? He said: No.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָאָתוֹן אֶל־בִּלְעָם הֲלוֹא אָנֹכִי אֲתֹנְךָ אֲשֶׁר־רָכַבְתָּ עָלַי מֵעוֹדְךָ עַד־הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הַהַסְכֵּן הִסְכַּנְתִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת לְךָ כֹּה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא׃

verses.english: YHWH uncovered Balaam's eyes, and he saw YHWH's angel standing in the road with his sword drawn in his hand. He bowed down and prostrated himself on his face.
verses.hebrew: וַיְגַל יְהוָה אֶת־עֵינֵי בִלְעָם וַיַּרְא אֶת־מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה נִצָּב בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְחַרְבּוֹ שְׁלֻפָה בְּיָדוֹ וַיִּקֹּד וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לְאַפָּיו׃

verses.english: YHWH's angel said to him: Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Look, I have come out as an adversary, because your way is reckless before me.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה עַל־מָה הִכִּיתָ אֶת־אֲתֹנְךָ זֶה שָׁלוֹשׁ רְגָלִים הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי יָצָאתִי לְשָׂטָן כִּי־יָרַט הַדֶּרֶךְ לְנֶגְדִּי׃

verses.english: The donkey saw me and turned away before me these three times. Had she not turned away from me, I would now have killed you and kept her alive.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּרְאַנִי הָאָתוֹן וַתֵּט לְפָנַי זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ רְגָלִים אוּלַי נָטְתָה מִפָּנַי כִּי עַתָּה גַּם־אֹתְכָה הָרַגְתִּי וְאוֹתָהּ הֶחֱיֵיתִי׃

verses.english: Balaam said to YHWH's angel: I have sinned, for I did not know that you were standing against me in the road. Now, if this is evil in your eyes, I will turn back.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל־מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה חָטָאתִי כִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי כִּי אַתָּה נִצָּב לִקְרָאתִי בַּדָּרֶךְ וְעַתָּה אִם־רַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ אָשׁוּבָה לִּי׃

verses.english: YHWH's angel said to Balaam: Go with the men, but speak only the word that I tell you. Balaam went with Balak's officials.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה אֶל־בִּלְעָם לֵךְ עִם־הָאֲנָשִׁים וְאֶפֶס אֶת־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־אֲדַבֵּר אֵלֶיךָ אֹתוֹ תְדַבֵּר וַיֵּלֶךְ בִּלְעָם עִם־שָׂרֵי בָלָק׃

verses.english: Balak heard that Balaam was coming and went out to meet him at the city of Moab on the Arnon border, at the edge of the territory.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע בָּלָק כִּי בָא בִלְעָם וַיֵּצֵא לִקְרָאתוֹ אֶל־עִיר מוֹאָב אֲשֶׁר עַל־גְּבוּל אַרְנֹן אֲשֶׁר בִּקְצֵה הַגְּבוּל׃

verses.english: Balak said to Balaam: Did I not send urgently to summon you? Why did you not come to me? Am I really unable to honor you?
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל־בִּלְעָם הֲלֹא שָׁלֹחַ שָׁלַחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לִקְרֹא־לָךְ לָמָּה לֹא־הָלַכְתָּ אֵלָי הַאֻמְנָם לֹא אוּכַל כַּבְּדֶךָ׃

verses.english: Balaam said to Balak: Look, I have come to you. Can I now say anything at all? I shall speak the word that God puts in my mouth.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל־בָּלָק הִנֵּה־בָאתִי אֵלֶיךָ עַתָּה הֲיָכוֹל אוּכַל דַּבֵּר מְאוּמָה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר יָשִׂים אֱלֹהִים בְּפִי אֹתוֹ אֲדַבֵּר׃

verses.english: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath-huzoth.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בִּלְעָם עִם־בָּלָק וַיָּבֹאוּ קִרְיַת חֻצוֹת׃

verses.english: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep and sent portions to Balaam and the officials with him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְבַּח בָּלָק בָּקָר וָצֹאן וַיְשַׁלַּח לְבִלְעָם וְלַשָּׂרִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ׃

verses.english: In the morning Balak took Balaam and brought him up to the heights of Baal. From there he saw the outer part of the people.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַיִּקַּח בָּלָק אֶת־בִּלְעָם וַיַּעֲלֵהוּ בָּמוֹת בָּעַל וַיַּרְא מִשָּׁם קְצֵה הָעָם׃

verses.english: Balaam said to Balak: Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל־בָּלָק בְּנֵה־לִי בָזֶה שִׁבְעָה מִזְבְּחֹת וְהָכֵן לִי בָּזֶה שִׁבְעָה פָרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֵילִים׃

verses.english: Balak did as Balaam said, and Balak and Balaam offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ בָּלָק כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בִּלְעָם וַיַּעַל בָּלָק וּבִלְעָם פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

verses.english: Balaam said to Balak: Stand beside your burnt offering, while I go. Perhaps YHWH will meet me; whatever He shows me, I will tell you. He went to a bare height.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם לְבָלָק הִתְיַצֵּב עַל־עֹלָתֶךָ וְאֵלְכָה אוּלַי יִקָּרֵה יְהוָה לִקְרָאתִי וּדְבַר מַה־יַּרְאֵנִי וְהִגַּדְתִּי לָךְ וַיֵּלֶךְ שֶׁפִי׃

verses.english: God met Balaam, and Balaam said to Him: I have arranged the seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּר אֱלֹהִים אֶל־בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֶת־שִׁבְעַת הַמִּזְבְּחֹת עָרַכְתִּי וָאַעַל פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

verses.english: YHWH put a word in Balaam's mouth and said: Return to Balak and speak thus.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם יְהוָה דָּבָר בְּפִי בִלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר שׁוּב אֶל־בָּלָק וְכֹה תְדַבֵּר׃

verses.english: He returned to him, and there he stood beside his burnt offering, with all the officials of Moab.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב אֵלָיו וְהִנֵּה נִצָּב עַל־עֹלָתוֹ הוּא וְכָל־שָׂרֵי מוֹאָב׃

verses.english: He took up his oracle and said: Balak brought me from Aram, the king of Moab from the eastern mountains: Come, curse Jacob for me; come, denounce Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר מִן־אֲרָם יַנְחֵנִי בָלָק מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָב מֵהַרְרֵי־קֶדֶם לְכָה אָרָה־לִּי יַעֲקֹב וּלְכָה זֹעֲמָה יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: How can I curse whom God has not cursed? How can I denounce whom YHWH has not denounced?
verses.hebrew: מָה אֶקֹּב לֹא קַבֹּה אֵל וּמָה אֶזְעֹם לֹא זָעַם יְהוָה׃

verses.english: From the tops of rocks I see them, and from the hills I behold them. Look, a people dwelling alone, not reckoned among the nations.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־מֵרֹאשׁ צֻרִים אֶרְאֶנּוּ וּמִגְּבָעוֹת אֲשׁוּרֶנּוּ הֶן־עָם לְבָדָד יִשְׁכֹּן וּבַגּוֹיִם לֹא יִתְחַשָּׁב׃

verses.english: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or number even a fourth of Israel? Let me die the death of the upright, and let my end be like theirs!
verses.hebrew: מִי מָנָה עֲפַר יַעֲקֹב וּמִסְפָּר אֶת־רֹבַע יִשְׂרָאֵל תָּמֹת נַפְשִׁי מוֹת יְשָׁרִים וּתְהִי אַחֲרִיתִי כָּמֹהוּ׃

verses.english: Balak said to Balaam: What have you done to me? I brought you to curse my enemies, and look, you have thoroughly blessed them!
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל־בִּלְעָם מֶה עָשִׂיתָ לִי לָקֹב אֹיְבַי לְקַחְתִּיךָ וְהִנֵּה בֵּרַכְתָּ בָרֵךְ׃

verses.english: He answered: Must I not take care to speak what YHWH puts in my mouth?
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן וַיֹּאמַר הֲלֹא אֵת אֲשֶׁר יָשִׂים יְהוָה בְּפִי אֹתוֹ אֶשְׁמֹר לְדַבֵּר׃

verses.english: Balak said to him: Please come with me to another place from which you can see them. You will see only their outer part, not all of them. Curse them for me from there.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בָּלָק לך־[לְכָה־] נָּא אִתִּי אֶל־מָקוֹם אַחֵר אֲשֶׁר תִּרְאֶנּוּ מִשָּׁם אֶפֶס קָצֵהוּ תִרְאֶה וְכֻלּוֹ לֹא תִרְאֶה וְקָבְנוֹ־לִי מִשָּׁם׃

verses.english: He took him to the field of Zophim, to the summit of Pisgah, built seven altars, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ שְׂדֵה צֹפִים אֶל־רֹאשׁ הַפִּסְגָּה וַיִּבֶן שִׁבְעָה מִזְבְּחֹת וַיַּעַל פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

verses.english: He said to Balak: Stand here beside your burnt offering, while I seek an encounter over there.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בָּלָק הִתְיַצֵּב כֹּה עַל־עֹלָתֶךָ וְאָנֹכִי אִקָּרֶה כֹּה׃

verses.english: YHWH met Balaam, put a word in his mouth, and said: Return to Balak and speak thus.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּר יְהוָה אֶל־בִּלְעָם וַיָּשֶׂם דָּבָר בְּפִיו וַיֹּאמֶר שׁוּב אֶל־בָּלָק וְכֹה תְדַבֵּר׃

verses.english: He came to him, and there he stood beside his burnt offering, with the officials of Moab. Balak said to him: What did YHWH say?
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֵלָיו וְהִנּוֹ נִצָּב עַל־עֹלָתוֹ וְשָׂרֵי מוֹאָב אִתּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בָּלָק מַה־דִּבֶּר יְהוָה׃

verses.english: He took up his oracle and said: Rise, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, son of Zippor!
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר קוּם בָּלָק וּשֲׁמָע הַאֲזִינָה עָדַי בְּנוֹ צִפֹּר׃

verses.english: God is not a man, that He should lie, or a son of man, that He should change His mind. Has He said, and will He not do it? Has He spoken, and will He not fulfill it?
verses.hebrew: לֹא אִישׁ אֵל וִיכַזֵּב וּבֶן־אָדָם וְיִתְנֶחָם הַהוּא אָמַר וְלֹא יַעֲשֶׂה וְדִבֶּר וְלֹא יְקִימֶנָּה׃

verses.english: Look, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I cannot reverse it.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה בָרֵךְ לָקָחְתִּי וּבֵרֵךְ וְלֹא אֲשִׁיבֶנָּה׃

verses.english: He has not looked upon iniquity in Jacob or seen trouble in Israel. YHWH their God is with them, and the acclamation of a king is among them.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־הִבִּיט אָוֶן בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא־רָאָה עָמָל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וּתְרוּעַת מֶלֶךְ בּוֹ׃

verses.english: God brings them out of Egypt; for them there is strength like a wild ox's.
verses.hebrew: אֵל מוֹצִיאָם מִמִּצְרָיִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹת רְאֵם לוֹ׃

verses.english: There is no omen-taking in Jacob and no divination in Israel. At the appointed time it shall be said of Jacob and Israel: What God has done!
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־נַחַשׁ בְּיַעֲקֹב וְלֹא־קֶסֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כָּעֵת יֵאָמֵר לְיַעֲקֹב וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל מַה־פָּעַל אֵל׃

verses.english: Look, a people rises like a lioness and lifts itself up like a lion. It will not lie down until it eats prey and drinks the blood of the slain.
verses.hebrew: הֶן־עָם כְּלָבִיא יָקוּם וְכַאֲרִי יִתְנַשָּׂא לֹא יִשְׁכַּב עַד־יֹאכַל טֶרֶף וְדַם־חֲלָלִים יִשְׁתֶּה׃

verses.english: Balak said to Balaam: Do not curse them at all, and do not bless them at all!
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל־בִּלְעָם גַּם־קֹב לֹא תִקֳּבֶנּוּ גַּם־בָּרֵךְ לֹא תְבָרֲכֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: Balaam answered Balak: Did I not tell you that I must do everything YHWH says?
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן בִּלְעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־בָּלָק הֲלֹא דִּבַּרְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֹתוֹ אֶעֱשֶׂה׃

verses.english: Balak said to Balaam: Please come; I will take you to another place. Perhaps it will be right in God's eyes for you to curse them for me from there.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל־בִּלְעָם לְכָה־נָּא אֶקָּחֲךָ אֶל־מָקוֹם אַחֵר אוּלַי יִישַׁר בְּעֵינֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וְקַבֹּתוֹ לִי מִשָּׁם׃

verses.english: Balak took Balaam to the summit of Peor, overlooking the wasteland.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח בָּלָק אֶת־בִּלְעָם רֹאשׁ הַפְּעוֹר הַנִּשְׁקָף עַל־פְּנֵי הַיְשִׁימֹן׃

verses.english: Balaam said to Balak: Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל־בָּלָק בְּנֵה־לִי בָזֶה שִׁבְעָה מִזְבְּחֹת וְהָכֵן לִי בָּזֶה שִׁבְעָה פָרִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֵילִים׃

verses.english: Balak did as Balaam said and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ בָּלָק כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר בִּלְעָם וַיַּעַל פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ׃

verses.english: Balaam saw that it pleased YHWH to bless Israel, so he did not go as before to seek omens. He turned his face toward the wilderness.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא בִּלְעָם כִּי טוֹב בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא־הָלַךְ כְּפַעַם־בְּפַעַם לִקְרַאת נְחָשִׁים וַיָּשֶׁת אֶל־הַמִּדְבָּר פָּנָיו׃

verses.english: Balaam raised his eyes and saw Israel dwelling by its tribes, and God's Spirit came upon him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא בִלְעָם אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל שֹׁכֵן לִשְׁבָטָיו וַתְּהִי עָלָיו רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: He took up his oracle and said: The utterance of Balaam son of Beor, the utterance of the man whose eye is opened,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר נְאֻם בִּלְעָם בְּנוֹ בְעֹר וּנְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר שְׁתֻם הָעָיִן׃

verses.english: the utterance of one who hears God's words, who sees a vision of Shaddai, falling down with eyes uncovered:
verses.hebrew: נְאֻם שֹׁמֵעַ אִמְרֵי־אֵל אֲשֶׁר מַחֲזֵה שַׁדַּי יֶחֱזֶה נֹפֵל וּגְלוּי עֵינָיִם׃

verses.english: How good are your tents, Jacob, your dwellings, Israel!
verses.hebrew: מַה־טֹּבוּ אֹהָלֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Like valleys stretching out, like gardens beside a river, like aloes planted by YHWH, like cedars beside waters.
verses.hebrew: כִּנְחָלִים נִטָּיוּ כְּגַנֹּת עֲלֵי נָהָר כַּאֲהָלִים נָטַע יְהוָה כַּאֲרָזִים עֲלֵי־מָיִם׃

verses.english: Water shall flow from his buckets, and his seed shall have abundant water. His king shall rise higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
verses.hebrew: יִזַּל־מַיִם מִדָּלְיָו וְזַרְעוֹ בְּמַיִם רַבִּים וְיָרֹם מֵאֲגַג מַלְכּוֹ וְתִנַּשֵּׂא מַלְכֻתוֹ׃

verses.english: God brings him out of Egypt; his strength is like a wild ox's. He shall devour the nations that oppose him, gnaw their bones, and pierce them with his arrows.
verses.hebrew: אֵל מוֹצִיאוֹ מִמִּצְרַיִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹת רְאֵם לוֹ יֹאכַל גּוֹיִם צָרָיו וְעַצְמֹתֵיהֶם יְגָרֵם וְחִצָּיו יִמְחָץ׃

verses.english: He crouched and lay down like a lion, like a lioness—who will rouse him? Blessed are those who bless you, and cursed are those who curse you.
verses.hebrew: כָּרַע שָׁכַב כַּאֲרִי וּכְלָבִיא מִי יְקִימֶנּוּ מְבָרֲכֶיךָ בָרוּךְ וְאֹרְרֶיךָ אָרוּר׃

verses.english: Balak's anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam: I summoned you to curse my enemies, and look, you have thoroughly blessed them these three times!
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף בָּלָק אֶל־בִּלְעָם וַיִּסְפֹּק אֶת־כַּפָּיו וַיֹּאמֶר בָּלָק אֶל־בִּלְעָם לָקֹב אֹיְבַי קְרָאתִיךָ וְהִנֵּה בֵּרַכְתָּ בָרֵךְ זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים׃

verses.english: Now flee to your own place! I said I would greatly honor you, but look, YHWH has kept you from honor.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה בְּרַח־לְךָ אֶל־מְקוֹמֶךָ אָמַרְתִּי כַּבֵּד אֲכַבֶּדְךָ וְהִנֵּה מְנָעֲךָ יְהוָה מִכָּבוֹד׃

verses.english: Balaam said to Balak: Did I not tell the messengers you sent to me:
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בִּלְעָם אֶל־בָּלָק הֲלֹא גַּם אֶל־מַלְאָכֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַחְתָּ אֵלַי דִּבַּרְתִּי לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Even if Balak gave me his house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond YHWH's command to do good or evil of my own will. What YHWH speaks, I must speak.
verses.hebrew: אִם־יִתֶּן־לִי בָלָק מְלֹא בֵיתוֹ כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב לֹא אוּכַל לַעֲבֹר אֶת־פִּי יְהוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת טוֹבָה אוֹ רָעָה מִלִּבִּי אֲשֶׁר־יְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֹתוֹ אֲדַבֵּר׃

verses.english: Now look, I am going to my people. Come, I will advise you what this people will do to your people in the latter days.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִנְנִי הוֹלֵךְ לְעַמִּי לְכָה אִיעָצְךָ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה הָעָם הַזֶּה לְעַמְּךָ בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים׃

verses.english: He took up his oracle and said: The utterance of Balaam son of Beor, the utterance of the man whose eye is opened,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר נְאֻם בִּלְעָם בְּנוֹ בְעֹר וּנְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר שְׁתֻם הָעָיִן׃

verses.english: the utterance of one who hears God's words and knows the knowledge of the Most High, who sees a vision of Shaddai, falling down with eyes uncovered:
verses.hebrew: נְאֻם שֹׁמֵעַ אִמְרֵי־אֵל וְיֹדֵעַ דַּעַת עֶלְיוֹן מַחֲזֵה שַׁדַּי יֶחֱזֶה נֹפֵל וּגְלוּי עֵינָיִם׃

verses.english: I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star shall march out of Jacob, and a scepter shall rise from Israel. He shall crush Moab's temples and break down all the sons of Seth.
verses.hebrew: אֶרְאֶנּוּ וְלֹא עַתָּה אֲשׁוּרֶנּוּ וְלֹא קָרוֹב דָּרַךְ כּוֹכָב מִיַּעֲקֹב וְקָם שֵׁבֶט מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וּמָחַץ פַּאֲתֵי מוֹאָב וְקַרְקַר כָּל־בְּנֵי־שֵׁת׃

verses.english: Edom shall become a possession, and Seir, his enemies, shall become a possession, while Israel acts valiantly.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אֱדוֹם יְרֵשָׁה וְהָיָה יְרֵשָׁה שֵׂעִיר אֹיְבָיו וְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֹשֶׂה חָיִל׃

verses.english: One from Jacob shall rule and destroy the survivor from the city.
verses.hebrew: וְיֵרְדְּ מִיַּעֲקֹב וְהֶאֱבִיד שָׂרִיד מֵעִיר׃

verses.english: He saw Amalek, took up his oracle, and said: Amalek was first among the nations, but its end is destruction.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֶת־עֲמָלֵק וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר רֵאשִׁית גּוֹיִם עֲמָלֵק וְאַחֲרִיתוֹ עֲדֵי אֹבֵד׃

verses.english: He saw the Kenites, took up his oracle, and said: Your dwelling is enduring, and your nest is set in the rock;
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֶת־הַקֵּינִי וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר אֵיתָן מוֹשָׁבֶךָ וְשִׂים בַּסֶּלַע קִנֶּךָ׃

verses.english: yet Kain shall be burned away. How long until Asshur takes you captive?
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־יִהְיֶה לְבָעֵר קָיִן עַד־מָה אַשּׁוּר תִּשְׁבֶּךָּ׃

verses.english: He took up his oracle and said: Alas, who can live when God appoints this?
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא מְשָׁלוֹ וַיֹּאמַר אוֹי מִי יִחְיֶה מִשֻּׂמוֹ אֵל׃

verses.english: Ships shall come from the coast of Kittim and afflict Asshur and Eber; but they too shall end in destruction.
verses.hebrew: וְצִים מִיַּד כִּתִּים וְעִנּוּ אַשּׁוּר וְעִנּוּ־עֵבֶר וְגַם־הוּא עֲדֵי אֹבֵד׃

verses.english: Balaam rose, went away, and returned to his place; Balak also went his way.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם בִּלְעָם וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיָּשָׁב לִמְקֹמוֹ וְגַם־בָּלָק הָלַךְ לְדַרְכּוֹ׃

verses.english: Israel stayed at Shittim, and the people began to engage in sexual immorality with the daughters of Moab.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשִּׁטִּים וַיָּחֶל הָעָם לִזְנוֹת אֶל־בְּנוֹת מוֹאָב׃

verses.english: The women invited the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרֶאןָ לָעָם לְזִבְחֵי אֱלֹהֵיהֶן וַיֹּאכַל הָעָם וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲוּוּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶן׃

verses.english: Israel joined itself to Baal of Peor, and YHWH's anger burned against Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּצָּמֶד יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: YHWH said to Moses: Take all the leaders of the people and expose them to YHWH in full sunlight, so that YHWH's burning anger may turn away from Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה קַח אֶת־כָּל־רָאשֵׁי הָעָם וְהוֹקַע אוֹתָם לַיהוָה נֶגֶד הַשָּׁמֶשׁ וְיָשֹׁב חֲרוֹן אַף־יְהוָה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Moses said to Israel's judges: Each of you shall kill his men who joined themselves to Baal of Peor.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל־שֹׁפְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִרְגוּ אִישׁ אֲנָשָׁיו הַנִּצְמָדִים לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר׃

verses.english: An Israelite man came and brought a Midianite woman to his brothers before the eyes of Moses and the whole congregation of the sons of Israel, while they were weeping at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּא וַיַּקְרֵב אֶל־אֶחָיו אֶת־הַמִּדְיָנִית לְעֵינֵי מֹשֶׁה וּלְעֵינֵי כָּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהֵמָּה בֹכִים פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: Phinehas son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, saw it, rose from among the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא פִּינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וַיָּקָם מִתּוֹךְ הָעֵדָה וַיִּקַּח רֹמַח בְּיָדוֹ׃

verses.english: He went after the Israelite man into the chamber and pierced both of them, the Israelite man and the woman, through her belly. The plague against the sons of Israel stopped.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אַחַר אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַקֻּבָּה וַיִּדְקֹר אֶת־שְׁנֵיהֶם אֵת אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶת־הָאִשָּׁה אֶל־קֳבָתָהּ וַתֵּעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה מֵעַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Those who died in the plague numbered twenty-four thousand.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ הַמֵּתִים בַּמַּגֵּפָה אַרְבָּעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים אָלֶף׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Phinehas son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, has turned My wrath away from the sons of Israel by being zealous with My zeal among them, so that I did not consume the sons of Israel in My jealousy.
verses.hebrew: פִּינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן הֵשִׁיב אֶת־חֲמָתִי מֵעַל בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּקַנְאוֹ אֶת־קִנְאָתִי בְּתוֹכָם וְלֹא־כִלִּיתִי אֶת־בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּקִנְאָתִי׃

verses.english: Therefore say: Look, I give him My covenant of peace.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אֱמֹר הִנְנִי נֹתֵן לוֹ אֶת־בְּרִיתִי שָׁלוֹם׃

verses.english: It shall be for him and his offspring after him a covenant of perpetual priesthood, because he was zealous for his God and made atonement for the sons of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה לּוֹ וּלְזַרְעוֹ אַחֲרָיו בְּרִית כְּהֻנַּת עוֹלָם תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר קִנֵּא לֵאלֹהָיו וַיְכַפֵּר עַל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: The name of the Israelite man struck down with the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu, a leader of an ancestral house among the Simeonites.
verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמֻּכֶּה אֲשֶׁר הֻכָּה אֶת־הַמִּדְיָנִית זִמְרִי בֶּן־סָלוּא נְשִׂיא בֵית־אָב לַשִּׁמְעֹנִי׃

verses.english: The name of the Midianite woman who was struck down was Cozbi daughter of Zur, who was head of clans, an ancestral house in Midian.
verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם הָאִשָּׁה הַמֻּכָּה הַמִּדְיָנִית כָּזְבִּי בַת־צוּר רֹאשׁ אֻמּוֹת בֵּית־אָב בְּמִדְיָן הוּא׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Treat the Midianites as enemies and strike them,
verses.hebrew: צָרוֹר אֶת־הַמִּדְיָנִים וְהִכִּיתֶם אוֹתָם׃

verses.english: for they treat you as enemies through the schemes by which they deceived you in the matter of Peor and in the matter of Cozbi, daughter of a Midianite leader, their sister, who was struck down on the day of the plague because of Peor.
verses.hebrew: כִּי צֹרְרִים הֵם לָכֶם בְּנִכְלֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר־נִכְּלוּ לָכֶם עַל־דְּבַר־פְּעוֹר וְעַל־דְּבַר כָּזְבִּי בַת־נְשִׂיא מִדְיָן אֲחֹתָם הַמֻּכָּה בְיוֹם־הַמַּגֵּפָה עַל־דְּבַר־פְּעוֹר׃

verses.english: After the plague, YHWH said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron the priest:
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי הַמַּגֵּפָה וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי הַמַּגֵּפָה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Take a census of the whole congregation of the sons of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their ancestral houses, everyone who goes out for military service in Israel.
verses.hebrew: שְׂאוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ כָּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם כָּל־יֹצֵא צָבָא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab beside the Jordan opposite Jericho, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֹתָם בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל־יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Count those from twenty years old and upward, as YHWH commanded Moses and the sons of Israel who came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמָעְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַיֹּצְאִים מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: Reuben was Israel's firstborn. The sons of Reuben: from Hanoch, the Hanochite clan; from Pallu, the Palluite clan;
verses.hebrew: רְאוּבֵן בְּכוֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן חֲנוֹךְ מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֲנֹכִי לְפַלּוּא מִשְׁפַּחַת הַפַּלֻּאִי׃

verses.english: from Hezron, the Hezronite clan; from Carmi, the Carmite clan.
verses.hebrew: לְחֶצְרֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶצְרוֹנִי לְכַרְמִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַכַּרְמִי׃

verses.english: These were the Reubenite clans. Those registered numbered forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הָרֻאוּבֵנִי וַיִּהְיוּ פְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִׁים׃

verses.english: The sons of Pallu: Eliab.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי פַלּוּא אֱלִיאָב׃

verses.english: The sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These were Dathan and Abiram, chosen members of the congregation, who contended against Moses and Aaron in Korah's congregation when they contended against YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי אֱלִיאָב נְמוּאֵל וְדָתָן וַאֲבִירָם הוּא־דָתָן וַאֲבִירָם קרואי [קְרִיאֵי] הָעֵדָה אֲשֶׁר הִצּוּ עַל־מֹשֶׁה וְעַל־אַהֲרֹן בַּעֲדַת־קֹרַח בְּהַצֹּתָם עַל־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and Korah when the congregation died, when the fire consumed the two hundred fifty men; they became a warning sign.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּפְתַּח הָאָרֶץ אֶת־פִּיהָ וַתִּבְלַע אֹתָם וְאֶת־קֹרַח בְּמוֹת הָעֵדָה בַּאֲכֹל הָאֵשׁ אֵת חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתַיִם אִישׁ וַיִּהְיוּ לְנֵס׃

verses.english: But Korah's sons did not die.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי־קֹרַח לֹא־מֵתוּ׃

verses.english: The sons of Simeon by their clans: from Nemuel, the Nemuelite clan; from Jamin, the Jaminite clan; from Jachin, the Jachinite clan;
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִנְמוּאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַנְּמוּאֵלִי לְיָמִין מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיָּמִינִי לְיָכִין מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיָּכִינִי׃

verses.english: from Zerah, the Zerahite clan; from Shaul, the Shaulite clan.
verses.hebrew: לְזֶרַח מִשְׁפַּחַת הַזַּרְחִי לְשָׁאוּל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשָּׁאוּלִי׃

verses.english: These were the Simeonite clans: twenty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַשִּׁמְעֹנִי שְׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף וּמָאתָיִם׃

verses.english: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה עֵר וְאוֹנָן וַיָּמָת עֵר וְאוֹנָן בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

verses.english: The sons of Judah by their clans: from Shelah, the Shelanite clan; from Perez, the Perezite clan; from Zerah, the Zerahite clan.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְשֵׁלָה מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשֵּׁלָנִי לְפֶרֶץ מִשְׁפַּחַת הַפַּרְצִי לְזֶרַח מִשְׁפַּחַת הַזַּרְחִי׃

verses.english: The sons of Perez: from Hezron, the Hezronite clan; from Hamul, the Hamulite clan.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־פֶרֶץ לְחֶצְרֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶצְרֹנִי לְחָמוּל מִשְׁפַּחַת הֶחָמוּלִי׃

verses.english: These were Judah's clans according to their registration: seventy-six thousand five hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת יְהוּדָה לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שִׁשָּׁה וְשִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: The sons of Issachar by their clans: from Tola, the Tolaite clan; from Puah, the Punite clan;
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם תּוֹלָע מִשְׁפַּחַת הַתּוֹלָעִי לְפֻוָה מִשְׁפַּחַת הַפּוּנִי׃

verses.english: from Jashub, the Jashubite clan; from Shimron, the Shimronite clan.
verses.hebrew: לְיָשׁוּב מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיָּשׁוּבִי לְשִׁמְרֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשִּׁמְרֹנִי׃

verses.english: These were Issachar's clans according to their registration: sixty-four thousand three hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת יִשָּׂשכָר לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְשִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: The sons of Zebulun by their clans: from Sered, the Seredite clan; from Elon, the Elonite clan; from Jahleel, the Jahleelite clan.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי זְבוּלֻן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְסֶרֶד מִשְׁפַּחַת הַסַּרְדִּי לְאֵלוֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאֵלֹנִי לְיַחְלְאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיַּחְלְאֵלִי׃

verses.english: These were the Zebulunite clans according to their registration: sixty thousand five hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַזְּבוּלֹנִי לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: The sons of Gad by their clans: from Zephon, the Zephonite clan; from Haggi, the Haggite clan; from Shuni, the Shunite clan;
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי גָד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִצְפוֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַצְּפוֹנִי לְחַגִּי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחַגִּי לְשׁוּנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשּׁוּנִי׃

verses.english: from Ozni, the Oznite clan; from Eri, the Erite clan;
verses.hebrew: לְאָזְנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאָזְנִי לְעֵרִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הָעֵרִי׃

verses.english: from Arod, the Arodite clan; from Areli, the Arelite clan.
verses.hebrew: לַאֲרוֹד מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאֲרוֹדִי לְאַרְאֵלִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאַרְאֵלִי׃

verses.english: These were the clans of the sons of Gad according to their registration: forty thousand five hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי־גָד לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: The sons of Asher by their clans: from Imnah, the Imnite clan; from Ishvi, the Ishvite clan; from Beriah, the Beriite clan.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי אָשֵׁר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְיִמְנָה מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיִּמְנָה לְיִשְׁוִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיִּשְׁוִי לִבְרִיעָה מִשְׁפַּחַת הַבְּרִיעִי׃

verses.english: The sons of Beriah: from Heber, the Heberite clan; from Malchiel, the Malchielite clan.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי בְרִיעָה לְחֶבֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶבְרִי לְמַלְכִּיאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּלְכִּיאֵלִי׃

verses.english: The name of Asher's daughter was Serah.
verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם בַּת־אָשֵׁר שָׂרַח׃

verses.english: These were the clans of the sons of Asher according to their registration: fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי־אָשֵׁר לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: The sons of Joseph by their clans were Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרָיִם׃

verses.english: The sons of Manasseh: from Machir, the Machirite clan. Machir begat Gilead; from Gilead, the Gileadite clan.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה לְמָכִיר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמָּכִירִי וּמָכִיר הוֹלִיד אֶת־גִּלְעָד לְגִלְעָד מִשְׁפַּחַת הַגִּלְעָדִי׃

verses.english: These were the sons of Gilead: from Iezer, the Iezerite clan; from Helek, the Helekite clan;
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי גִלְעָד אִיעֶזֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאִיעֶזְרִי לְחֵלֶק מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶלְקִי׃

verses.english: from Asriel, the Asrielite clan; from Shechem, the Shechemite clan;
verses.hebrew: וְאַשְׂרִיאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאַשְׂרִאֵלִי וְשֶׁכֶם מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשִּׁכְמִי׃

verses.english: from Shemida, the Shemidaite clan; from Hepher, the Hepherite clan.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמִידָע מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשְּׁמִידָעִי וְחֵפֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶפְרִי׃

verses.english: Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons, only daughters. The names of Zelophehad's daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.hebrew: וּצְלָפְחָד בֶּן־חֵפֶר לֹא־הָיוּ לוֹ בָּנִים כִּי אִם־בָּנוֹת וְשֵׁם בְּנוֹת צְלָפְחָד מַחְלָה וְנֹעָה חָגְלָה מִלְכָּה וְתִרְצָה׃

verses.english: These were Manasseh's clans; those registered numbered fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת מְנַשֶּׁה וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: These were the sons of Ephraim by their clans: from Shuthelah, the Shuthelahite clan; from Becher, the Becherite clan; from Tahan, the Tahanite clan.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי־אֶפְרַיִם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְשׁוּתֶלַח מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשֻּׁתַלְחִי לְבֶכֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַבַּכְרִי לְתַחַן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַתַּחֲנִי׃

verses.english: These were the sons of Shuthelah: from Eran, the Eranite clan.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי שׁוּתָלַח לְעֵרָן מִשְׁפַּחַת הָעֵרָנִי׃

verses.english: These were the clans of the sons of Ephraim according to their registration: thirty-two thousand five hundred. These were the sons of Joseph by their clans.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי־אֶפְרַיִם לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת אֵלֶּה בְנֵי־יוֹסֵף לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

verses.english: The sons of Benjamin by their clans: from Bela, the Belaite clan; from Ashbel, the Ashbelite clan; from Ahiram, the Ahiramite clan;
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְבֶלַע מִשְׁפַּחַת הַבַּלְעִי לְאַשְׁבֵּל מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאַשְׁבֵּלִי לַאֲחִירָם מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאֲחִירָמִי׃

verses.english: from Shephupham, the Shuphamite clan; from Hupham, the Huphamite clan.
verses.hebrew: לִשְׁפוּפָם מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשּׁוּפָמִי לְחוּפָם מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחוּפָמִי׃

verses.english: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the Ardite clan; from Naaman, the Naamite clan.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־בֶלַע אַרְדְּ וְנַעֲמָן מִשְׁפַּחַת הָאַרְדִּי לְנַעֲמָן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַנַּעֲמִי׃

verses.english: These were the sons of Benjamin by their clans; those registered numbered forty-five thousand six hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי־בִנְיָמִן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: These were the sons of Dan by their clans: from Shuham, the Shuhamite clan. These were Dan's clans by their families.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי־דָן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְשׁוּחָם מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשּׁוּחָמִי אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת דָּן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם׃

verses.english: All the Shuhamite clans according to their registration numbered sixty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־מִשְׁפְּחֹת הַשּׁוּחָמִי לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם אַרְבָּעָה וְשִׁשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: The sons of Naphtali by their clans: from Jahzeel, the Jahzeelite clan; from Guni, the Gunite clan;
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי נַפְתָּלִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְיַחְצְאֵל מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיַּחְצְאֵלִי לְגוּנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַגּוּנִי׃

verses.english: from Jezer, the Jezerite clan; from Shillem, the Shillemite clan.
verses.hebrew: לְיֵצֶר מִשְׁפַּחַת הַיִּצְרִי לְשִׁלֵּם מִשְׁפַּחַת הַשִּׁלֵּמִי׃

verses.english: These were Naphtali's clans by their families; those registered numbered forty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת נַפְתָּלִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם חֲמִשָּׁה וְאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: Those registered of the sons of Israel numbered six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה פְּקוּדֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וָאָלֶף שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִׁים׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: The land shall be divided among these as an inheritance according to the number of names.
verses.hebrew: לָאֵלֶּה תֵּחָלֵק הָאָרֶץ בְּנַחֲלָה בְּמִסְפַּר שֵׁמוֹת׃

verses.english: To the larger group you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller group a smaller inheritance. Each shall receive its inheritance according to those registered.
verses.hebrew: לָרַב תַּרְבֶּה נַחֲלָתוֹ וְלַמְעַט תַּמְעִיט נַחֲלָתוֹ אִישׁ לְפִי פְקֻדָיו יֻתַּן נַחֲלָתוֹ׃

verses.english: But the land shall be divided by lot. They shall inherit according to the names of their ancestral tribes.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־בְּגוֹרָל יֵחָלֵק אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לִשְׁמוֹת מַטּוֹת־אֲבֹתָם יִנְחָלוּ׃

verses.english: Their inheritance shall be divided by the decision of the lot between the larger and the smaller groups.
verses.hebrew: עַל־פִּי הַגּוֹרָל תֵּחָלֵק נַחֲלָתוֹ בֵּין רַב לִמְעָט׃

verses.english: These were the registered Levites by their clans: from Gershon, the Gershonite clan; from Kohath, the Kohathite clan; from Merari, the Merarite clan.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה פְקוּדֵי הַלֵּוִי לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לְגֵרְשׁוֹן מִשְׁפַּחַת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּי לִקְהָת מִשְׁפַּחַת הַקְּהָתִי לִמְרָרִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמְּרָרִי׃

verses.english: These were Levi's clans: the Libnite clan, the Hebronite clan, the Mahlite clan, the Mushite clan, and the Korahite clan. Kohath begat Amram.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹת לֵוִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַלִּבְנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַחֶבְרֹנִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּחְלִי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַמּוּשִׁי מִשְׁפַּחַת הַקָּרְחִי וּקְהָת הוֹלִד אֶת־עַמְרָם׃

verses.english: Amram's wife was named Jochebed, a daughter of Levi, born to Levi in Egypt. She bore Aaron, Moses, and their sister Miriam to Amram.
verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם אֵשֶׁת עַמְרָם יוֹכֶבֶד בַּת־לֵוִי אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה אֹתָהּ לְלֵוִי בְּמִצְרָיִם וַתֵּלֶד לְעַמְרָם אֶת־אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת־מֹשֶׁה וְאֵת מִרְיָם אֲחֹתָם׃

verses.english: To Aaron were born Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּלֵד לְאַהֲרֹן אֶת־נָדָב וְאֶת־אֲבִיהוּא אֶת־אֶלְעָזָר וְאֶת־אִיתָמָר׃

verses.english: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unauthorized fire before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא בְּהַקְרִיבָם אֵשׁ־זָרָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Those registered numbered twenty-three thousand, every male from one month old and upward. They were not registered among the sons of Israel, because no inheritance was given to them among the sons of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ פְקֻדֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשָׁה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף כָּל־זָכָר מִבֶּן־חֹדֶשׁ וָמָעְלָה כִּי לֹא הָתְפָּקְדוּ בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי לֹא־נִתַּן לָהֶם נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: These were those registered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who registered the sons of Israel in the plains of Moab beside the Jordan opposite Jericho.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה פְּקוּדֵי מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר פָּקְדוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

verses.english: Among these there was no man from those registered by Moses and Aaron the priest, when they registered the sons of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.hebrew: וּבְאֵלֶּה לֹא־הָיָה אִישׁ מִפְּקוּדֵי מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר פָּקְדוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי׃

verses.english: For YHWH had said of them: They shall certainly die in the wilderness. Not one of them remained except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָמַר יְהוָה לָהֶם מוֹת יָמֻתוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר וְלֹא־נוֹתַר מֵהֶם אִישׁ כִּי אִם־כָּלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן׃

verses.english: The daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, son of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh, of the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph, came forward. His daughters' names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרַבְנָה בְּנוֹת צְלָפְחָד בֶּן־חֵפֶר בֶּן־גִּלְעָד בֶּן־מָכִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹת מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן־יוֹסֵף וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֹתָיו מַחְלָה נֹעָה וְחָגְלָה וּמִלְכָּה וְתִרְצָה׃

verses.english: They stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders, and the whole congregation at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲמֹדְנָה לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וְלִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי הַנְּשִׂיאִם וְכָל־הָעֵדָה פֶּתַח אֹהֶל־מוֹעֵד לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the congregation that assembled against YHWH in Korah's congregation; he died for his own sin, and he had no sons.
verses.hebrew: אָבִינוּ מֵת בַּמִּדְבָּר וְהוּא לֹא־הָיָה בְּתוֹךְ הָעֵדָה הַנּוֹעָדִים עַל־יְהוָה בַּעֲדַת־קֹרַח כִּי־בְחֶטְאוֹ מֵת וּבָנִים לֹא־הָיוּ לוֹ׃

verses.english: Why should our father's name be removed from his clan because he had no son? Give us a possession among our father's brothers.
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה יִגָּרַע שֵׁם־אָבִינוּ מִתּוֹךְ מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ כִּי אֵין לוֹ בֵּן תְּנָה־לָּנוּ אֲחֻזָּה בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵי אָבִינוּ׃

verses.english: Moses brought their case before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב מֹשֶׁה אֶת־מִשְׁפָּטָן לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH said to Moses:
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: The daughters of Zelophehad speak rightly. You must give them an inherited possession among their father's brothers and transfer their father's inheritance to them.
verses.hebrew: כֵּן בְּנוֹת צְלָפְחָד דֹּבְרֹת נָתֹן תִּתֵּן לָהֶם אֲחֻזַּת נַחֲלָה בְּתוֹךְ אֲחֵי אֲבִיהֶם וְהַעֲבַרְתָּ אֶת־נַחֲלַת אֲבִיהֶן לָהֶן׃

verses.english: Speak to the sons of Israel: If a man dies and has no son, you shall transfer his inheritance to his daughter.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּדַבֵּר לֵאמֹר אִישׁ כִּי־יָמוּת וּבֵן אֵין לוֹ וְהַעֲבַרְתֶּם אֶת־נַחֲלָתוֹ לְבִתּוֹ׃

verses.english: If he has no daughter, you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־אֵין לוֹ בַּת וּנְתַתֶּם אֶת־נַחֲלָתוֹ לְאֶחָיו׃

verses.english: If he has no brothers, you shall give his inheritance to his father's brothers.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־אֵין לוֹ אַחִים וּנְתַתֶּם אֶת־נַחֲלָתוֹ לַאֲחֵי אָבִיו׃

verses.english: If his father has no brothers, you shall give his inheritance to his nearest relative within his clan, and he shall possess it. This shall be a legal statute for the sons of Israel, as YHWH commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־אֵין אַחִים לְאָבִיו וּנְתַתֶּם אֶת־נַחֲלָתוֹ לִשְׁאֵרוֹ הַקָּרֹב אֵלָיו מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ וְיָרַשׁ אֹתָהּ וְהָיְתָה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְחֻקַּת מִשְׁפָּט כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: YHWH said to Moses: Go up this mountain of Abarim and see the land that I have given to the sons of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה עֲלֵה אֶל־הַר הָעֲבָרִים הַזֶּה וּרְאֵה אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: When you have seen it, you too shall be gathered to your people, as your brother Aaron was gathered,
verses.hebrew: וְרָאִיתָה אֹתָהּ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ אֶל־עַמֶּיךָ גַּם־אָתָּה כַּאֲשֶׁר נֶאֱסַף אַהֲרֹן אָחִיךָ׃

verses.english: because you rebelled against My command in the wilderness of Zin, during the congregation's dispute, concerning showing Me holy through the water before their eyes. These are the waters of Meribah at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר מְרִיתֶם פִּי בְּמִדְבַּר־צִן בִּמְרִיבַת הָעֵדָה לְהַקְדִּישֵׁנִי בַמַּיִם לְעֵינֵיהֶם הֵם מֵי־מְרִיבַת קָדֵשׁ מִדְבַּר־צִן׃

verses.english: Moses spoke to YHWH, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל־יְהוָה לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: Let YHWH, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,
verses.hebrew: יִפְקֹד יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי הָרוּחֹת לְכָל־בָּשָׂר אִישׁ עַל־הָעֵדָה׃

verses.english: who will go out before them and come in before them, who will lead them out and bring them in, so that YHWH's congregation will not be like sheep without a shepherd.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא לִפְנֵיהֶם וַאֲשֶׁר יָבֹא לִפְנֵיהֶם וַאֲשֶׁר יוֹצִיאֵם וַאֲשֶׁר יְבִיאֵם וְלֹא תִהְיֶה עֲדַת יְהוָה כַּצֹּאן אֲשֶׁר אֵין־לָהֶם רֹעֶה׃

verses.english: YHWH said to Moses: Take Joshua son of Nun, a man in whom there is spirit, and lay your hand on him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה קַח־לְךָ אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־רוּחַ בּוֹ וְסָמַכְתָּ אֶת־יָדְךָ עָלָיו׃

verses.english: Stand him before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation, and commission him before their eyes.
verses.hebrew: וְהַעֲמַדְתָּ אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי כָּל־הָעֵדָה וְצִוִּיתָה אֹתוֹ לְעֵינֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Place some of your majesty upon him, so that the whole congregation of the sons of Israel may obey.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּה מֵהוֹדְךָ עָלָיו לְמַעַן יִשְׁמְעוּ כָּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before YHWH. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in: he, all the sons of Israel with him, and the whole congregation.
verses.hebrew: וְלִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן יַעֲמֹד וְשָׁאַל לוֹ בְּמִשְׁפַּט הָאוּרִים לִפְנֵי יְהוָה עַל־פִּיו יֵצְאוּ וְעַל־פִּיו יָבֹאוּ הוּא וְכָל־בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אִתּוֹ וְכָל־הָעֵדָה׃

verses.english: Moses did as YHWH commanded him. He took Joshua and stood him before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֹתוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיַּעֲמִדֵהוּ לִפְנֵי אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְלִפְנֵי כָּל־הָעֵדָה׃

verses.english: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as YHWH had spoken through Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְמֹךְ אֶת־יָדָיו עָלָיו וַיְצַוֵּהוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: Command the sons of Israel and say to them: My offering, My food for My fire offerings, My pleasing aroma—you shall take care to present it to Me at its appointed time.
verses.hebrew: צַו אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם אֶת־קָרְבָּנִי לַחְמִי לְאִשַּׁי רֵיחַ נִיחֹחִי תִּשְׁמְרוּ לְהַקְרִיב לִי בְּמוֹעֲדוֹ׃

verses.english: Say to them: This is the fire offering you shall present to YHWH: two unblemished year-old lambs each day as a regular burnt offering.
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ לָהֶם זֶה הָאִשֶּׁה אֲשֶׁר תַּקְרִיבוּ לַיהוָה כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה תְמִימִם שְׁנַיִם לַיּוֹם עֹלָה תָמִיד׃

verses.english: Offer one lamb in the morning and the second lamb between the evenings.
verses.hebrew: אֶת־הַכֶּבֶשׂ אֶחָד תַּעֲשֶׂה בַבֹּקֶר וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם׃
