verses.english: With it offer a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with a quarter of a hin of beaten oil.
verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂירִית הָאֵיפָה סֹלֶת לְמִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בְּשֶׁמֶן כָּתִית רְבִיעִת הַהִין׃

verses.english: It is the regular burnt offering instituted at Mount Sinai, a pleasing aroma, a fire offering to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: עֹלַת תָּמִיד הָעֲשֻׂיָה בְּהַר סִינַי לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: Its drink offering shall be a quarter of a hin for each lamb. In the holy place pour out a drink offering of strong drink to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְנִסְכּוֹ רְבִיעִת הַהִין לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד בַּקֹּדֶשׁ הַסֵּךְ נֶסֶךְ שֵׁכָר לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: Offer the second lamb between the evenings. Offer it with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning, a fire offering, a pleasing aroma to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת הַכֶּבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּיִם כְּמִנְחַת הַבֹּקֶר וּכְנִסְכּוֹ תַּעֲשֶׂה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: On the Sabbath day offer two unblemished year-old lambs, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, with its drink offering.
verses.hebrew: וּבְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת שְׁנֵי־כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וְנִסְכּוֹ׃

verses.english: This is the Sabbath burnt offering for each Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.hebrew: עֹלַת שַׁבַּת בְּשַׁבַּתּוֹ עַל־עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וְנִסְכָּהּ׃

verses.english: At the beginnings of your months present a burnt offering to YHWH: two young bulls, one ram, and seven unblemished year-old lambs.
verses.hebrew: וּבְרָאשֵׁי חָדְשֵׁיכֶם תַּקְרִיבוּ עֹלָה לַיהוָה פָּרִים בְּנֵי־בָקָר שְׁנַיִם וְאַיִל אֶחָד כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה שִׁבְעָה תְּמִימִם׃

verses.english: For each bull, three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering; for each ram, two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering;
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לַפָּר הָאֶחָד וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לָאַיִל הָאֶחָד׃

verses.english: and for each lamb, a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering: a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, a fire offering to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְעִשָּׂרֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן סֹלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד עֹלָה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: Their drink offerings shall be wine: half a hin for a bull, a third of a hin for a ram, and a quarter of a hin for a lamb. This is the monthly burnt offering for each month throughout the year.
verses.hebrew: וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם חֲצִי הַהִין יִהְיֶה לַפָּר וּשְׁלִישִׁת הַהִין לָאַיִל וּרְבִיעִת הַהִין לַכֶּבֶשׂ יָיִן זֹאת עֹלַת חֹדֶשׁ בְּחָדְשׁוֹ לְחָדְשֵׁי הַשָּׁנָה׃

verses.english: One male goat shall also be offered as a sin offering to YHWH, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת לַיהוָה עַל־עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד יֵעָשֶׂה וְנִסְכּוֹ׃

verses.english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is YHWH's Passover.
verses.hebrew: וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ פֶּסַח לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: On the fifteenth day of this month is a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.
verses.hebrew: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה חָג שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מַצּוֹת יֵאָכֵל׃

verses.english: On the first day there shall be a holy assembly. You shall do no laborious work.
verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ כָּל־מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

verses.english: Present a fire offering, a burnt offering to YHWH: two young bulls, one ram, and seven year-old lambs; they shall be unblemished.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה עֹלָה לַיהוָה פָּרִים בְּנֵי־בָקָר שְׁנַיִם וְאַיִל אֶחָד וְשִׁבְעָה כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם יִהְיוּ לָכֶם׃

verses.english: Their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil: prepare three tenths of an ephah for a bull and two tenths for a ram.
verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָתָם סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאַיִל תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

verses.english: Prepare a tenth of an ephah for each of the seven lambs.
verses.hebrew: עִשָּׂרוֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן תַּעֲשֶׂה לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד לְשִׁבְעַת הַכְּבָשִׂים׃

verses.english: Offer one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׂעִיר חַטָּאת אֶחָד לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall offer these in addition to the morning burnt offering, which belongs to the regular burnt offering.
verses.hebrew: מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַבֹּקֶר אֲשֶׁר לְעֹלַת הַתָּמִיד תַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת־אֵלֶּה׃

verses.english: Offer these each day for seven days as food, a fire offering, a pleasing aroma to YHWH. They shall be offered in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.hebrew: כָּאֵלֶּה תַּעֲשׂוּ לַיּוֹם שִׁבְעַת יָמִים לֶחֶם אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ־נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָה עַל־עוֹלַת הַתָּמִיד יֵעָשֶׂה וְנִסְכּוֹ׃

verses.english: On the seventh day you shall have a holy assembly. You shall do no laborious work.
verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כָּל־מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

verses.english: On the day of firstfruits, when you present a new grain offering to YHWH at your Feast of Weeks, you shall have a holy assembly. You shall do no laborious work.
verses.hebrew: וּבְיוֹם הַבִּכּוּרִים בְּהַקְרִיבְכֶם מִנְחָה חֲדָשָׁה לַיהוָה בְּשָׁבֻעֹתֵיכֶם מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כָּל־מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

verses.english: Present a burnt offering as a pleasing aroma to YHWH: two young bulls, one ram, and seven year-old lambs.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם עוֹלָה לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָה פָּרִים בְּנֵי־בָקָר שְׁנַיִם אַיִל אֶחָד שִׁבְעָה כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה׃

verses.english: Their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths of an ephah for each bull and two tenths for each ram;
verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָתָם סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר הָאֶחָד שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאַיִל הָאֶחָד׃

verses.english: a tenth of an ephah for each of the seven lambs;
verses.hebrew: עִשָּׂרוֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד לְשִׁבְעַת הַכְּבָשִׂים׃

verses.english: and one male goat to make atonement for you.
verses.hebrew: שְׂעִיר עִזִּים אֶחָד לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall offer these in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering. They shall be unblemished, with their drink offerings.
verses.hebrew: מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתוֹ תַּעֲשׂוּ תְּמִימִם יִהְיוּ־לָכֶם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם׃

verses.english: In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall hold a holy assembly. You shall do no laborious work. It shall be a day of trumpet blasts for you.
verses.hebrew: וּבַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כָּל־מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ יוֹם תְּרוּעָה יִהְיֶה לָכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall present a burnt offering as a pleasing aroma to YHWH: one young bull, one ram, and seven unblemished year-old lambs.
verses.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם עֹלָה לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָה פַּר בֶּן־בָּקָר אֶחָד אַיִל אֶחָד כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה שִׁבְעָה תְּמִימִם׃

verses.english: Their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for the bull and two-tenths for the ram,
verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָתָם סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאָיִל׃

verses.english: and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs.
verses.hebrew: וְעִשָּׂרוֹן אֶחָד לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד לְשִׁבְעַת הַכְּבָשִׂים׃

verses.english: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you,
verses.hebrew: וּשְׂעִיר־עִזִּים אֶחָד חַטָּאת לְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: besides the monthly burnt offering and its grain offering, the regular burnt offering and its grain offering, and their drink offerings, according to their rule, as a pleasing aroma, an offering by fire to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַחֹדֶשׁ וּמִנְחָתָהּ וְעֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall hold a holy assembly. You shall humble yourselves and do no work.
verses.hebrew: וּבֶעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי הַזֶּה מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם וְעִנִּיתֶם אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם כָּל־מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

verses.english: You shall present a burnt offering to YHWH as a pleasing aroma: one young bull, one ram, and seven year-old lambs; they shall be unblemished for you.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם עֹלָה לַיהוָה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ פַּר בֶּן־בָּקָר אֶחָד אַיִל אֶחָד כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה שִׁבְעָה תְּמִימִם יִהְיוּ לָכֶם׃

verses.english: Their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for the bull and two-tenths for the one ram,
verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָתָם סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאַיִל הָאֶחָד׃

verses.english: and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs.
verses.hebrew: עִשָּׂרוֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד לְשִׁבְעַת הַכְּבָשִׂים׃

verses.english: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering, besides the sin offering of atonement, the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.hebrew: שְׂעִיר־עִזִּים אֶחָד חַטָּאת מִלְּבַד חַטַּאת הַכִּפֻּרִים וְעֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם׃

verses.english: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall hold a holy assembly. You shall do no laborious work and shall keep a festival to YHWH for seven days.
verses.hebrew: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִקְרָא־קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כָּל־מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ וְחַגֹּתֶם חַג לַיהוָה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים׃

verses.english: You shall present a burnt offering, an offering by fire, as a pleasing aroma to YHWH: thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen year-old lambs; they shall be unblemished.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם עֹלָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָה פָּרִים בְּנֵי־בָקָר שְׁלֹשָׁה עָשָׂר אֵילִם שְׁנָיִם כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר תְּמִימִם יִהְיוּ׃

verses.english: Their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for each of the thirteen bulls and two-tenths for each of the two rams,
verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָתָם סֹלֶת בְּלוּלָה בַשָּׁמֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר הָאֶחָד לִשְׁלֹשָׁה עָשָׂר פָּרִים שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאַיִל הָאֶחָד לִשְׁנֵי הָאֵילִם׃

verses.english: and one-tenth for each of the fourteen lambs.
verses.hebrew: וְעִשָּׂרוֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד לְאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר כְּבָשִׂים׃

verses.english: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׂעִיר־עִזִּים אֶחָד חַטָּאת מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד מִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכָּהּ׃

verses.english: On the second day offer twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen unblemished year-old lambs.
verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי פָּרִים בְּנֵי־בָקָר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אֵילִם שְׁנָיִם כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר תְּמִימִם׃

verses.english: Their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams, and the lambs shall be according to their number, as prescribed.
verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם לַפָּרִים לָאֵילִם וְלַכְּבָשִׂים בְּמִסְפָּרָם כַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׂעִיר־עִזִּים אֶחָד חַטָּאת מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם׃

verses.english: On the third day offer eleven bulls, two rams, and fourteen unblemished year-old lambs.
verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי פָּרִים עַשְׁתֵּי־עָשָׂר אֵילִם שְׁנָיִם כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר תְּמִימִם׃

verses.english: Their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams, and the lambs shall be according to their number, as prescribed.
verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם לַפָּרִים לָאֵילִם וְלַכְּבָשִׂים בְּמִסְפָּרָם כַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׂעִיר חַטָּאת אֶחָד מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכָּהּ׃

verses.english: On the fourth day offer ten bulls, two rams, and fourteen unblemished year-old lambs.
verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הָרְבִיעִי פָּרִים עֲשָׂרָה אֵילִם שְׁנָיִם כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר תְּמִימִם׃

verses.english: Their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams, and the lambs shall be according to their number, as prescribed.
verses.hebrew: מִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם לַפָּרִים לָאֵילִם וְלַכְּבָשִׂים בְּמִסְפָּרָם כַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׂעִיר־עִזִּים אֶחָד חַטָּאת מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד מִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכָּהּ׃

verses.english: On the fifth day offer nine bulls, two rams, and fourteen unblemished year-old lambs.
verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַחֲמִישִׁי פָּרִים תִּשְׁעָה אֵילִם שְׁנָיִם כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר תְּמִימִם׃

verses.english: Their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams, and the lambs shall be according to their number, as prescribed.
verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם לַפָּרִים לָאֵילִם וְלַכְּבָשִׂים בְּמִסְפָּרָם כַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׂעִיר חַטָּאת אֶחָד מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכָּהּ׃

verses.english: On the sixth day offer eight bulls, two rams, and fourteen unblemished year-old lambs.
verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי פָּרִים שְׁמֹנָה אֵילִם שְׁנָיִם כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר תְּמִימִם׃

verses.english: Their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams, and the lambs shall be according to their number, as prescribed.
verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם לַפָּרִים לָאֵילִם וְלַכְּבָשִׂים בְּמִסְפָּרָם כַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offerings.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׂעִיר חַטָּאת אֶחָד מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד מִנְחָתָהּ וּנְסָכֶיהָ׃

verses.english: On the seventh day offer seven bulls, two rams, and fourteen unblemished year-old lambs.
verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי פָּרִים שִׁבְעָה אֵילִם שְׁנָיִם כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר תְּמִימִם׃

verses.english: Their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, the rams, and the lambs shall be according to their number, according to their rule.
verses.hebrew: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּהֶם לַפָּרִים לָאֵילִם וְלַכְּבָשִׂים בְּמִסְפָּרָם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָם׃

verses.english: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׂעִיר חַטָּאת אֶחָד מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד מִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכָּהּ׃

verses.english: On the eighth day you shall hold a solemn assembly. You shall do no laborious work.
verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי עֲצֶרֶת תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם כָּל־מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ׃

verses.english: You shall present a burnt offering, an offering by fire, as a pleasing aroma to YHWH: one bull, one ram, and seven unblemished year-old lambs.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם עֹלָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָה פַּר אֶחָד אַיִל אֶחָד כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה שִׁבְעָה תְּמִימִם׃

verses.english: Their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bull, the ram, and the lambs shall be according to their number, as prescribed.
verses.hebrew: מִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם לַפָּר לָאַיִל וְלַכְּבָשִׂים בְּמִסְפָּרָם כַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׂעִיר חַטָּאת אֶחָד מִלְּבַד עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וּמִנְחָתָהּ וְנִסְכָּהּ׃

verses.english: You shall offer these to YHWH at your appointed times, apart from your vows and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, your grain offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה תַּעֲשׂוּ לַיהוָה בְּמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם לְבַד מִנִּדְרֵיכֶם וְנִדְבֹתֵיכֶם לְעֹלֹתֵיכֶם וּלְמִנְחֹתֵיכֶם וּלְנִסְכֵּיכֶם וּלְשַׁלְמֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: Moses told the Israelites everything that YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: Moses spoke to the heads of the Israelite tribes, saying, “This is what YHWH has commanded:
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל־רָאשֵׁי הַמַּטּוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה׃

verses.english: If a man makes a vow to YHWH or swears an oath to bind himself by an obligation, he shall not profane his word. He shall do everything that comes from his mouth.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ כִּי־יִדֹּר נֶדֶר לַיהוָה אוֹ־הִשָּׁבַע שְׁבֻעָה לֶאְסֹר אִסָּר עַל־נַפְשׁוֹ לֹא יַחֵל דְּבָרוֹ כְּכָל־הַיֹּצֵא מִפִּיו יַעֲשֶׂה׃

verses.english: If a woman makes a vow to YHWH and binds herself by an obligation while in her father’s house in her youth,
verses.hebrew: וְאִשָּׁה כִּי־תִדֹּר נֶדֶר לַיהוָה וְאָסְרָה אִסָּר בְּבֵית אָבִיהָ בִּנְעֻרֶיהָ׃

verses.english: and her father hears her vow and the obligation by which she has bound herself, but her father remains silent toward her, then all her vows shall stand, and every obligation by which she has bound herself shall stand.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַע אָבִיהָ אֶת־נִדְרָהּ וֶאֱסָרָהּ אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל־נַפְשָׁהּ וְהֶחֱרִישׁ לָהּ אָבִיהָ וְקָמוּ כָּל־נְדָרֶיהָ וְכָל־אִסָּר אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָה עַל־נַפְשָׁהּ יָקוּם׃

verses.english: But if her father disallows her on the day he hears, none of her vows or obligations by which she has bound herself shall stand. YHWH will forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־הֵנִיא אָבִיהָ אֹתָהּ בְּיוֹם שָׁמְעוֹ כָּל־נְדָרֶיהָ וֶאֱסָרֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָה עַל־נַפְשָׁהּ לֹא יָקוּם וַיהוָה יִסְלַח־לָהּ כִּי־הֵנִיא אָבִיהָ אֹתָהּ׃

verses.english: If she becomes a man’s wife while her vows are upon her, or a rash utterance of her lips by which she has bound herself,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־הָיוֹ תִהְיֶה לְאִישׁ וּנְדָרֶיהָ עָלֶיהָ אוֹ מִבְטָא שְׂפָתֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל־נַפְשָׁהּ׃

verses.english: and her husband hears, but remains silent toward her on the day he hears, then her vows shall stand, and her obligations by which she has bound herself shall stand.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַע אִישָׁהּ בְּיוֹם שָׁמְעוֹ וְהֶחֱרִישׁ לָהּ וְקָמוּ נְדָרֶיהָ וֶאֱסָרֶהָ אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָה עַל־נַפְשָׁהּ יָקֻמוּ׃

verses.english: But if her husband disallows her on the day he hears, he annuls her vow that is upon her and the utterance of her lips by which she has bound herself. YHWH will forgive her.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּיוֹם שְׁמֹעַ אִישָׁהּ יָנִיא אוֹתָהּ וְהֵפֵר אֶת־נִדְרָהּ אֲשֶׁר עָלֶיהָ וְאֵת מִבְטָא שְׂפָתֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָה עַל־נַפְשָׁהּ וַיהוָה יִסְלַח־לָהּ׃

verses.english: But every vow of a widow or a divorced woman—everything by which she has bound herself—shall stand against her.
verses.hebrew: וְנֵדֶר אַלְמָנָה וּגְרוּשָׁה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָה עַל־נַפְשָׁהּ יָקוּם עָלֶיהָ׃

verses.english: If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound herself by an obligation with an oath,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־בֵּית אִישָׁהּ נָדָרָה אוֹ־אָסְרָה אִסָּר עַל־נַפְשָׁהּ בִּשְׁבֻעָה׃

verses.english: and her husband heard, remained silent toward her, and did not disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every obligation by which she has bound herself shall stand.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַע אִישָׁהּ וְהֶחֱרִשׁ לָהּ לֹא הֵנִיא אֹתָהּ וְקָמוּ כָּל־נְדָרֶיהָ וְכָל־אִסָּר אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָה עַל־נַפְשָׁהּ יָקוּם׃

verses.english: But if her husband annuls them on the day he hears, then whatever came from her lips concerning her vows or the obligation upon herself shall not stand. Her husband has annulled them, and YHWH will forgive her.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־הָפֵר יָפֵר אֹתָם אִישָׁהּ בְּיוֹם שָׁמְעוֹ כָּל־מוֹצָא שְׂפָתֶיהָ לִנְדָרֶיהָ וּלְאִסַּר נַפְשָׁהּ לֹא יָקוּם אִישָׁהּ הֲפֵרָם וַיהוָה יִסְלַח־לָהּ׃

verses.english: Every vow and every binding oath to humble herself—her husband may establish it, or her husband may annul it.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־נֵדֶר וְכָל־שְׁבֻעַת אִסָּר לְעַנֹּת נָפֶשׁ אִישָׁהּ יְקִימֶנּוּ וְאִישָׁהּ יְפֵרֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: But if her husband remains entirely silent toward her from day to day, he establishes all her vows or all her obligations that are upon her. He has established them because he remained silent toward her on the day he heard.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־הַחֲרֵשׁ יַחֲרִישׁ לָהּ אִישָׁהּ מִיּוֹם אֶל־יוֹם וְהֵקִים אֶת־כָּל־נְדָרֶיהָ אוֹ אֶת־כָּל־אֱסָרֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר עָלֶיהָ הֵקִים אֹתָם כִּי־הֶחֱרִשׁ לָהּ בְּיוֹם שָׁמְעוֹ׃

verses.english: But if he annuls them after he has heard, he shall bear her guilt.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־הָפֵר יָפֵר אֹתָם אַחֲרֵי שָׁמְעוֹ וְנָשָׂא אֶת־עֲוֺנָהּ׃

verses.english: These are the statutes that YHWH commanded Moses between a man and his wife, and between a father and his daughter while she is in her youth in her father’s house.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הַחֻקִּים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה בֵּין אִישׁ לְאִשְׁתּוֹ בֵּין־אָב לְבִתּוֹ בִּנְעֻרֶיהָ בֵּית אָבִיהָ׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Take vengeance for the Israelites upon the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”
verses.hebrew: נְקֹם נִקְמַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֵת הַמִּדְיָנִים אַחַר תֵּאָסֵף אֶל־עַמֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for the army, that they may go against Midian to inflict YHWH’s vengeance on Midian.
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל־הָעָם לֵאמֹר הֵחָלְצוּ מֵאִתְּכֶם אֲנָשִׁים לַצָּבָא וְיִהְיוּ עַל־מִדְיָן לָתֵת נִקְמַת־יְהוָה בְּמִדְיָן׃

verses.english: You shall send a thousand from each tribe, from all the tribes of Israel, into the army.”
verses.hebrew: אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה לְכֹל מַטּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל תִּשְׁלְחוּ לַצָּבָא׃

verses.english: So a thousand from each tribe were supplied from the thousands of Israel: twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמָּסְרוּ מֵאַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף חֲלוּצֵי צָבָא׃

verses.english: Moses sent them into the army, a thousand from each tribe, together with Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest, with the sacred vessels and the alarm trumpets in his hand.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה אֶלֶף לַמַּטֶּה לַצָּבָא אֹתָם וְאֶת־פִּינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן לַצָּבָא וּכְלֵי הַקֹּדֶשׁ וַחֲצֹצְרוֹת הַתְּרוּעָה בְּיָדוֹ׃

verses.english: They waged war against Midian, as YHWH had commanded Moses, and killed every male.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְבְּאוּ עַל־מִדְיָן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה וַיַּהַרְגוּ כָּל־זָכָר׃

verses.english: They killed the kings of Midian among their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן הָרְגוּ עַל־חַלְלֵיהֶם אֶת־אֱוִי וְאֶת־רֶקֶם וְאֶת־צוּר וְאֶת־חוּר וְאֶת־רֶבַע חֲמֵשֶׁת מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן וְאֵת בִּלְעָם בֶּן־בְּעוֹר הָרְגוּ בֶּחָרֶב׃

verses.english: The Israelites took the women of Midian and their little ones captive, and plundered all their livestock, all their herds, and all their wealth.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁבּוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־נְשֵׁי מִדְיָן וְאֶת־טַפָּם וְאֵת כָּל־בְּהֶמְתָּם וְאֶת־כָּל־מִקְנֵהֶם וְאֶת־כָּל־חֵילָם בָּזָזוּ׃

verses.english: They burned all their inhabited towns and all their encampments with fire.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כָּל־עָרֵיהֶם בְּמוֹשְׁבֹתָם וְאֵת כָּל־טִירֹתָם שָׂרְפוּ בָּאֵשׁ׃

verses.english: They took all the spoil and all the captives, both people and livestock.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־כָּל־הַשָּׁלָל וְאֵת כָּל־הַמַּלְקוֹחַ בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה׃

verses.english: They brought the captives, the captured livestock, and the spoil to Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the congregation of the Israelites, at the camp on the plains of Moab by the Jordan opposite Jericho.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבִאוּ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַשְּׁבִי וְאֶת־הַמַּלְקוֹחַ וְאֶת־הַשָּׁלָל אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה אֶל־עַרְבֹת מוֹאָב אֲשֶׁר עַל־יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

verses.english: Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the congregation went out to meet them outside the camp.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְכָל־נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה לִקְרָאתָם אֶל־מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה׃

verses.english: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds who were returning from the military campaign.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְצֹף מֹשֶׁה עַל פְּקוּדֵי הֶחָיִל שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת הַבָּאִים מִצְּבָא הַמִּלְחָמָה׃

verses.english: Moses said to them, “Have you kept every female alive?
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מֹשֶׁה הַחִיִּיתֶם כָּל־נְקֵבָה׃

verses.english: Look! Through Balaam’s counsel these women caused the Israelites to act unfaithfully against YHWH in the matter of Peor, so that the plague came upon YHWH’s congregation.
verses.hebrew: הֵן הֵנָּה הָיוּ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּדְבַר בִּלְעָם לִמְסָר־מַעַל בַּיהוָה עַל־דְּבַר־פְּעוֹר וַתְּהִי הַמַּגֵּפָה בַּעֲדַת יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Now kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known a man by lying with a male.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִרְגוּ כָל־זָכָר בַּטָּף וְכָל־אִשָּׁה יֹדַעַת אִישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּב זָכָר הֲרֹגוּ׃

verses.english: But keep alive for yourselves all the young females who have not known a male’s bed.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל הַטַּף בַּנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדְעוּ מִשְׁכַּב זָכָר הַחֲיוּ לָכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall camp outside the camp for seven days. All of you who killed a person or touched someone slain shall purify yourselves on the third day and the seventh day, both you and your captives.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם חֲנוּ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים כֹּל הֹרֵג נֶפֶשׁ וְכֹל נֹגֵעַ בֶּחָלָל תִּתְחַטְּאוּ בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי אַתֶּם וּשְׁבִיכֶם׃

verses.english: You shall purify every garment, every leather article, everything made from goats’ hair, and every wooden article.”
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־בֶּגֶד וְכָל־כְּלִי־עוֹר וְכָל־מַעֲשֵׂה עִזִּים וְכָל־כְּלִי־עֵץ תִּתְחַטָּאוּ׃

verses.english: Eleazar the priest said to the men of the army who had gone into battle, “This is the statute of the instruction that YHWH commanded Moses:
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶל־אַנְשֵׁי הַצָּבָא הַבָּאִים לַמִּלְחָמָה זֹאת חֻקַּת הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: Only the gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, and lead—
verses.hebrew: אַךְ אֶת־הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַכָּסֶף אֶת־הַנְּחֹשֶׁת אֶת־הַבַּרְזֶל אֶת־הַבְּדִיל וְאֶת־הָעֹפָרֶת׃

verses.english: everything that can withstand fire you shall pass through fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless, it must be purified with the water for impurity. Everything that cannot withstand fire you shall pass through water.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־יָבֹא בָאֵשׁ תַּעֲבִירוּ בָאֵשׁ וְטָהֵר אַךְ בְּמֵי נִדָּה יִתְחַטָּא וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָבֹא בָּאֵשׁ תַּעֲבִירוּ בַמָּיִם׃

verses.english: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day and be clean; afterward you may enter the camp.”
verses.hebrew: וְכִבַּסְתֶּם בִּגְדֵיכֶם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וּטְהַרְתֶּם וְאַחַר תָּבֹאוּ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה׃

verses.english: YHWH said to Moses,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Take a count of the captured spoil, both people and livestock—you, Eleazar the priest, and the ancestral heads of the congregation.
verses.hebrew: שָׂא אֵת רֹאשׁ מַלְקוֹחַ הַשְּׁבִי בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה אַתָּה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְרָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הָעֵדָה׃

verses.english: Divide the captured spoil equally between the warriors who went out to battle and the whole congregation.
verses.hebrew: וְחָצִיתָ אֶת־הַמַּלְקוֹחַ בֵּין תֹּפְשֵׂי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַיֹּצְאִים לַצָּבָא וּבֵין כָּל־הָעֵדָה׃

verses.english: Levy a tribute for YHWH from the warriors who went out to battle: one living being out of every five hundred, from the people, cattle, donkeys, and flocks.
verses.hebrew: וַהֲרֵמֹתָ מֶכֶס לַיהוָה מֵאֵת אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה הַיֹּצְאִים לַצָּבָא אֶחָד נֶפֶשׁ מֵחֲמֵשׁ הַמֵּאוֹת מִן־הָאָדָם וּמִן־הַבָּקָר וּמִן־הַחֲמֹרִים וּמִן־הַצֹּאן׃

verses.english: Take it from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest as YHWH’s contribution.
verses.hebrew: מִמַּחֲצִיתָם תִּקָּחוּ וְנָתַתָּה לְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן תְּרוּמַת יְהוָה׃

verses.english: From the Israelites’ half, take one out of every fifty, from the people, cattle, donkeys, flocks, and all livestock, and give them to the Levites who keep the charge of YHWH’s tabernacle.”
verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּחֲצִת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל תִּקַּח אֶחָד אָחֻז מִן־הַחֲמִשִּׁים מִן־הָאָדָם מִן־הַבָּקָר מִן־הַחֲמֹרִים וּמִן־הַצֹּאן מִכָּל־הַבְּהֵמָה וְנָתַתָּה אֹתָם לַלְוִיִּם שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת מִשְׁכַּן יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: The captured spoil remaining from the plunder that the army had taken was six hundred seventy-five thousand of the flocks,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַמַּלְקוֹחַ יֶתֶר הַבָּז אֲשֶׁר בָּזְזוּ עַם הַצָּבָא צֹאן שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וְשִׁבְעִים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשֶׁת־אֲלָפִים׃

verses.english: seventy-two thousand cattle,
verses.hebrew: וּבָקָר שְׁנַיִם וְשִׁבְעִים אָלֶף׃

verses.english: sixty-one thousand donkeys,
verses.hebrew: וַחֲמֹרִים אֶחָד וְשִׁשִּׁים אָלֶף׃

verses.english: and thirty-two thousand human beings in all, from the women who had not known a male’s bed.
verses.hebrew: וְנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם מִן־הַנָּשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדְעוּ מִשְׁכַּב זָכָר כָּל־נֶפֶשׁ שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף׃

verses.english: The half-share belonging to those who went out to battle numbered three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred of the flocks,
verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי הַמֶּחֱצָה חֵלֶק הַיֹּצְאִים בַּצָּבָא מִסְפַּר הַצֹּאן שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וְשִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: and YHWH’s tribute from the flocks was six hundred seventy-five.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי הַמֶּכֶס לַיהוָה מִן־הַצֹּאן שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת חָמֵשׁ וְשִׁבְעִים׃

verses.english: The cattle numbered thirty-six thousand, and their tribute to YHWH was seventy-two.
verses.hebrew: וְהַבָּקָר שִׁשָּׁה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף וּמִכְסָם לַיהוָה שְׁנַיִם וְשִׁבְעִים׃

verses.english: The donkeys numbered thirty thousand five hundred, and their tribute to YHWH was sixty-one.
verses.hebrew: וַחֲמֹרִים שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וּמִכְסָם לַיהוָה אֶחָד וְשִׁשִּׁים׃

verses.english: The human beings numbered sixteen thousand, and their tribute to YHWH was thirty-two persons.
verses.hebrew: וְנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר אָלֶף וּמִכְסָם לַיהוָה שְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁים נָפֶשׁ׃

verses.english: Moses gave the tribute, YHWH’s contribution, to Eleazar the priest, as YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה אֶת־מֶכֶס תְּרוּמַת יְהוָה לְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: From the Israelites’ half, which Moses had separated from that of the men who fought—
verses.hebrew: וּמִמַּחֲצִית בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר חָצָה מֹשֶׁה מִן־הָאֲנָשִׁים הַצֹּבְאִים׃

verses.english: the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred of the flocks,
verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי מֶחֱצַת הָעֵדָה מִן־הַצֹּאן שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: thirty-six thousand cattle,
verses.hebrew: וּבָקָר שִׁשָּׁה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אָלֶף׃

verses.english: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,
verses.hebrew: וַחֲמֹרִים שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף וַחֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת׃

verses.english: and sixteen thousand human beings—
verses.hebrew: וְנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר אָלֶף׃

verses.english: From the Israelites’ half, Moses took one out of every fifty people and animals. He gave them to the Levites who kept charge of YHWH’s tabernacle, as YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה מִמַּחֲצִת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הָאָחֻז אֶחָד מִן־הַחֲמִשִּׁים מִן־הָאָדָם וּמִן־הַבְּהֵמָה וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָם לַלְוִיִּם שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁמֶרֶת מִשְׁכַּן יְהוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: The officers over the thousands of the army, the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds, approached Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְבוּ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה הַפְּקֻדִים אֲשֶׁר לְאַלְפֵי הַצָּבָא שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְשָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת׃

verses.english: They said to Moses, “Your servants have counted the warriors under our command, and not one man of ours is missing.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה עֲבָדֶיךָ נָשְׂאוּ אֶת־רֹאשׁ אַנְשֵׁי הַמִּלְחָמָה אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדֵנוּ וְלֹא־נִפְקַד מִמֶּנּוּ אִישׁ׃

verses.english: So we have brought YHWH’s offering, each man whatever gold article he found—armlets, bracelets, rings, earrings, and ornaments—to make atonement for our lives before YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: וַנַּקְרֵב אֶת־קָרְבַּן יְהוָה אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר מָצָא כְלִי־זָהָב אֶצְעָדָה וְצָמִיד טַבַּעַת עָגִיל וְכוּמָז לְכַפֵּר עַל־נַפְשֹׁתֵינוּ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from them, all of it fashioned articles.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַזָּהָב מֵאִתָּם כֹּל כְּלִי מַעֲשֶׂה׃

verses.english: All the gold of the contribution that they presented to YHWH from the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כָּל־זְהַב הַתְּרוּמָה אֲשֶׁר הֵרִימוּ לַיהוָה שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר אֶלֶף שְׁבַע־מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁקֶל מֵאֵת שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וּמֵאֵת שָׂרֵי הַמֵּאוֹת׃

verses.english: The soldiers had taken plunder, each for himself.
verses.hebrew: אַנְשֵׁי הַצָּבָא בָּזְזוּ אִישׁ לוֹ׃

verses.english: Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting as a memorial for the Israelites before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה וְאֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת־הַזָּהָב מֵאֵת שָׂרֵי הָאֲלָפִים וְהַמֵּאוֹת וַיָּבִאוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד זִכָּרוֹן לִבְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: The Reubenites and Gadites had very abundant livestock. They saw the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead, and the region was suitable for livestock.
verses.hebrew: וּמִקְנֶה רַב הָיָה לִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן וְלִבְנֵי־גָד עָצוּם מְאֹד וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת־אֶרֶץ יַעְזֵר וְאֶת־אֶרֶץ גִּלְעָד וְהִנֵּה הַמָּקוֹם מְקוֹם מִקְנֶה׃

verses.english: The Gadites and Reubenites came and said to Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the leaders of the congregation,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹאוּ בְנֵי־גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל־אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֶל־נְשִׂיאֵי הָעֵדָה לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon—
verses.hebrew: עֲטָרוֹת וְדִיבֹן וְיַעְזֵר וְנִמְרָה וְחֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶלְעָלֵה וּשְׂבָם וּנְבוֹ וּבְעֹן׃

verses.english: the land that YHWH struck down before the congregation of Israel—is land for livestock, and your servants have livestock.”
verses.hebrew: הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה יְהוָה לִפְנֵי עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶרֶץ מִקְנֶה הִוא וְלַעֲבָדֶיךָ מִקְנֶה׃

verses.english: They said, “If we have found favor in your eyes, let this land be given to your servants as a possession. Do not make us cross the Jordan.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִם־מָצָאנוּ חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ יֻתַּן אֶת־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לַעֲבָדֶיךָ לַאֲחֻזָּה אַל־תַּעֲבִרֵנוּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃

verses.english: Moses said to the Gadites and Reubenites, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לִבְנֵי־גָד וְלִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן הַאַחֵיכֶם יָבֹאוּ לַמִּלְחָמָה וְאַתֶּם תֵּשְׁבוּ פֹה׃

verses.english: Why do you discourage the hearts of the Israelites from crossing into the land that YHWH has given them?
verses.hebrew: וְלָמָּה תנואון [תְנִיאוּן] אֶת־לֵב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעֲבֹר אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן לָהֶם יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Your fathers did this when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to inspect the land.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתֵיכֶם בְּשָׁלְחִי אֹתָם מִקָּדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ לִרְאוֹת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: They went up to the Wadi Eshcol and inspected the land, but discouraged the hearts of the Israelites so that they would not enter the land that YHWH had given them.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ עַד־נַחַל אֶשְׁכּוֹל וַיִּרְאוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּנִיאוּ אֶת־לֵב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְבִלְתִּי־בֹא אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן לָהֶם יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH’s anger burned on that day, and He swore, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּשָּׁבַע לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: ‘Surely none of the men who came up from Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the ground that I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, because they have not followed Me wholeheartedly,
verses.hebrew: אִם־יִרְאוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים הָעֹלִים מִמִּצְרַיִם מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה אֵת הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב כִּי לֹא־מִלְאוּ אַחֲרָי׃

verses.english: except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun, because they have followed YHWH wholeheartedly.’
verses.hebrew: בִּלְתִּי כָּלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה הַקְּנִזִּי וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן כִּי מִלְאוּ אַחֲרֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: YHWH’s anger burned against Israel, and He made them wander in the wilderness for forty years, until the whole generation that did evil in YHWH’s eyes had come to an end.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְנִעֵם בַּמִּדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה עַד־תֹּם כָּל־הַדּוֹר הָעֹשֶׂה הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Now look! You have risen in your fathers’ place, a brood of sinful men, to add still more to YHWH’s burning anger against Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה קַמְתֶּם תַּחַת אֲבֹתֵיכֶם תַּרְבּוּת אֲנָשִׁים חַטָּאִים לִסְפּוֹת עוֹד עַל חֲרוֹן אַף־יְהוָה אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: If you turn back from following Him, He will again leave them in the wilderness, and you will destroy this whole people.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי תְשׁוּבֻן מֵאַחֲרָיו וְיָסַף עוֹד לְהַנִּיחוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר וְשִׁחַתֶּם לְכָל־הָעָם הַזֶּה׃

verses.english: They approached him and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock and towns for our little ones.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמְרוּ גִּדְרֹת צֹאן נִבְנֶה לְמִקְנֵנוּ פֹּה וְעָרִים לְטַפֵּנוּ׃

verses.english: But we will arm ourselves and go swiftly before the Israelites until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones will live in fortified towns because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנַחְנוּ נֵחָלֵץ חֻשִׁים לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד אֲשֶׁר אִם־הֲבִיאֹנֻם אֶל־מְקוֹמָם וְיָשַׁב טַפֵּנוּ בְּעָרֵי הַמִּבְצָר מִפְּנֵי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: We will not return to our homes until each Israelite has received his inheritance.
verses.hebrew: לֹא נָשׁוּב אֶל־בָּתֵּינוּ עַד הִתְנַחֵל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ נַחֲלָתוֹ׃

verses.english: For we will not inherit with them across the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on the eastern side of the Jordan.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא נִנְחַל אִתָּם מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן וָהָלְאָה כִּי בָאָה נַחֲלָתֵנוּ אֵלֵינוּ מֵעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן מִזְרָחָה׃

verses.english: Moses said to them, “If you do this, if you arm yourselves before YHWH for war,
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מֹשֶׁה אִם־תַּעֲשׂוּן אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אִם־תֵּחָלְצוּ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה לַמִּלְחָמָה׃

verses.english: and every armed man among you crosses the Jordan before YHWH until He has dispossessed His enemies before Him,
verses.hebrew: וְעָבַר לָכֶם כָּל־חָלוּץ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן לִפְנֵי יְהוָה עַד הוֹרִישׁוֹ אֶת־אֹיְבָיו מִפָּנָיו׃

verses.english: and the land is subdued before YHWH, then afterward you may return. You will be free of obligation toward YHWH and Israel, and this land shall be your possession before YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְנִכְבְּשָׁה הָאָרֶץ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְאַחַר תָּשֻׁבוּ וִהְיִיתֶם נְקִיִּים מֵיְהוָה וּמִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וְהָיְתָה הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לָכֶם לַאֲחֻזָּה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: But if you do not do so, you will have sinned against YHWH; know that your sin will find you out.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא תַעֲשׂוּן כֵּן הִנֵּה חֲטָאתֶם לַיהוָה וּדְעוּ חַטַּאתְכֶם אֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא אֶתְכֶם׃

verses.english: Build towns for your little ones and folds for your flocks, and do what has come from your mouth.”
verses.hebrew: בְּנוּ־לָכֶם עָרִים לְטַפְּכֶם וּגְדֵרֹת לְצֹנַאֲכֶם וְהַיֹּצֵא מִפִּיכֶם תַּעֲשׂוּ׃

verses.english: The Gadites and Reubenites said to Moses, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בְּנֵי־גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵאמֹר עֲבָדֶיךָ יַעֲשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲדֹנִי מְצַוֶּה׃

verses.english: Our little ones, our wives, our herds, and all our livestock will remain there in the towns of Gilead.
verses.hebrew: טַפֵּנוּ נָשֵׁינוּ מִקְנֵנוּ וְכָל־בְּהֶמְתֵּנוּ יִהְיוּ־שָׁם בְּעָרֵי הַגִּלְעָד׃

verses.english: But your servants will cross over, everyone armed for the army, before YHWH for war, as my lord says.”
verses.hebrew: וַעֲבָדֶיךָ יַעַבְרוּ כָּל־חֲלוּץ צָבָא לִפְנֵי יְהוָה לַמִּלְחָמָה כַּאֲשֶׁר אֲדֹנִי דֹּבֵר׃

verses.english: Moses gave instructions concerning them to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the ancestral heads of the Israelite tribes.
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה אֵת אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וְאֵת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְאֶת־רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Moses said to them, “If the Gadites and Reubenites cross the Jordan with you, everyone armed for war before YHWH, and the land is subdued before you, give them the land of Gilead as a possession.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֲלֵהֶם אִם־יַעַבְרוּ בְנֵי־גָד וּבְנֵי־רְאוּבֵן אִתְּכֶם אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן כָּל־חָלוּץ לַמִּלְחָמָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה וְנִכְבְּשָׁה הָאָרֶץ לִפְנֵיכֶם וּנְתַתֶּם לָהֶם אֶת־אֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד לַאֲחֻזָּה׃

verses.english: But if they do not cross over armed with you, they shall receive a possession among you in the land of Canaan.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא יַעַבְרוּ חֲלוּצִים אִתְּכֶם וְנֹאחֲזוּ בְתֹכְכֶם בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

verses.english: The Gadites and Reubenites answered, “What YHWH has spoken to your servants, we will do.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְנֵי־גָד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן לֵאמֹר אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֶל־עֲבָדֶיךָ כֵּן נַעֲשֶׂה׃

verses.english: We will cross over armed before YHWH into the land of Canaan, while our inherited possession remains with us on this side of the Jordan.”
verses.hebrew: נַחְנוּ נַעֲבֹר חֲלוּצִים לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְאִתָּנוּ אֲחֻזַּת נַחֲלָתֵנוּ מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן׃

verses.english: Moses gave to the Gadites, the Reubenites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan: the land with its towns and their territories, the towns of the surrounding land.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם מֹשֶׁה לִבְנֵי־גָד וְלִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן־יוֹסֵף אֶת־מַמְלֶכֶת סִיחֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי וְאֶת־מַמְלֶכֶת עוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן הָאָרֶץ לְעָרֶיהָ בִּגְבֻלֹת עָרֵי הָאָרֶץ סָבִיב׃

verses.english: The Gadites built Dibon, Ataroth, and Aroer,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְנוּ בְנֵי־גָד אֶת־דִּיבֹן וְאֶת־עֲטָרֹת וְאֵת עֲרֹעֵר׃

verses.english: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, and Jogbehah,
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־עַטְרֹת שׁוֹפָן וְאֶת־יַעְזֵר וְיָגְבֳּהָה׃

verses.english: Beth-nimrah and Beth-haran, fortified towns and sheepfolds.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בֵּית נִמְרָה וְאֶת־בֵּית הָרָן עָרֵי מִבְצָר וְגִדְרֹת צֹאן׃

verses.english: The Reubenites built Heshbon, Elealeh, and Kiriathaim,
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן בָּנוּ אֶת־חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶת־אֶלְעָלֵא וְאֵת קִרְיָתָיִם׃

verses.english: Nebo and Baal-meon, their names being changed, and Sibmah. They gave names to the towns they built.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־נְבוֹ וְאֶת־בַּעַל מְעוֹן מוּסַבֹּת שֵׁם וְאֶת־שִׂבְמָה וַיִּקְרְאוּ בְשֵׁמֹת אֶת־שְׁמוֹת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר בָּנוּ׃

verses.english: The descendants of Machir son of Manasseh went to Gilead and captured it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were there.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ בְּנֵי מָכִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה גִּלְעָדָה וַיִּלְכְּדֻהָ וַיּוֹרֶשׁ אֶת־הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ׃

verses.english: Moses gave Gilead to Machir son of Manasseh, and he settled in it.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה אֶת־הַגִּלְעָד לְמָכִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה וַיֵּשֶׁב בָּהּ׃

verses.english: Jair son of Manasseh went and captured their villages, and called them Havvoth-jair.
verses.hebrew: וְיָאִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה הָלַךְ וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־חַוֺּתֵיהֶם וַיִּקְרָא אֶתְהֶן חַוֺּת יָאִיר׃

verses.english: Nobah went and captured Kenath and its dependent towns, and called it Nobah after his own name.
verses.hebrew: וְנֹבַח הָלַךְ וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־קְנָת וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶיהָ וַיִּקְרָא לָה נֹבַח בִּשְׁמוֹ׃

verses.english: These are the stages of the Israelites, who came out of the land of Egypt by their companies under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה מַסְעֵי בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לְצִבְאֹתָם בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן׃

verses.english: Moses recorded their departures by their stages at YHWH’s command. These are their stages according to their departures.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֶת־מוֹצָאֵיהֶם לְמַסְעֵיהֶם עַל־פִּי יְהוָה וְאֵלֶּה מַסְעֵיהֶם לְמוֹצָאֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: They set out from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month. On the day after the Passover, the Israelites went out with a high hand in the sight of all Egypt,
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרַעְמְסֵס בַּחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן מִמָּחֳרַת הַפֶּסַח יָצְאוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיָד רָמָה לְעֵינֵי כָּל־מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn whom YHWH had struck down among them. YHWH had also executed judgments against their gods.
verses.hebrew: וּמִצְרַיִם מְקַבְּרִים אֵת אֲשֶׁר הִכָּה יְהוָה בָּהֶם כָּל־בְּכוֹר וּבֵאלֹהֵיהֶם עָשָׂה יְהוָה שְׁפָטִים׃

verses.english: The Israelites set out from Rameses and camped at Succoth.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵרַעְמְסֵס וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּסֻכֹּת׃

verses.english: They set out from Succoth and camped at Etham, which is at the edge of the wilderness.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִסֻּכֹּת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְאֵתָם אֲשֶׁר בִּקְצֵה הַמִּדְבָּר׃

verses.english: They set out from Etham and turned back toward Pi-hahiroth, which is opposite Baal-zephon, and camped before Migdol.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֵתָם וַיָּשָׁב עַל־פִּי הַחִירֹת אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי בַּעַל צְפוֹן וַיַּחֲנוּ לִפְנֵי מִגְדֹּל׃

verses.english: They set out from before Hahiroth and crossed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness. They traveled three days through the wilderness of Etham and camped at Marah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִפְּנֵי הַחִירֹת וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְתוֹךְ־הַיָּם הַמִּדְבָּרָה וַיֵּלְכוּ דֶּרֶךְ שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים בְּמִדְבַּר אֵתָם וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמָרָה׃

verses.english: They set out from Marah and came to Elim. At Elim were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמָּרָה וַיָּבֹאוּ אֵילִמָה וּבְאֵילִם שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה עֵינֹת מַיִם וְשִׁבְעִים תְּמָרִים וַיַּחֲנוּ־שָׁם׃

verses.english: They set out from Elim and camped by the Sea of Reeds.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֵילִם וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל־יַם־סוּף׃

verses.english: They set out from the Sea of Reeds and camped in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִיַּם־סוּף וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמִדְבַּר־סִין׃

verses.english: They set out from the wilderness of Sin and camped at Dophkah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמִּדְבַּר־סִין וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּדָפְקָה׃

verses.english: They set out from Dophkah and camped at Alush.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִדָּפְקָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּאָלוּשׁ׃

verses.english: They set out from Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאָלוּשׁ וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּרְפִידִם וְלֹא־הָיָה שָׁם מַיִם לָעָם לִשְׁתּוֹת׃

verses.english: They set out from Rephidim and camped in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרְפִידִם וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי׃

verses.english: They set out from the wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמִּדְבַּר סִינָי וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּקִבְרֹת הַתַּאֲוָה׃

verses.english: They set out from Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִקִּבְרֹת הַתַּאֲוָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּחֲצֵרֹת׃

verses.english: They set out from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵחֲצֵרֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּרִתְמָה׃

verses.english: They set out from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-perez.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרִתְמָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּרִמֹּן פָּרֶץ׃

verses.english: They set out from Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרִמֹּן פָּרֶץ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּלִבְנָה׃

verses.english: They set out from Libnah and camped at Rissah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִלִּבְנָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּרִסָּה׃

verses.english: They set out from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵרִסָּה וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּקְהֵלָתָה׃

verses.english: They set out from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִקְּהֵלָתָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּהַר־שָׁפֶר׃

verses.english: They set out from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהַר־שָׁפֶר וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּחֲרָדָה׃

verses.english: They set out from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵחֲרָדָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמַקְהֵלֹת׃

verses.english: They set out from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמַּקְהֵלֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּתָחַת׃

verses.english: They set out from Tahath and camped at Terah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִתָּחַת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּתָרַח׃

verses.english: They set out from Terah and camped at Mithkah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִתָּרַח וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמִתְקָה׃

verses.english: They set out from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמִּתְקָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּחַשְׁמֹנָה׃

verses.english: They set out from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵחַשְׁמֹנָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמֹסֵרוֹת׃

verses.english: They set out from Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִמֹּסֵרוֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּבְנֵי יַעֲקָן׃

verses.english: They set out from Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִבְּנֵי יַעֲקָן וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּחֹר הַגִּדְגָּד׃

verses.english: They set out from Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵחֹר הַגִּדְגָּד וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּיָטְבָתָה׃

verses.english: They set out from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִיָּטְבָתָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַבְרֹנָה׃

verses.english: They set out from Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעַבְרֹנָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעֶצְיוֹן גָּבֶר׃

verses.english: They set out from Ezion-geber and camped in the wilderness of Zin, that is, Kadesh.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעֶצְיוֹן גָּבֶר וַיַּחֲנוּ בְמִדְבַּר־צִן הִוא קָדֵשׁ׃

verses.english: They set out from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, at the edge of the land of Edom.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִקָּדֵשׁ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּהֹר הָהָר בִּקְצֵה אֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם׃

verses.english: Aaron the priest went up Mount Hor at YHWH’s command and died there in the fortieth year after the Israelites came out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן אֶל־הֹר הָהָר עַל־פִּי יְהוָה וַיָּמָת שָׁם בִּשְׁנַת הָאַרְבָּעִים לְצֵאת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died on Mount Hor.
verses.hebrew: וְאַהֲרֹן בֶּן־שָׁלֹשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה בְּמֹתוֹ בְּהֹר הָהָר׃

verses.english: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev in the land of Canaan, heard of the Israelites’ coming.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע הַכְּנַעֲנִי מֶלֶךְ עֲרָד וְהוּא־יֹשֵׁב בַּנֶּגֶב בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן בְּבֹא בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: They set out from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהֹר הָהָר וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּצַלְמֹנָה׃

verses.english: They set out from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִצַּלְמֹנָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּפוּנֹן׃

verses.english: They set out from Punon and camped at Oboth.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִפּוּנֹן וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּאֹבֹת׃

verses.english: They set out from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim, on the border of Moab.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵאֹבֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעִיֵּי הָעֲבָרִים בִּגְבוּל מוֹאָב׃

verses.english: They set out from Iyim and camped at Dibon-gad.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעִיִּים וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּדִיבֹן גָּד׃

verses.english: They set out from Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִדִּיבֹן גָּד וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַלְמֹן דִּבְלָתָיְמָה׃

verses.english: They set out from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵעַלְמֹן דִּבְלָתָיְמָה וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּהָרֵי הָעֲבָרִים לִפְנֵי נְבוֹ׃

verses.english: They set out from the mountains of Abarim and camped on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan opposite Jericho.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מֵהָרֵי הָעֲבָרִים וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃

verses.english: They camped by the Jordan from Beth-jeshimoth to Abel-shittim, on the plains of Moab.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל־הַיַּרְדֵּן מִבֵּית הַיְשִׁמֹת עַד אָבֵל הַשִּׁטִּים בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan opposite Jericho, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל־יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן אֶל־אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

verses.english: you shall dispossess all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their figured images, destroy all their cast images, and demolish all their high places.
verses.hebrew: וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם אֶת־כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְאִבַּדְתֶּם אֵת כָּל־מַשְׂכִּיֹּתָם וְאֵת כָּל־צַלְמֵי מַסֵּכֹתָם תְּאַבֵּדוּ וְאֵת כָּל־בָּמֹתָם תַּשְׁמִידוּ׃

verses.english: You shall take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given you the land to possess.
verses.hebrew: וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וִישַׁבְתֶּם־בָּהּ כִּי לָכֶם נָתַתִּי אֶת־הָאָרֶץ לָרֶשֶׁת אֹתָהּ׃

verses.english: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your clans. Give a larger inheritance to the larger group and a smaller inheritance to the smaller group. Wherever the lot falls for anyone shall be his. You shall inherit according to your ancestral tribes.
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְנַחַלְתֶּם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ בְּגוֹרָל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתֵיכֶם לָרַב תַּרְבּוּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתוֹ וְלַמְעַט תַּמְעִיט אֶת־נַחֲלָתוֹ אֶל אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא לוֹ שָׁמָּה הַגּוֹרָל לוֹ יִהְיֶה לְמַטּוֹת אֲבֹתֵיכֶם תִּתְנֶחָלוּ׃

verses.english: But if you do not dispossess the inhabitants of the land from before you, those whom you leave will become barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides, and they will trouble you in the land where you settle.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא תוֹרִישׁוּ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְהָיָה אֲשֶׁר תּוֹתִירוּ מֵהֶם לְשִׂכִּים בְּעֵינֵיכֶם וְלִצְנִינִם בְּצִדֵּיכֶם וְצָרֲרוּ אֶתְכֶם עַל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יֹשְׁבִים בָּהּ׃

verses.english: Then I will do to you what I intended to do to them.”
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּמִּיתִי לַעֲשׂוֹת לָהֶם אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Command the Israelites and say to them: When you enter the land of Canaan, this is the land that shall fall to you as an inheritance, the land of Canaan within its boundaries.
verses.hebrew: צַו אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי־אַתֶּם בָּאִים אֶל־הָאָרֶץ כְּנָעַן זֹאת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּפֹּל לָכֶם בְּנַחֲלָה אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לִגְבֻלֹתֶיהָ׃

verses.english: Your southern side shall run from the wilderness of Zin alongside Edom. Your southern boundary shall begin at the eastern end of the Salt Sea.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה לָכֶם פְּאַת־נֶגֶב מִמִּדְבַּר־צִן עַל־יְדֵי אֱדוֹם וְהָיָה לָכֶם גְּבוּל נֶגֶב מִקְצֵה יָם־הַמֶּלַח קֵדְמָה׃

verses.english: Your boundary shall turn south of the Ascent of Akrabbim and pass toward Zin. Its endpoint shall be south of Kadesh-barnea; it shall extend to Hazar-addar and pass toward Azmon.
verses.hebrew: וְנָסַב לָכֶם הַגְּבוּל מִנֶּגֶב לְמַעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים וְעָבַר צִנָה והיה [וְהָיוּ] תּוֹצְאֹתָיו מִנֶּגֶב לְקָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵעַ וְיָצָא חֲצַר־אַדָּר וְעָבַר עַצְמֹנָה׃

verses.english: The boundary shall turn from Azmon toward the Wadi of Egypt, and its endpoint shall be the sea.
verses.hebrew: וְנָסַב הַגְּבוּל מֵעַצְמוֹן נַחְלָה מִצְרָיִם וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו הַיָּמָּה׃

verses.english: For your western boundary, you shall have the Great Sea as the boundary. This shall be your western boundary.
verses.hebrew: וּגְבוּל יָם וְהָיָה לָכֶם הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל וּגְבוּל זֶה־יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל יָם׃

verses.english: This shall be your northern boundary: from the Great Sea mark out a line to Mount Hor.
verses.hebrew: וְזֶה־יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל צָפוֹן מִן־הַיָּם הַגָּדֹל תְּתָאוּ לָכֶם הֹר הָהָר׃

verses.english: From Mount Hor mark out a line to Lebo-hamath, and the boundary’s endpoint shall be Zedad.
verses.hebrew: מֵהֹר הָהָר תְּתָאוּ לְבֹא חֲמָת וְהָיוּ תּוֹצְאֹת הַגְּבֻל צְדָדָה׃

verses.english: The boundary shall extend to Ziphron, and its endpoint shall be Hazar-enan. This shall be your northern boundary.
verses.hebrew: וְיָצָא הַגְּבֻל זִפְרֹנָה וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו חֲצַר עֵינָן זֶה־יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל צָפוֹן׃

verses.english: Mark out your eastern boundary from Hazar-enan to Shepham.
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְאַוִּיתֶם לָכֶם לִגְבוּל קֵדְמָה מֵחֲצַר עֵינָן שְׁפָמָה׃

verses.english: The boundary shall descend from Shepham to Riblah, east of Ain. The boundary shall descend and touch the eastern slope of the Sea of Chinnereth.
verses.hebrew: וְיָרַד הַגְּבֻל מִשְּׁפָם הָרִבְלָה מִקֶּדֶם לָעָיִן וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל וּמָחָה עַל־כֶּתֶף יָם־כִּנֶּרֶת קֵדְמָה׃

verses.english: The boundary shall descend to the Jordan, and its endpoint shall be the Salt Sea. This shall be your land within its surrounding boundaries.”
verses.hebrew: וְיָרַד הַגְּבוּל הַיַּרְדֵּנָה וְהָיוּ תוֹצְאֹתָיו יָם הַמֶּלַח זֹאת תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם הָאָרֶץ לִגְבֻלֹתֶיהָ סָבִיב׃

verses.english: Moses commanded the Israelites, saying, “This is the land that you shall inherit by lot, which YHWH commanded to be given to the nine tribes and the half-tribe.
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר זֹאת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תִּתְנַחֲלוּ אֹתָהּ בְּגוֹרָל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה לָתֵת לְתִשְׁעַת הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה׃

verses.english: For the tribe of the Reubenites according to their ancestral houses, the tribe of the Gadites according to their ancestral houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לָקְחוּ מַטֵּה בְנֵי הָראוּבֵנִי לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם וּמַטֵּה בְנֵי־הַגָּדִי לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם וַחֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם׃

verses.english: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance across the Jordan opposite Jericho, eastward, toward the sunrise.”
verses.hebrew: שְׁנֵי הַמַּטּוֹת וַחֲצִי הַמַּטֶּה לָקְחוּ נַחֲלָתָם מֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ קֵדְמָה מִזְרָחָה׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: “These are the names of the men who shall take possession of the land for you: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־יִנְחֲלוּ לָכֶם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֶלְעָזָר הַכֹּהֵן וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן׃

verses.english: Take one leader from each tribe to take possession of the land.
verses.hebrew: וְנָשִׂיא אֶחָד נָשִׂיא אֶחָד מִמַּטֶּה תִּקְחוּ לִנְחֹל אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: These are the names of the men: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה כָּלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה׃

verses.english: from the tribe of the Simeonites, Shemuel son of Ammihud;
verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְּנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן שְׁמוּאֵל בֶּן־עַמִּיהוּד׃

verses.english: from the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad son of Chislon;
verses.hebrew: לְמַטֵּה בִנְיָמִן אֱלִידָד בֶּן־כִּסְלוֹן׃

verses.english: from the tribe of the Danites, the leader Bukki son of Jogli;
verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־דָן נָשִׂיא בֻּקִּי בֶּן־יָגְלִי׃

verses.english: from the descendants of Joseph, from the tribe of the Manassites, the leader Hanniel son of Ephod;
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי יוֹסֵף לְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה נָשִׂיא חַנִּיאֵל בֶּן־אֵפֹד׃

verses.english: from the tribe of the Ephraimites, the leader Kemuel son of Shiphtan;
verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־אֶפְרַיִם נָשִׂיא קְמוּאֵל בֶּן־שִׁפְטָן׃

verses.english: from the tribe of the Zebulunites, the leader Elizaphan son of Parnach;
verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־זְבוּלֻן נָשִׂיא אֱלִיצָפָן בֶּן־פַּרְנָךְ׃

verses.english: from the tribe of the Issacharites, the leader Paltiel son of Azzan;
verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־יִשָׂשכָר נָשִׂיא פַּלְטִיאֵל בֶּן־עַזָּן׃

verses.english: from the tribe of the Asherites, the leader Ahihud son of Shelomi;
verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־אָשֵׁר נָשִׂיא אֲחִיהוּד בֶּן־שְׁלֹמִי׃

verses.english: from the tribe of the Naphtalites, the leader Pedahel son of Ammihud.”
verses.hebrew: וּלְמַטֵּה בְנֵי־נַפְתָּלִי נָשִׂיא פְּדַהְאֵל בֶּן־עַמִּיהוּד׃

verses.english: These are the men whom YHWH commanded to assign the Israelites their inheritance in the land of Canaan.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה לְנַחֵל אֶת־בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan opposite Jericho, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל־יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Command the Israelites to give the Levites towns to live in from their inherited possession. You shall also give the Levites pasturelands around the towns.
verses.hebrew: צַו אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנָתְנוּ לַלְוִיִּם מִנַּחֲלַת אֲחֻזָּתָם עָרִים לָשָׁבֶת וּמִגְרָשׁ לֶעָרִים סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶם תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם׃

verses.english: The towns shall be theirs to live in, and their pasturelands shall be for their livestock, their property, and all their needs.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ הֶעָרִים לָהֶם לָשָׁבֶת וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם יִהְיוּ לִבְהֶמְתָּם וְלִרְכֻשָׁם וּלְכֹל חַיָּתָם׃

verses.english: The pasturelands of the towns that you give the Levites shall extend a thousand cubits outward from the town wall all around.
verses.hebrew: וּמִגְרְשֵׁי הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם מִקִּיר הָעִיר וָחוּצָה אֶלֶף אַמָּה סָבִיב׃

verses.english: Outside the town measure two thousand cubits on the eastern side, two thousand on the southern side, two thousand on the western side, and two thousand on the northern side, with the town in the middle. These shall be their towns’ pasturelands.
verses.hebrew: וּמַדֹּתֶם מִחוּץ לָעִיר אֶת־פְּאַת־קֵדְמָה אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְאֶת־פְּאַת־נֶגֶב אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְאֶת־פְּאַת־יָם אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְאֵת פְּאַת צָפוֹן אַלְפַּיִם בָּאַמָּה וְהָעִיר בַּתָּוֶךְ זֶה יִהְיֶה לָהֶם מִגְרְשֵׁי הֶעָרִים׃

verses.english: Among the towns you give the Levites shall be the six cities of refuge that you provide for a manslayer to flee to; in addition to them, give forty-two towns.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם אֵת שֵׁשׁ־עָרֵי הַמִּקְלָט אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לָנֻס שָׁמָּה הָרֹצֵחַ וַעֲלֵיהֶם תִּתְּנוּ אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁתַּיִם עִיר׃

verses.english: All the towns you give the Levites shall be forty-eight towns, together with their pasturelands.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ לַלְוִיִּם אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁמֹנֶה עִיר אֶתְהֶן וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן׃

verses.english: For the towns that you give from the Israelites’ possession, take more from those who have much and less from those who have little. Each shall give some of his towns to the Levites in proportion to the inheritance he receives.”
verses.hebrew: וְהֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתְּנוּ מֵאֲחֻזַּת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאֵת הָרַב תַּרְבּוּ וּמֵאֵת הַמְעַט תַּמְעִיטוּ אִישׁ כְּפִי נַחֲלָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִנְחָלוּ יִתֵּן מֵעָרָיו לַלְוִיִּם׃

verses.english: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
verses.hebrew: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן אַרְצָה כְּנָעַן׃

verses.english: designate towns for yourselves to serve as cities of refuge, so that a manslayer who has struck a person unintentionally may flee there.
verses.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיתֶם לָכֶם עָרִים עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶינָה לָכֶם וְנָס שָׁמָּה רֹצֵחַ מַכֵּה־נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

verses.english: The towns shall be a refuge for you from the avenger, so that the manslayer does not die before standing before the congregation for judgment.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ לָכֶם הֶעָרִים לְמִקְלָט מִגֹּאֵל וְלֹא יָמוּת הָרֹצֵחַ עַד־עָמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה לַמִּשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: The towns you provide shall be six cities of refuge for you.
verses.hebrew: וְהֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר תִּתֵּנוּ שֵׁשׁ־עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶינָה לָכֶם׃

verses.english: Provide three towns across the Jordan and three towns in the land of Canaan; they shall be cities of refuge.
verses.hebrew: אֵת שְׁלֹשׁ הֶעָרִים תִּתְּנוּ מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן וְאֵת שְׁלֹשׁ הֶעָרִים תִּתְּנוּ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן עָרֵי מִקְלָט תִּהְיֶינָה׃

verses.english: These six towns shall be a refuge for the Israelites, the foreigner, and the resident among them, so that anyone who strikes a person unintentionally may flee there.
verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר וְלַתּוֹשָׁב בְּתוֹכָם תִּהְיֶינָה שֵׁשׁ־הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לְמִקְלָט לָנוּס שָׁמָּה כָּל־מַכֵּה־נֶפֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָה׃

verses.english: But if he strikes someone with an iron object and that person dies, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־בִּכְלִי בַרְזֶל הִכָּהוּ וַיָּמֹת רֹצֵחַ הוּא מוֹת יוּמַת הָרֹצֵחַ׃

verses.english: If he strikes someone with a hand-held stone capable of causing death and that person dies, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.hebrew: וְאִם בְּאֶבֶן יָד אֲשֶׁר־יָמוּת בָּהּ הִכָּהוּ וַיָּמֹת רֹצֵחַ הוּא מוֹת יוּמַת הָרֹצֵחַ׃

verses.english: Or if he strikes someone with a hand-held wooden object capable of causing death and that person dies, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.hebrew: אוֹ בִּכְלִי עֵץ־יָד אֲשֶׁר־יָמוּת בּוֹ הִכָּהוּ וַיָּמֹת רֹצֵחַ הוּא מוֹת יוּמַת הָרֹצֵחַ׃

verses.english: The blood-avenger himself shall put the murderer to death. When he encounters him, he shall put him to death.
verses.hebrew: גֹּאֵל הַדָּם הוּא יָמִית אֶת־הָרֹצֵחַ בְּפִגְעוֹ־בוֹ הוּא יְמִיתֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: If he pushes someone out of hatred or deliberately throws something at him and that person dies,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־בְּשִׂנְאָה יֶהְדָּפֶנּוּ אוֹ־הִשְׁלִיךְ עָלָיו בִּצְדִיָּה וַיָּמֹת׃

verses.english: or strikes him with his hand out of enmity and he dies, the one who struck him shall surely be put to death; he is a murderer. The blood-avenger shall put the murderer to death when he encounters him.
verses.hebrew: אוֹ בְאֵיבָה הִכָּהוּ בְיָדוֹ וַיָּמֹת מוֹת־יוּמַת הַמַּכֶּה רֹצֵחַ הוּא גֹּאֵל הַדָּם יָמִית אֶת־הָרֹצֵחַ בְּפִגְעוֹ־בוֹ׃

verses.english: But if he suddenly pushes someone without enmity, or throws any object at him without deliberate intent,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־בְּפֶתַע בְּלֹא־אֵיבָה הֲדָפוֹ אוֹ־הִשְׁלִיךְ עָלָיו כָּל־כְּלִי בְּלֹא צְדִיָּה׃

verses.english: or, without seeing him, drops on him a stone capable of causing death and he dies, though he was not his enemy and was not seeking his harm,
verses.hebrew: אוֹ בְכָל־אֶבֶן אֲשֶׁר־יָמוּת בָּהּ בְּלֹא רְאוֹת וַיַּפֵּל עָלָיו וַיָּמֹת וְהוּא לֹא־אוֹיֵב לוֹ וְלֹא מְבַקֵּשׁ רָעָתוֹ׃

verses.english: then the congregation shall judge between the one who struck him and the blood-avenger according to these ordinances.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁפְטוּ הָעֵדָה בֵּין הַמַּכֶּה וּבֵין גֹּאֵל הַדָּם עַל הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים הָאֵלֶּה׃

verses.english: The congregation shall rescue the manslayer from the hand of the blood-avenger and return him to the city of refuge to which he fled. He shall remain there until the death of the high priest who was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.hebrew: וְהִצִּילוּ הָעֵדָה אֶת־הָרֹצֵחַ מִיַּד גֹּאֵל הַדָּם וְהֵשִׁיבוּ אֹתוֹ הָעֵדָה אֶל־עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ אֲשֶׁר־נָס שָׁמָּה וְיָשַׁב בָּהּ עַד־מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדֹל אֲשֶׁר־מָשַׁח אֹתוֹ בְּשֶׁמֶן הַקֹּדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: But if the manslayer goes outside the boundary of the city of refuge to which he fled,
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־יָצֹא יֵצֵא הָרֹצֵחַ אֶת־גְּבוּל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָנוּס שָׁמָּה׃

verses.english: and the blood-avenger finds him outside the boundary of his city of refuge and kills the manslayer, the avenger incurs no bloodguilt.
verses.hebrew: וּמָצָא אֹתוֹ גֹּאֵל הַדָּם מִחוּץ לִגְבוּל עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ וְרָצַח גֹּאֵל הַדָּם אֶת־הָרֹצֵחַ אֵין לוֹ דָּם׃

verses.english: For he must remain in his city of refuge until the high priest’s death. After the high priest’s death, the manslayer may return to the land of his possession.
verses.hebrew: כִּי בְעִיר מִקְלָטוֹ יֵשֵׁב עַד־מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדֹל וְאַחֲרֵי מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן הַגָּדֹל יָשׁוּב הָרֹצֵחַ אֶל־אֶרֶץ אֲחֻזָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: These shall be a statute of judgment for you throughout your generations in all your settlements.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ אֵלֶּה לָכֶם לְחֻקַּת מִשְׁפָּט לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: In every case of a person being killed, the murderer shall be put to death on the testimony of witnesses. A single witness shall not testify against a person so as to cause his death.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־מַכֵּה־נֶפֶשׁ לְפִי עֵדִים יִרְצַח אֶת־הָרֹצֵחַ וְעֵד אֶחָד לֹא־יַעֲנֶה בְנֶפֶשׁ לָמוּת׃

verses.english: You shall not accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death; he shall surely be put to death.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־תִקְחוּ כֹפֶר לְנֶפֶשׁ רֹצֵחַ אֲשֶׁר־הוּא רָשָׁע לָמוּת כִּי־מוֹת יוּמָת׃

verses.english: You shall not accept a ransom for one who has fled to his city of refuge, allowing him to return to live in the land before the priest’s death.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־תִקְחוּ כֹפֶר לָנוּס אֶל־עִיר מִקְלָטוֹ לָשׁוּב לָשֶׁבֶת בָּאָרֶץ עַד־מוֹת הַכֹּהֵן׃

verses.english: You shall not pollute the land in which you are, for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood shed in it except by the blood of the one who shed it.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־תַחֲנִיפוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם בָּהּ כִּי הַדָּם הוּא יַחֲנִיף אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וְלָאָרֶץ לֹא־יְכֻפַּר לַדָּם אֲשֶׁר שֻׁפַּךְ־בָּהּ כִּי־אִם בְּדַם שֹׁפְכוֹ׃

verses.english: You shall not defile the land in which you live, in whose midst I dwell, for I, YHWH, dwell among the Israelites.”
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא תְטַמֵּא אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יֹשְׁבִים בָּהּ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי שֹׁכֵן בְּתוֹכָהּ כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה שֹׁכֵן בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: The ancestral heads of the clan of the descendants of Gilead son of Machir, son of Manasseh, from the clans of Joseph’s descendants, approached and spoke before Moses and the leaders, the ancestral heads of the Israelites.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְבוּ רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְמִשְׁפַּחַת בְּנֵי־גִלְעָד בֶּן־מָכִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף וַיְדַבְּרוּ לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וְלִפְנֵי הַנְּשִׂאִים רָאשֵׁי אָבוֹת לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: They said, “YHWH commanded my lord to give the land to the Israelites as an inheritance by lot, and my lord was commanded by YHWH to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶת־אֲדֹנִי צִוָּה יְהוָה לָתֵת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ בְּנַחֲלָה בְּגוֹרָל לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַאדֹנִי צֻוָּה בַיהוָה לָתֵת אֶת־נַחֲלַת צְלָפְחָד אָחִינוּ לִבְנֹתָיו׃

verses.english: But if they become wives of men from one of the other Israelite tribes, their inheritance will be taken from our ancestral inheritance and added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry. It will be taken from our allotted inheritance.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיוּ לְאֶחָד מִבְּנֵי שִׁבְטֵי בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְנָשִׁים וְנִגְרְעָה נַחֲלָתָן מִנַּחֲלַת אֲבֹתֵינוּ וְנוֹסַף עַל נַחֲלַת הַמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶינָה לָהֶם וּמִגֹּרַל נַחֲלָתֵנוּ יִגָּרֵעַ׃

verses.english: When the Jubilee comes for the Israelites, their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry, and their inheritance will be taken from the inheritance of our ancestral tribe.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־יִהְיֶה הַיֹּבֵל לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנוֹסְפָה נַחֲלָתָן עַל נַחֲלַת הַמַּטֶּה אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶינָה לָהֶם וּמִנַּחֲלַת מַטֵּה אֲבֹתֵינוּ יִגָּרַע נַחֲלָתָן׃

verses.english: Moses commanded the Israelites at YHWH’s direction, saying, “The tribe of Joseph’s descendants speaks rightly.
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו מֹשֶׁה אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־פִּי יְהוָה לֵאמֹר כֵּן מַטֵּה בְנֵי־יוֹסֵף דֹּבְרִים׃

verses.english: This is what YHWH has commanded concerning Zelophehad’s daughters: Let them marry whom they think best, but they shall marry within the clan of their father’s tribe.
verses.hebrew: זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה יְהוָה לִבְנוֹת צְלָפְחָד לֵאמֹר לַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵיהֶם תִּהְיֶינָה לְנָשִׁים אַךְ לְמִשְׁפַּחַת מַטֵּה אֲבִיהֶם תִּהְיֶינָה לְנָשִׁים׃

verses.english: No inheritance of the Israelites shall pass from tribe to tribe, for each Israelite shall hold fast to the inheritance of his ancestral tribe.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־תִסֹּב נַחֲלָה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמַּטֶּה אֶל־מַטֶּה כִּי אִישׁ בְּנַחֲלַת מַטֵּה אֲבֹתָיו יִדְבְּקוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Every daughter who inherits property among the Israelite tribes shall marry someone from the clan of her father’s tribe, so that each Israelite may possess his ancestral inheritance.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־בַּת יֹרֶשֶׁת נַחֲלָה מִמַּטּוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאֶחָד מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת מַטֵּה אָבִיהָ תִּהְיֶה לְאִשָּׁה לְמַעַן יִירְשׁוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ נַחֲלַת אֲבֹתָיו׃

verses.english: No inheritance shall pass from one tribe to another, for the Israelite tribes shall each hold fast to their own inheritance.”
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־תִסֹּב נַחֲלָה מִמַּטֶּה לְמַטֶּה אַחֵר כִּי־אִישׁ בְּנַחֲלָתוֹ יִדְבְּקוּ מַטּוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Zelophehad’s daughters did as YHWH had commanded Moses.
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה כֵּן עָשׂוּ בְּנוֹת צְלָפְחָד׃

verses.english: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, became wives of their paternal uncles’ sons.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּהְיֶינָה מַחְלָה תִרְצָה וְחָגְלָה וּמִלְכָּה וְנֹעָה בְּנוֹת צְלָפְחָד לִבְנֵי דֹדֵיהֶן לְנָשִׁים׃

verses.english: They married within the clans of the descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained within the tribe of their father’s clan.
verses.hebrew: מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן־יוֹסֵף הָיוּ לְנָשִׁים וַתְּהִי נַחֲלָתָן עַל־מַטֵּה מִשְׁפַּחַת אֲבִיהֶן׃

verses.english: These are the commandments and judgments that YHWH commanded the Israelites through Moses on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan opposite Jericho.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה הַמִּצְוֺת וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעַרְבֹת מוֹאָב עַל יַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ׃
